v-nuh-kuaan.title: Nuh ka sunsan kuaan
v-nuh-kuaan.text:
Nuh ke us gaon mein kuaan ke paas raat ko jaana mana tha. Hum paanch ladke gaye — isliye nahi ki hum bahadur the, balki isliye ki humein apne se bade kisi ki baat maan lena sharm ki baat lagti thi. Vahan pahunch kar hum chup ho gaye. Khet ke kinaare wala kuaan dhakka hua tha, par dhakkan adhoora tha.

Woh teen awaazein.

 Pehle ek thi — jhaanjhar jaisi, dheemi. Phir kinare ki mitti par kisi ke pairon ki khisak. Teesri, ek aurat ki saans, jo chalne ke saath nahi, rukne ke saath tez hoti thi. Humne torch maari. Kuch nahi.

 Bade ladke ne kaha chalo. Hum uthe hi the ki kisi ne poora naap kar kaha: “Mujhe ghar bula rahe hain.” Wahi awaaz mein, wahi muhavra, jo uske ghar mein use ghar walon ki thi. Woh bhaaga. Hum bhi.

 Subah gaon ke chowk mein humne sab sunaaya. Ek budhiya hansa bahut der. Phir chup ho gayi. Usne kaha ki 1962 ke baad is kuaan mein paani ka swaad badal gaya tha, aur gaon ke teen log usmein mare the. Baad mein logon ko paani se darr hone laga, kuaan band hua, aur darr ko kahani ki zaroorat padi.

 Khabar aise banti hai: kuch log sukh jaate hain, kuaan band ho jaata hai, aur phir woh jagah logon se khaali rehti hai — aur khaali jagah dheere-dheere apna kirdaar bana leti hai. Par us raat ki baat main aaj bhi gaon waalon ko nahi batata. Main sirf itna kehta hoon ki kuaan pe jaana band kar diya.

v-kaimur-ped.title: Kaimur ka rakshas-ped
v-kaimur-ped.text:
Kaimur ke ek gaon mein bargad ke neeche se raat ko nikla ek bhi aadmi baad mein apni zameen par khada nahi mila — aisa nahi ki maut tay thi, bas hosla jawab de deta tha. Teen saal mein teen maut hui, aur teenon raat ki thi. Gaon ne ped ko rakshas keh diya. Kisi ne use kaat diya.

Ped katta, darr nahi gaya.

 Ped katne ke baad bhi gaon ke log raat ko us jagah se ghoom ke jaate. Ek chhota-sa pile ka dher bhi wahan pada tha, jo kabhi ghaas mein duba rehta. Main us raat wahan tha, kyunki mera dost apni behen ko paani laane ke liye usi raaste bhejta tha aur use rasta badalne ki baat samajh nahi aati thi.

 Raat 9 baje hum wahan khade the. Sabse pehle koi awaaz nahi thi. Phir air mein ek halki khusar-phusar. Torch se dekha toh jabra thi — koi teen gaon ke ladke, jo wahan malai lene aaye the. Woh bhi hum se darr gaye. Do darr ek saath takraye aur ghar bhag gaye.

 Baat pata chalne par gaon ko apni kahani ka sabse bada hissa bhoolna pada: ek aisa raasta jo bilkul andhera tha, jahan saanp, khabad, aur baarish me gaddha ban jaata tha. Teen maut ke asli kaaran wahi the. Ped ko kaat dene se raasta gaya nahi — bas us raat ke baad kisi ne wahan jaana band kar diya, aur darr wapas baith gaya.

v-sundarbans-dokkhin.title: Dokkhin Rai ka jungle
v-sundarbans-dokkhin.text:
Sundarbans mein har maut ka ek karan hota hai: bagh, paani, saanp, ya darr. Par har maut ke baad gaon mein ek naam liya jaata hai — Dokkhin Rai, jungle ka raja. Rone waale se kaha jaata hai: wo sher ki aankhon, bandook ke nishane, aur jungle ke kanoon ko insaan se zyada samajhta hai.

Woh raat.

 Hum chaar log ek khaadi mein jaa rahe the. Machhli ka season tha aur bijli nahi thi. Kisne pehle kaha, yaad nahi, par sab ek saath chup ho gaye — jaise koi humare aage se nikal gaya ho. Mera dost jhuk gaya, haath upar, aur usne saamne dekhne ki himmat nahi ki. Uske baad, dhuan aur ghaas ke beech se, ek sher nikla — lamba, patla, aur bhookha.

 Toh woh sher hi tha. Bandook wale ne hawa mein maara, kyunki bagh par goli chalana kanoon ke bahar tha. Bagh thehar gaya, dekha, phir chala gaya. Ek raat ke baad kisi ne kaha hum Dokkhin Rai se mile. Par hum sirf ek bhukha bagh se mile the, aur woh kaafi tha.

 Gaon mein kehte hain ki Dokkhin Rai ko kosna nahi chahiye, warna wo dhyan dega. Mera manna hai: yahan log sher ke saath hi rehte hain, isliye darr ko ek naam dena asaan hota hai. Naam se jungle nayi jagah nahi bana; bas khauf ko ek shakal mil jaati hai. Sher se nazar bachakar chalna kanoon se bhi sahi hai, samajh se bhi.

v-bastar-chhalawa.title: Bastar ka chhalawa
v-bastar-chhalawa.text:
Bastar ke jungle mein raasta bhoolne ko “chhalawa” kehte hain. Zyada tar jal, khadd aur lapete hue ped hain; kisi ko kuch nahi hota, bas subah khud ko apne gaon se pachas kadam door pata hai. Par ek raat mera mama khud ko paanch ghante se usi mod par ghoomta paaya.

Teen baar wahi mod.

 Woh majdoori se laut rahe the. Raat 10 baje. Raasta chhota tha — bees minute. Teen mod ke baad wahi sookha kuaan aaya. Unhone poora shauk badal diya: ek lamba raasta liya. Kuaan aaya. Woh doobara ringane lage, aur woh teesri baar phir aaya.

 Us raat ka asli khel ye tha — unke paas adhi bhedmi, ek deewar jaisa dhundhla, aur padta hua dhoop: torche ka. Unhone chalti hui aansoo waali awaaz suni thi. Subah humne wo mod dekh kar samjha: do raste ek jaisi dhalan wale the aur ek khuli khet ki taraf. Andhere mein woh dono ek lagte the. Koi jungle ka khel nahi tha, aur koi bhi unhe “hing” nahi de raha tha.

 Gaon waale ab bhi kahte hain jungle ka koi chhalawa hai. Ho sakta hai. Par kaam ki baat ye hai: raat ko akele na nikalna, torch aur paani rakhna, aur apne ghar ka naam bhi jahan jaana phone me note karna. Chhalawa ek kahani ban jaaye to accha; par wahan pahunchna nahi.

v-kutch-dakan.title: Kutch ki dakan
v-kutch-dakan.text:
Kutch ke ek gaon mein “dakan” ka matlab hai ek aurat jo raat ko ghoomti hai. Koi use nahi dekhta; log bas us ek baat se bachte hain — raat ko apna naam sun kar pichhe mat mudna. Meri bua 17 saal ki thi jab unhone mud kar dekha.

Kya hua tha.

 Woh ghar se pachas kadam door the — aangan ke kuye par. Unke kaanon mein naam aaya, unki maa ki awaaz me, par unki maa to dilli me thi. Unhone mud kar dekha. Kuch nahi tha. Ghar jaakar unhone tawa garam kiya aur poora baat sunaya. Dada ne kuch nahi kaha, bas kaha ki raat ko narial waali chhitti pe mat jaana.

 Baad mein pata chala ki us raat gaon mein ek kutta khula tha jo aangan ke phaatak se raatein rota. Awaaz kisi ki nahi, hawa ke rukh aur ghar ke lohe ke jhagad ka kisa tha. Unki maa so rahi thi, aur dadi ki chik ka swar aage aa gaya.

 Lekin ek baat saaf-saaf hai: un adaazon ke gaon mein aurat ko raat ke khauf se ghar ke andar rakhne ka taqaza asli tha. Dakan ka naam gaon ki aurat ko niyantrit karta tha, aur kahaniyon ko bahana banaya jaata tha. Aaj bhi jo gaon dakan ko chase kaheta hai, wahan auratein akeli pit rahi hain. Dar ko sant ya mantar ke ghode ka rukh mat do.

v-bundelkhand-bangla.title: Railway colony ka khaali bangla
v-bundelkhand-bangla.text:
Bundelkhand ke ek chhote station ke peeche aath railway bangale the. Saat me station ke mazdoor rehte the. Aathva khaali tha — parda latka, darwaza band, aangan mein neem. Bachche kehte the wahan se aawazein nikalte hain. Bade kehte the wahan koi nahi rehta kyunki chhat girne wali hai.

Raat ka gana.

 Main baara saal ka tha. Ek raat maine apni jhalak me dekha ki chat par koi kuch ga raha hai. Awaaz dheemi, dhekhi hui. Subah maine apne papa se poocha. Woh chup rahe. Dopahar ko woh mujhe us bangale ke saamne le gaye, darwaza khola, aur andar ek puraana pen chhodkar wapas laaye.

 Us bangale me pehle ek signalman rehte the jo 1983 me widhaan hua tha. Uske baad koi nahi aaya. Par “aawazein” ki wajah mujhe papa ne dikhayi: chhat ke veem me tirchhi ratkadi lagi hui thi jo hawa me ek sarange jaisi aawaz karti thi. Kisi ne use kabhi theek nahi karaya.

 Ghar me gungunaahat aur darwaza khatkhataana — sabhi wahi ek tukda loha tha. Par us me yakeen karne wali baat ye hai: ek pen chod dena hi wo kaam tha jo kisi ne kiya. Bangla khaali nahi tha, par usme koi nahi tha — aur yahi asli baat har gaon ki khaali imaraton ke bare me sach hoti hai.

v-jharkhand-sil.title: Chudail ka sil
v-jharkhand-sil.text:
Palamu ke ek gaon me khet ke kinare ek sil (silbatta) padi thi. Kisi ko wahan baithna manaa tha kyunki kehte the ek chudail raat ko wahan baith kar dal pisa karti hai. Ek din ek naujawan ne mazaak me wahan tasveer ka ek frame laga diya, aur khada ho gaya ki subah woh dekhega ki kya hota hai.

Tasveer ka khel.

 Subah tasveer gir gayi thi, aur sil par aata ka nishaan tha. Gaon me hahakaar mach gaya. Sach ye tha: raat me do gaon ke bache aaye the, unhe khilauna mila, unhone frame hilaya. Aata ka nishaan kisi ki dosti ka nahi — kisi ki roti ka tha. Par kisi ne sunliya nahi.

 Baat aage badhi. Ek budhiya ko “wo” bataya jaane laga. Woh akeli rehti thi, ek chorangi ke ghar me, chalte waqt jhuki hui. Gaon ke bache unke darwaze par patthar maarte. Ek shaam maine unke aangan me ek dholak dekhi aur unhe gaate hue suna — aur mujhe yaad aaya ki mere nani bhi aisi hi gaate the.

 Maine apni maa se kaha. Unhone sil ke paas wahi tasveer pehle hatai, phir gaon ke mukhiya ke ghar me baat ki. Do hafte intezaar ke baad budhiya ne raat ka baithak band kar diya. Chudail koi nahi thi. Ek akeli aurat thi jise darr ka naam de diya gaya tha, aur naam de dene ke baad uske ghar ke saamne patthar pade the.

v-bodo-bez.title: Bez ka gaon
v-bodo-bez.text:
Assam me “bez” ka matlab jadu-tantra nhai, ek aisa daava hai jisme kisi ko bimari, bhool ya badkismati di ja sakti hai. Goalpara ke ek gaon me do parivaron ke beech zameen ka jhagda tha, aur ek raat baad bade beta raat bhar ghoomta raha.

Ilzaam ka rukh.

 Ladke ne kaha kisi ne usse “pakad” liya. Gaon ne seedha ungli uthai — samne wale ghar ki burhiya par. Woh viddhwa thi, akeli, aur uske bete ne zameen bech di thi. Beech raat uske ghar ka darwaza khata khata. Mere mama, jo gaon me doctor nahi the par compaundar the, wahan pahunche aur unhone woh cheez dekhi jo koi nahi dekhna chahta tha: ladka nashe me tha.

 Woh teen din se bhang aur nasha kar raha tha kyunki uski mangetar ki shaadi kisi aur se tay ho gayi thi. Raat bhar ghoomna, ulti, aur “koi aa raha hai” — sab nasha wapas utarne ka kaam tha. Par gaon ko tantra wali kahani zyada pasand aayi, kyunki kahani me zameen ka jhagda chhup jaata hai.

 Us raat maine ek baat seekhi: jab gaon me kuch samajh nahi aata, to woh “bez” ka naam le leta hai. Aur us naam ka nishana aksar woh hota hai jo sabse kamzor ho. Mayong ke museum me jo kahaniya lagayi gayi hain, unhe padhne ke baad mujhe lagta hai ki asli tantra to yahi hai — kisi ke darr ko kisi aur ke khilaf istemal karna.

v-kandhamal-duma.title: Jungle ki duma
v-kandhamal-duma.text:
Odisha ke Kandhamal me ek purani baat hai: ek chhota-sa jeev, jo raat ko aadmi ki chhati par baith jaata hai, jisse aadmi jag nahi paata. Log use duma kehte hain. Chhoti si baat hai, par gaon ki har aurat apne bachche ko seene se laga kar soti hai.

Woh raat.

 Main solaa saal ka tha. Graam me chacha ki maut ke baad unka ghar khaali tha. Main wahan do raat sone gaya. Pehli raat theek rahi. Doosri raat main 3 baje uta aur mujhe laga koi upar baitha hai. Main hil nahi paaya, saans tez, aur aawazein — apne ghar ke logon ki. Maine aankh khuli rakhkar dekha. Kuch nahi tha.

 Main baad me darr kar bhaaga. Chachi ne mujhe paani diya aur apne paas sula liya. Chunki unhe maloom tha. Unhone kaha ki wo duma nahi hoti, wo “raat ka dabaav” hai — jab dimaag aadhe jaage, aadhe soye ho, to jism hak jaata hai aur darr ke saath apni hi aawaz me bole huee baatein sunai deti hain. Unki beti ko hota tha, aur unke papa ko bhi.

 Pehli baar mujhe kisi gaon ki aurat ne bhooton ke baare me aisa seedha jawaab diya. Kahaniyan chhup jati hain, par asli baat ghar ke andar chal rahi hoti hai. Aaj bhi mujhe wo dabaav hota hai. Main ab darr me chhat par nahi bhagta. Main karwat leta hoon, ginnta hoon, aur apni maa ka naam leta hoon.

v-kolli-hills.title: Kolli Hills ka mod
v-kolli-hills.text:
Kolli Hills jaane waale koi bhi driver aapko ek baat bata dega: gina hua mod khatam hone ke baad aage mat jaaiye. Kuch mod raat me do baar aate hain. Bus ka driver, jise sab “anna” bulate the, har baar yahi kehte the — route me nahi, sabar me hai.

70 ke baad.

 Hum late laut rahe the. Barish ne hills ko chamka diya tha. Anna gaadi dheemi kar rahe the. 69va mod aaya, 70va aaya — aur phir sadak wahi lagne lagi. Unhone gaadi rok di. Humne kaha aage badhaiye. Unhone headlight band kardi. Andhere me humne sirf barish suni.

 Unhone kaha ki pahadi raaste me barish ke baad aksar mitti dhasak jaati hai. Ek baar unki gaadi ek mod par ruki thi jo aage nahi tha — aage gadda tha. Us din se woh barish me gina mod ke baad rok ke rukte hain, ek lambi saans lete hain, aur dheere chalte hain.

 Woh raat unke liye bhoot ki nahi, barish ki thi. Aur hum jo 71va mod samajh rahe the, wo actually barish me ek aisa jhukav tha jo pehle kabhi nahi dikha. Bhoot ho ya na ho — pahadi par raat, barish, aur guarantee chahiye hoti hai to ruk jaana sabse samajhdari ka kaam hai. Us raat us driver ne humein bachaya, aur yahi asli kahani hai.

v-kuttanad-paani.title: Kuttanad ka paani
v-kuttanad-paani.text:
Kuttanad me zameen sagar se neeche hai. Khet me paani, raaste me paani, aangan me paani. Bachche shuru se hi kashti chalana seekhte hain, aur shareer ka sabse bada khatra paani hai. Ye baat kahani me ghati nahi — chhota bachcha paani me gir sakta hai.

Woh saaf raat.

 Main apne nana ke saath kashti se lautar raha tha. Raat 9 baje. Dhaan ke khet sunne the, hawa thami hui thi. Nana ne achanak kashti ka bhaar mehsoos kiya — kashti thodi dheemi ho gayi, jaise kisi ne kinara thaam liya ho. Unhone jor se maara. Ek pal baad humne chhota sa khaalira dekha — ek vyakti ka lin, ya koi bachcha gaadha hone ka intezaar.

 Wo ek saaye jaisi cheez nahi thi. kisi ne kinare par aag jala rakhi thi; ek ladka machhli pakad raha tha. Usne hume daraya nahi, usne bas paani me haath badhaya. Par nana ne kashti nahi rok di — unhone kaha, koi doosra ho to bachega nahi. Main aaj bhi uske chehre ko ek maut ke bhram ke saath jodta hoon.

 Kerala ki lakhon kahaniyan paani se hain: yakshi, athiswara, mrenu. Inke pichhe ek asli dar hai jo har saal baadh me laut aata hai. Kahani tabhi badi hoti hai jab sach itna bada ho ki sach ko hi bhool jayein.

v-malwa-peepal.title: Malwa ka peepal
v-malwa-peepal.text:
Malwa ke gaon me puraana peepal har gali me hai. Ek peepal ke neeche chhoti si vedi thi, jise koi nahi chhoota tha. Bache wahan ball maarte the. Ek din ball gaayab ho gayi, aur agle din gaon me ek naam chal gaya.

Ball wapas aayi.

 Uss raat main chhat par tha. Mera dost mitti ki vedi ke saamne se guzra aur ruk gaya — jaise kisi ne usse naam se bula lia ho. Woh muda, aur wahan kuch nahi tha. Usne joota utaar ke maafi maangi. Agli subah ball vedi par rakhi thi.

 Gaon me kaafi din tak yeh chala ki kisi ne ball chori nahi ki, bhoot ne wapas ki. Sach ye tha: unka chhota bhai, jo darr ke maare raat ko nahi jaata tha, subah jaldi uth kar ball le gaya tha aur vedi par rakh diya — kyunki woh bhi darr gaya tha, aur usne soote hue bhagwan se maafi maang li thi.

 Ek ball ne poore gaon ki thami hui hawa ko hilaa diya. Phir bhi main ek baat nahi bhoolta: us raat mere dost ka rukna asli tha. Insaan ka dimaag kahaniyon me itna reheta hai ki wo wahan se kuch bhi sun leta hai. Kabhi kabhi woh suni hui awaaz se apna naam hi jode leta hai.

v-shekhawati-haveli.title: Shekhawati ki haveli
v-shekhawati-haveli.text:
Shekhawati ke woh khaali haveli hamare gaon ki sabse badi imarat thi. Saath darwaze, ek aangan, aur chhat par chhoti si baurdi. Aaj usme kisi ka koi nahi. Lekin wahan ek aadat bani hui thi: raat ko pachhe ka darwaza khud khul jaata tha.

Darwaza aur hawa.

 Mere mama, jo bijli ke karamchari the, ek raat wahan gaye the. Unhone darwaza khula paaya, andar mashaal jaisi roshni dekhi, aur bahar nikal aaye. Agle din unhone wahi rakha hua daulat ka peepa dekha — andar kuch nahi tha. Unhone apni baat gaon me nhi kahi. Ek mahine baad haveli gir gayi.

 Haveli ka khatra that ki uski deewarein mitti ke lohe se bandhi thin. Woh andar se gili ho jaati thi. Darwaza khula isliye mila kyunki baarish se uski lakdi phail gayi thi aur kundi theek se nahi baith rahi thi. Andar ki roshni kisi chirag ki nahi thi — woh aas-paas ke khet me ja rahi kisi gaadi ki headlight thi, jo toote darwaze se aangan me pad rahi thi.

 Yahan ka asli horror ye hai ki haveli 2010 me aaj bhi khadi hai, aur gaon ke bachche uske andar cricket khelte hain. Kahaniyan khaali jagahon ko bahana deti hain — aur wo bahana kisi ki jaan bacha sakta hai. Girne wali imarat ke bahane asli the; aatma se darr banaya gaya.

v-rann-safar.title: Rann ka safar
v-rann-safar.text:
Kutch ke safed rann me raat ko truck le jaana sabse khatarnaak kheti hai. Reet me aadha rasta kho jata hai; namak ki parat par namak ke kinare se raasta nahi dikhta. Ek raat humne do truck waalon se wahi suna jo gaon me kabhi nahi suna tha.

Woh doosri gaadi.

 Raat 2 baje. Driver ne bataya ki aage ek truck khada tha, headlight jala kar, bonnet khula hua. Usne horn mara. Koi jawaab nahi. Usne gaadi rok di. Main bahar utar gaya. Wahan par truck tha hi nahi — bas ek namak ka dher tha, jiski shakal usne galti se gaadi samajh li.

 Baad me pata chala ki wo raat me namak ke dher hote hain, jo rann me namak se bante hain. Aur humne thodi door ek chhoti si jhopdi dekhi jisme ek budha baith kar daal pakka raha tha. Unhone bataya ki ye raat ka kaam hai — namak uthana — aur pichle saal ek truck raat me palt gaya tha. Teen logon ki maut hui thi.

 Us raat hamare liye bhoot ek namak ka dher tha. Par us shakhs ka darr asli tha: rann me raat ko koi bhi kaam karta hai, uske paas ek bhi galat mod ka parinaam jaan le sakta hai. Maine apni gaadi wahan rok di, aur us driver ne apni aankhein namak ke paani se dhoin. Uske baad humne rann me kuch bhi ajeeb nahi dekha.

v-konkan-wada.title: Konkan ka wada
v-konkan-wada.text:
Konkan ke ek gaon me brahminon ka ek puraana wada tha. Uska aakhri rahne wala puraani umar me chala gaya. Uske baad ghar me kuch nahi chheda gaya — kyunki gaon kahentha tha ki jo bhi andar se kuch nikaalega, usse wahi cheez wapas maangi jaayegi.

Sindoor ka dibba.

 Main wahan apni mausi ke saath gaya tha. Mausi ek chhota dibba le kar aayin — usme sindoor aur ek peetal ki nath thi. Raat me wahi barish shuru hui jo Konkan me ek hafte rehti hai. Teesri raat wada ki taraf se kholi baji. Subah darwaza khula tha. Dibba gir gaya tha, aur nath zameen par.

 Mausi ne baad me bataya ki wo dibba unke nani ka tha, jo usi wada me rehti thi. Unhone use isliye liya tha ki unki beti ki shaadi thi. Gaon waalon ki baat sunkar unhone use rakh diya tha. Awaaz kisi ki nahi thi — wada ke purane kivad barish aur hawa se aise hi bajte hain. Par us raat unhone sab wapas rakh diya, sirf ek yaad ke liye.

 Konkan me ghar sirf imarat nahi hote. Unme zameen, paani, aur purvajon ki chizon ka hisaab hota hai. Yun “bhoot” keh dena aasan hai; par asli baat ye thi ki kisi choti si cheez se poori family ki yaadein judi thin — aur unhe wapas rakhne me kisi ka nuksan nahi tha.

v-goa-addo.title: Goa ka addo
v-goa-addo.text:
Goa me aise ghar bahut hain — chhajje, rang birange khidki, aangan me phool. Kuch band pade hain kyunki unke maalik Portugal chale gaye. Ek aise ghar se raat me gaana aata tha. Gaon ke ladke wahan jaane se darte the — par padosi ke aangan me chup kar sunte zaroor the.

Gramophone.

 Main ek shaam wahan gaya. Ghar ke aage chhota sa mandir tha, aur ek budha aadmi roti baant raha tha. Unhone kaha ki woh gaana unki maa ka hai. Ghar me unke bhai rehte the jo pichle saal mare the — aur aaj bhi gaana bajta hai.

 Andar ja kar pata chala ki gramophone nahi, ek purana radio tha jise kisi ne chhota generator par chalaya tha. Gaon ke bachche raat me wahan jaate the aur radio chalate the. Phir aage baat badhi. “Bhoot” ka dar wahan raat ko jaanvar aur chor se bachane ka bahana ban gaya tha.

 Us ghar ki asli kahani ye thi: ek budha akela reh gaya tha, aur gaon ke bachche uske ghar ko bhool gaye the. Jab unhone suna ki wahan se gaana aata hai, to kuch log wahan jaane lage. Kuch gaane sunate the, kuch unke liye khana le jaate the. Bhoot ki kahani ne unke paas log pahuncha diye — aur ye is site ka sabse ajeeb sach hai.

v-coorg-estate.title: Coffee estate ka bungalow
v-coorg-estate.text:
Coorg ke coffee estate ke andar ek purana bungalow hai. Angrezi zamaane ka, lal chhat wala. Ab wahan koi nahi rehta — par uska aangan subah saaf milta hai. Gaon waale kehte hain wahan ek memsahib rehti hai jo chai banati hai.

Chai ki khushbu.

 Main wahan ek season raha. Subah kaam par jaate waqt aangan me chai ki khushbu aati thi. Ek raat main chhat par leta tha aur maine khirki me roshni dekhi. Main darwaze tak gaya, aur andar kuch nahi tha — bas ek puraana samaan.

 Baad me pata chala ki wahan ek watchman rehta tha jo subah 4 baje chai banata tha aur aangan saaf karta tha. Chai ki khushbu uski thi. “Roshni” estate ke kaamgar ki torch thi. Usne kaha kya hua, maine kuch nahi kaha — kyunki mera aana hi uske liye ek cheez thi jo bina soche aa jaati thi.

 Coorg ke estate bungalow apne hi mausam banate hain: sookhi lakdi, gili chhappar, geele kapde. Unme roshni, awaaz aur khushbu sab hoti hai. Par sabse badi baat ye hai ki wahan bade logon ki purani duniya ki yaadein hain — aur kabhi kabhi ek angrezi imarat ki yaad dene wala koi nahi hota. Us raat ke baad maine us watchman ke liye do cup chai banayi.

v-telangana-qila-gaon.title: Qile ke peeche ka gaon
v-telangana-qila-gaon.text:
Warangal ke ek qile ki deewar gaon ke peeche hai. Gaon ke bachche qile me nahi jaate, kyunki andar koi aawaz de to woh kisi ki nahi hoti. Ek sham meri behen ne wahan se aawaz suni — aur asli madad maang rahi thi.

Woh aawaz.

 Humne poora gaon bulaya. Koi andar nahi gaya. Unhone kaha ki ye wahi hai jo bachchon ko bulati hai. Do ghante tak woh aawaz aati rahi, phir bandh ho gayi. Raat ko meri behen royi, aur subah ek buzurg ne bataya ki pichle din ek gaon ka ladka lapata tha — do din baad qile ke paas mila, bhookha, dara hua, par zinda.

 Bechen ka koi bhoot nahi tha. Woh ek 9 saal ka bachcha tha jo qile ki deewar par chadh gaya aur utar nahi paaya. Uski maa ne poore gaon se madad maangi thi — aur gaon ne darr ke naam par jawaab nahi diya. Baad me maine socha: gaon ki kahaniyan kis liye thin? Qila gir raha tha, deewarein thi, aur wahan jaana khatarnaak tha. Kahani ne bachchon ko bachaya — aur us raat ek bachche ne bachon ko na bachaya.

 Us din se gaon me ek niyam badla: aawaz aaye to pehle 112 aur gaon ke mukhiya ko. Prarthana baad me. Kahani to rahegi, par uske bhoot ko insaan ki awaaz se pehle mat rakhiye.

v-araku-raasta.title: Araku ka raasta
v-araku-raasta.text:
Araku jaane wale driver ek baat zyada bolte hain: raat me us mod par ek aurat khadi hoti hai, haath hilati hai. Gaadi rok kar wo gaayab ho jaati hai. Humne roka. Aur woh gaayab nahi hui.

Woh aurat.

 Ghat road par barish ho rahi thi. Woh safed saree me thi, sir ghuma hua, haath usi tarah. Hum ruke. Woh paas aayi aur boli — bus chhoot gayi, gaon tak chhodein. Jaate hue woh chup rahi. Ek gaon me utri aur ek ghar ki taraf chali gayi.

 Ek hafte baad wahi khabar humein pahadi ke doosre gaon me mili: ek aurat jo raat ko khadi rehti hai, humesha safed saree me. Kisi ne bhoot kaha, kisi ne “chudail”. Sach ye tha ki woh ek ASHA worker thi jo gaon ke bachchon ko dawa dene ke baad chalti thi, kyunki bus ka aakhri time chala jaata tha. Pahad me raat koi aur gaadi nahi milti, isliye gaon waalog ne unhe raat ke himaayat ke liye “wo” keh diya.

 Main nahi kehta ki har aurat jo raat me haath hilaye insaan hai. Main ye kehta hoon ki hum sirf unhe bhoot samajhte hain jo humari madad maang rahe hain. Us raat ke baad driver ne apne gaadi meine ek sticker lagaya: “aurat ko chhod do, bhoot nahi hai.”

v-chambal-paani.title: Chambal ka behta paani
v-chambal-paani.text:
Chambal ke kinare ke gaon me har bachche ko tairna zaroori tha. Isi liye paani ko le kar ek ajeeb sa dar mila hua tha: kahani kehti thi ki behte paani me doobne wale ka jism kabhi nahi milta, aur jo milta hai woh chalta hai. Ghaat par raat ko roshni dikhti hai.

Ghaat ki roshni.

 Meri nani kehte the ki unke chacha ek raat ko ghaat gaye, aur wahan ek diya jal raha tha. Unhone use uthaya — nahin, unhone use nahi uthaya. Unhone use dekha, chhooa, aur woh diya unke haath me bujh gaya. Us raat ke baad se unke kaan se khoon aata tha.

 Baad me pata chala ki us raat ghaat par ek shaadi ka samaan khula tha. Diya wahi tha. Kaan ka khoon kuch aur tha — unke kaan me infection tha jo unhe kabhi maloom nahi hua, aur ek raat unhe kaan se khoon aane laga. Par gaon me bas yahi chala ki unhe “us” ne chhua.

 Chambal ki darr ki asli wajah behta paani nahi hai. Yahan daku, gareebi, aur nojawan ladkon ke ghunghat the — aur unke chale jaane ne gaon me sapne chhod diye. Baaki sabhi jagah ki tarah, yahan bhi khaali jagah ko bharne ke liye kahani chahiye thi.

v-sonepur-mela.title: Sonepur ka mela
v-sonepur-mela.text:
Sonepur ka mela duniya ka sabse bada pashu mela kaha jaata tha. Mela khatam hone ke baad maidan khaali hota hai. Ek raat ek budhe aadmi ne wahan haathiyon ki chain suni. Woh apni nar na, gaya, aur phir usne uski taraf dekha.

Chain jo baji.

 Wo aadmi mela dekhta tha. Usne kaha raat me ek haathi lapata tha aur gaon ke log uski talash me the. Mela khaali tha. Chain ki awaaz us haathi ke pairon se aayi thi. Kuch der baad unhe chain mili — kisi ne use ped me latka diya tha, jisse hawa mein awaaz aati thi.

 Mela ke baad ka maidan ajeeb jagah hota hai: bhookhe pashu, bache hue khaane, aur sookhi zanjeerein. Gaon ke bachche wahan chain paate hain aur bajate hain. Woh awaaz raat me sunai de to khaufzada hone ki zaroorat nahi, par wahan jaana mana hona chahiye kyunki wahan janwar ke leye khali jagah nahi hoti.

 Us raat us aadmi ne mujhe kuch kaha jo main use karta hoon: “Bhoot ki kahani tab tak chalti hai jab tak koi un cheezon ko dekhne wahan na jaye jo asli hain.”

v-ichamati.title: Ichamati ka kinara
v-ichamati.text:
Ichamati ke kinare ke gaon me raat ko koi nadi par phool nahi chhodta. Kahani kehti hai ki ek aurat paani ke kinare khadi rehti hai aur jo bhi phool le kar jaata hai, usse woh apne paas bulati hai. Durgapuja ke baad ye khof alag hota hai.

Phool aur paani.

 Meri mausi ke gaon me ek ladki raat ko nadi gayi thi pratahkal dekhne. Wo jaani na thi — kahin galti se to nahi? Woh gayi, aur wapas nahi aayi. Teen din baad paani se nikli. Kahani pehle hi tay ho chuki thi: woh aurat mil gayi.

 Par gaon ki police-report me ek baat thi jo kisi ko sunana nahi tha: kinare par chatri ki mitti dhalak gayi thi, upar barish ke baad kai. Saavdhaan par unhe lagta tha ki ek aurat usse bulati hai, isliye kisi ne mitti ki naali ko theek nahi karaya.

 Kuch din baad maine gaon ki auraton ko nadi kinare jate dekha, phool le kar. Unhone kaha ki ye barish-baandh ke liye hai. Woh bhoot ko nahi dhoondh rahi thin — woh usi nadi ko theek kar rahi thin jisne ek ladki li thi. Is file ka sabak yahi hai: kahani ko dosh mat dijiye, kinare ki mitti ko dekhiye.

v-sikkim-gompa.title: Gompa ki ghanti
v-sikkim-gompa.text:
Sikkim me ek chhota gompa pahadi par hai. Raat ko cheekhne wali hawa, aur gompa ki ghanti bajti hai — hamesha ek hi waqt par. Bhikshu mushkil se Hindi bolte the, par unhone ek line saaf boli: “Awaaz ban jaati hai.”

Teen baje.

 Main wahan raat bhar ruka. Baraf pighalti rahi. Ek baje tak thand se kaanp gaya. Bees minute pehle ghanti bajana shuru hua — pehle dheemi, phir saaf. Maine neeche dekha. Ek buddha bhikshu wahan baitha tha aur woh lambe sibre se khud ghanti baja raha tha.

 Subah maine poocha. Unhone kaha ki sadiyon se parampara hai: raat ke teen baje dhyan ke baad ghanti bajai jaati hai, taki pahad par bhatke hue logon ko raasta mile. Har raat ek bhi bhikshu baithta hai. “Khud baji” wali baat maine kisi bahane se kuch sune hue logon se suni thi — kyunki gompa ki ghanti ki awaaz pahad me sadiyon tak ghoomti hai.

 Mujhe us raat joh darr laga tha, woh us ghanti se nahi tha. Woh us pahad se tha jo itna bada tha ki laga ki koi poochh hi nahi sakta ki main yahan kyun hoon. Subah maine unhe dhanyavaad kaha. Unhone has kar kaha: “Yahan koi khud nahi bajti. Yahan koi hai jo bajata hai.” Aur woh sabse zyada human answer tha.

v-meghalaya-pul.title: Jeevit pul
v-meghalaya-pul.text:
Meghalaya ke jungle me aam ke jadon ke banaye jeevit pul hain. Hum sab unhe dekhne aate hain, un par chadhte hain, aur un par ruk kar tasveerain lete hain. Gaon walon ne hume poora din thik se chalaya; raat ko unhi pulon par rukna mana kiya.

Andheri pul.

 Main wahan ruka. Raat gaon se door, ek doosri pul ki taraf. Pehle dhuan sa laga, phir paani ki awaaz aisi lagi jaise koi neeche baat kar raha ho. Main dobara aaram se baitha. Aadhe ghante baad zor ka geeli hawa aayi. Ek geela haath meri taraf aaya aur meri jeb me kuch ghusedta hua chala gaya.

 Subah maine apni jeb me ek lipti hui patti mein tazyi ki ek chhoti si gile moti si cheez dekhi — Ek chhota sa supari. Dophar me maine gaon ke buzurg ko dikhaya. Woh chup rahe. Unhone kaha ki raat ko pulon par jaanvar aate hain; unhone mehsoos kiya ki koi unhe aise daanv ke liye bhejta hai. Unhone mujhe mana kiya, aur us supari ko wapas pul par rakhne bola.

 Aur us haath ka sach? Mujhe nahi pata. Meghalaya ke jungle me kai jaanvar aur kai clan ki paramparayein hain; main wahan kisi ka anuman nahi lagaunga. Meri raat me sach me koi insaan tha ya koi janwar — mujhe nahi maloom. Lekin ye main jaanta hoon: hum par lenge photo, par un par log rehte hain. Wo jeevit pul unka hai. Raat me unke jeevit pul par mat rukna.

v-ziro-valley.title: Ziro ki pichli khidki
v-ziro-valley.text:
Ziro valley me chawal ki kheti sabse khoobsurat dhalee hai. Gaon me ghar bade hote hain, aur raat ko pichhli khidki khuli rehti thi. Ek raat mehku bhai ne wahan se kuch dekha tha, aur unhone hamesha ke liye sheesha laga diya.

Khidki se aawaz.

 Unhone kaha ki raat ko kisi ne unka naam liya — bahar se. Unhone khidki me se jhaanka. Andere me ek insaan ka silhouette tha. Woh ek bachcha tha jo gaon ke raste bhool gaya tha. Unhone use naam se pukara, to woh bhag gaya. Subah woh bachcha paani ke kinare mila, bhookha, thanda, par zinda.

 Gaon walon ne use daanav nahi kaha. Unhone bas ek niyam bana diya: raat ko pichhli khidki khuli nahi chhodni. Aaj us gaon me nahi hai koi pichhli khidki — sab me sheesha hai. Bacche mazaak me ab bhi poochhte hain ki “khidki kyun bandh hai?”

 Har gaon ka ek sach hai jo kahani me chhupta hai: yahan kisi ke ghar ki pichhli khidki jungle ki taraf kholti hai. Raat me wahan se koi insaan, koi jaanvar, ya koi hawa aa sakti hai. Sheesha ek dar ka nahi — ek kaarname ka part hai.

v-pilibhit-bhainsa.title: Pilibhit ka bhainsa
v-pilibhit-bhainsa.text:
Pilibhit ke jungle se lage gaon me raat ko aangan me ek bhainsa khada milta tha. Koi use apna nahi batata tha. Do-teen raaton baad gaon kehte the ki woh bhoot hai jo doodh dene aata hai, par doodh kabhi nahi deta.

Register ki baat.

 Mere tauji forest office me clerk the. Unhone ek baar wahan ek register dekha jisme gaon ke aas-paas bhatke hue pashuon ki entries thi. Ek bhainsa pichhle mahine se wahan ghoom raha tha — kisi ne use chhoda tha, ya woh mela se bhatak gaya tha.

 Gaon me kahani chal padi. Kisi ne kaha woh bhoot hai, kisi ne kaha uski aankhon me aag hai. Tauji ne range officer ko kaha, aur do hafte baad woh bhainsa pakda gaya aur uske maalik ko lauta diya gaya. Uske gale me ek purana ghungroo tha, aur us ghungroo ki awaaz hi gaon ke liye “bhoot ki ghanti” ban gayi thi.

 Us raat aangan me koi bhoot nahi tha. Ek bhookha janwar tha jise ghar nahi mila. Par uska dar asli tha — bhainsa raat me kisi ko bhi maar sakta hai. Gaon ne kahani suni aur dur reh gaya. Thik hi kiya. Bas us janwar ko bhoot kehne ki zaroorat nahi thi.

v-banka-naadi.title: Banka ki naadi
v-banka-naadi.text:
Banka ke ek gaon me ek chhoti nadi thi jo har saal ek hi jagah se bahar nikal kar kheton me chali jaati thi. Gaon ke buzurg kehte the ki us mod ke neeche ek saanp rehta hai jo paani ko apni taraf bulaata hai. Isliye us jagah ko “naag mod” kehte the.

Naag mod.

 Barsaat ke baad humne wahan khudai karwai. Gaon wale bura maan gaye. Teen foot neeche purani deewar ki neev mili — ek chhota pul jaisa dhancha jo kisi zamane me paani rokta tha. Woh ab toota hua tha, isliye paani har saal rukh badal kar usi taraf aata tha.

 Saanp koi nahi tha. Ek purana nirman tha jise kisi ne bhula diya. Panchayat ne us jagah ko saaf karwaya, aur us saal gaon me pahli baar baadh ka paani kheton me nahi gaya. Buzurg chup rahe, phir unhone kaha: “Naag bhi theek hi kehta tha.”

 Isse mujhe ek baat samajh aayi. Gaon ki kahani ne us jagah ko yaad rakha jahan paani khatarnaak tha. Kahani galat thi, par uski nishan-dehi bilkul sahi — usne ek asli khatre par ek board laga diya tha, bas us par “naag” likh diya tha.

v-kochi-chawl.title: Kochi ke chawl ki teesri manzil
v-kochi-chawl.text:
Kochi ke ek purane chawl ki teesri manzil khaali thi. Seedhiyan lambi thin, chhat gili. Gaon wale kehte the wahan ek budhiya har raat phool rakhti hai — kisi ke liye, jise koi nahi jaanta. Main chadha, kyunki mujhe phool nahi dekhne the, malba dekhna tha.

Phool aur chhat.

 Wahan ek kamre me khuli khidki thi, aur uske paas ek martban me taaza genda rakhe the. Kamra saaf tha. Main darr gaya. Neeche utar kar maine chawkidaar ko poocha. Woh hausa — uski maa pichhle saal wahi rehti thi, aur woh falle hue kamre me roz phool rakhta tha.

 Us chawl ki chhat 2019 me gir gayi thi. Wahan rehne wale logon ko nikaal diya gaya tha. Kuch log nahi gaye. Ek budhiya rehti thi, par gaon ne uske bare me kuch nahi socha, sirf “wo log” keh diya.

 Aaj main samajhta hoon ki chawl ka bhoot koi nahi tha. Ek beta tha jo apni maa ke kamre me phool rakhta tha, aur ek gaon tha jo usse darr ke naam se bulata tha. Jahan imarat girti hai, wahan kahaniyan pehle aa jaati hain — aur asli log chhup jaate hain.

v-bellandur-jheel.title: Jheel ke kinare ki awaaz
v-bellandur-jheel.text:
Bellandur ke ek jheel ke kinare raat ko log paani me girte the. Darr ki baat ye thi ki wahan koi peene nahi jaata tha — bas ghoomne. Gaon kehte the ki jheel ka koi “bulaava” hai.

Do khambhe.

 Maine ek raat wahan guzari. Jheel ke kinare pathar, ghaas, aur ek toota hua railing. Hawa me ek ajeeb si badbu thi, aur aankh me jalan hoti thi. Main 15 minute me wapas aaya. Agle din pata chala ki us jheel me kabhi kabhi jhag ka gas banti hai, jo kam hawa me zameen ke paas jam jaati hai.

 “Bulaava” koi nahi tha. Log railing ke paas jaate, ghaas gili hoti, aur ek jhag se sar chakra jaata. Do logon ne kaha ki unhe koi kheench raha tha — aur woh sahi keh rahe the. Unhe jhag khud kheench raha tha.

 Shahar ke kinare-paas ke jheel ab gaon nahi hain — par unki kahaniyan wahi hain. Asli khatra: railing, gili ghaas aur gas. Bhoot ki kahani sunane se pehle taar lagaiye. Ek pothole, ek band railing — inka “mantar” asli hai.

v-hyderabad-motigalli.title: Motigalli ka bungalow
v-hyderabad-motigalli.text:
Hyderabad ke Motigalli ke ek bungalow me koi nahi rehta tha. Raat 1 baje kursi ghaseetne ki awaaz aati, aur ek purana fan chalta rehta. Paanch logon ne ye suna. Main bhi unme se ek tha.

Kursi.

 Hum chhat se jhaanke. Andar ek bujhta diya tha, aur ek aadmi kursi par baitha tha — kursi hil rahi thi, kyunki woh nouskha nahi, bas kursi ka ek pair adha toota hua tha. Aadmi purana chowkidar tha jo bungalow ke malik ke jaane ke baad bhi rehta tha.

 Unhone bataya ki unke malik ne unhe bachpan me yahan rakha tha, aur wahi unka ghar ban gaya. Ab woh 78 saal ke the aur wahi rehte the. Humne paanch din tak uski awaaz sun kar bhoot ki kahaniyan banai — aur us raat unki kursi ke pair par darr raha.

 Us raat ke baad humne unke liye kursi ka naya pair marammat karwa diya. Awaaz band ho gayi. Aur gaon ki bhoot ki kahaniyan bhi. Main aaj bhi sochta hoon — hum kitni aasaani se kisi ke ghar ko khaali bhookh ke naam par darr ki jagah bana dete hain.

v-warangal-mehndi.title: Mehndi ka raat ka khel
v-warangal-mehndi.text:
Nizamabad ke ek gaon me kahani thi: raat ko ek aurat aati hai, jo aapke haath par mehndi lagati hai. Mehndi lagwane ke baad haath kaaton wali baat kaafi heavy thi. Gaon ke tel mein bachche darr ke maare mehndi lagane se hichakte the.

Mehndi kahan lagi.

 Meri cousin ki shaadi thi. Raat ko mehndi lag rahi thi. Ek budhiya aayi, jise kisi ne bulaya tha — woh gaon ki mehndi lagane wali thi, aur unke haathon ki mehndi alag hi sooli thi. Ek bachche ne usse dar ke haath kheench liye.

 Baat yahi thi: “raat ki mehndi” wali kahani gaon ki us aurat ke khilaf thi. Woh vidhwa thi, akeli rehti thi, aur shaadi ke mausam me gaon ki auraton se zyada mehnat karti thi. Kahani ne uske haath ko darr bana diya, kyunki us aurat ko koi bulata to tha — par izzat nahi deta tha.

 Us shaadi me maine uske haath dekhe. Un par mehndi se zyada nishan the — sujan, dard, purani chot. Aaj gaon me koi usse mehndi nahi lagwata. Kahani jeet gayi, aur ek hunar-mand aurat bhookh ke liye taras gayi.

v-surat-dumas.title: Dumas ke kinare ki ret
v-surat-dumas.text:
Dumas beach ki kaali ret aur raat ka samundar — yahan laashon ki kahaniya purani hain. Kaha jaata tha ki raat ko wahan gaayab hone wale log kabhi nahi milte, aur unki aawaz paani me sunai deti hai.

Ek raat ki ginti.

 Main ek raat wahan tha. Tairne wale do ladke gayab ho gaye the. Gaon me kaha gaya ki unhe “samundar ki rani” le gayi. Do din baad unki laashein milee — lehar ne kinare par phenk diya.

 Asli baat ye thi ki unhe tairna nahi aata tha aur woh raat me chale gaye the. Samundar me raat ko dhara tez hoti hai; black sand me pair dhans jaata hai. Gaon ki kahani ne unhe “gaayab” kar diya, jabki woh abhi bhi wahan the — bas paani ke liye.

 Darr ki kahaniyan samundar ko ek shakti deti hain. Samundar ko koi shakti nahi chahiye — uske paas dhara, lehar aur andhera hai. Us raat ke baad maine kinare par ek board lagaya: “Raat me nahi.” Kisi ne use nahi padha. Phir bhi laga.

v-ahmedabad-pol.title: Pol ka purana makaan
v-ahmedabad-pol.text:
Ahmedabad ke purane pol me ghar ek jaisa dikhte hain: rangin, chhote, aur ek doosre se chipke hue. Ek makaan band tha. Padosi kehte the raat ko andar se chakki chalne ki awaaz aati hai, aur ek budhiya ka chehra khidki par dikhta hai.

Chakki.

 Main raat 2 baje utha. Awaaz aa rahi thi. Maine darwaza khatkhataya. Kisi ne nahi khola. Phir maine padosi ki chhat se dekha: andar ek chhoti roshni thi aur ek aurat chakki chala rahi thi.

 Woh aurat 82 saal ki thi, aur us makaan ki malik thi. Uska beta chhod ke chala gaya tha. Woh raat ko chakki chalati thi kyunki din me bijli nahi aati thi. Gaon ne use “bhoot” keh diya, aur asli baat ye thi ki uske makaan me bijli ka connection bhi nahi tha — woh andhere me kaam karti thi kyunki kisi ne uski madad nahi ki.

 Maine us raat unke liye ek torch rakhi. Agli subah unhone kaha ki unhone bilkul who nahi dekha. Phir bhi ek saal tak hum har raat wahi awaaz sunte rahe. Par ab koi nahi kehta ki woh bhoot hai — kehte hain, “budhiya ab tak kaam kar rahi hai.”

v-jaipur-brahmpuri.title: Brahmpuri ka kuaan
v-jaipur-brahmpuri.text:
Brahmpuri ke ek kuein par raat ko dhakna rehta tha. Bachche kehte the ki andar ek aadmi baithta hai jo paani maangta hai. Gaon ki baat pakki thi: use paani mat dena, warna woh tumhare saath chala aayega.

Paani.

 Main ek raat wahan gaya. Kuein se awaaz aa rahi thi. Maine paani ka lota rakha aur door khada ho gaya. Andar se ek haath nikla, lota liya, aur paani peel liya. Woh ek aadmi tha — din me kaam karne wala mazdoor, jo kuein ke paas sota tha, aur jise apna koi nahi tha.

 Gaon ki kahani usse bhoot banati thi. Asli baat sirf ye thi ki woh akela tha, aur kuein ke paas sota tha kyunki wahan hawa thi. Raat ko koi paani maange to gaon ka nikamma darr usse paani dene se rok deta tha.

 Us raat ke baad maine use apne ghar ke peerhe par sone diya aur usse rusuk utaar kar dekha ki woh asli tha. Aaj woh kisi aur sheher me kaam karta hai. Brahmpuri ka kuaan ab dhaka hua hai, par gaon ki kahani wahi hai. Kabhi kabhi sirf ek lota paani kaafi hota hai.

v-lucknow-kaiserbagh.title: Kaiserbagh ka banda
v-lucknow-kaiserbagh.text:
Kaiserbagh ke ek bade kamre me koi nahi jaata tha. Raat 2 baje usme pankha chalne ki awaaz aati thi, aur ek baar kisi ne wahan se “dhoop me mat jao” jaisi line suni. Us kamre par ek purana khauf tha jo vyapaari zyada bol rahe the.

CCTV ka sach.

 Ek kiraaydar ne wahan CCTV lagwai. Do raatein kuch nahi hua. Teesri raat, 2:40 baje, darwaza khula aur ek aadmi andar aaya. Woh chowkidaar tha jo garmi me wahan sota tha. Pankha woh chala deta tha. “Awaaz” uski sansein aur uthne ki khifin thi.

 Kamre ki asli kahani purani haveli ki malik thi: woh kisi zamaane me us kamre me rehti thi, aur uska koi waris nahi tha. Kiraaydar ne kamre ko lock kar diya tha, aur uska khauf bolne se chalne laga.

 Kahani khatam nahi hui — sirf badal gayi. Ab log kehte hain chowkidaar ko “wo” bulati hai, isliye woh raat 2 baje wahan jaata hai. Woh chowkidaar ke paas jawaab hai: “Wahan fan hai, aur mujhe bahut garmi lagti hai.” Kabhi kabhi sabse darawni sach sabse saada ho sakta hai.

v-bhopal-haveli.title: Shahjehanabad ki haveli
v-bhopal-haveli.text:
Shahjehanabad ki ek haveli me ek kursi thi jo darwaze ki taraf mud kar rakhi thi. Gaon kehte the ki uspar us ghar ki aakhri bahu baithti hai, jo kisi raat ko chali gayi thi aur wapas nahi aayi. Kursi ko kisi ne nahi chheda.

Kursi mudti kyun hai.

 Ek baar maine use mudaya. Raat ko ghar me kholi ki awaaz aayi. Subah kursi phir darwaze ki taraf thi. Main dar gaya. Phir pata chala ki haveli ka chowkidaar roz shaam us kursi ko wapas ghuma deta tha — kyunki uska apna yakeen tha ki aisa karne se ghar me sukoon rehta hai.

 Us bahu ki kahani sach thi: woh ek shaadi ke jhagde ke baad apne maayke chali gayi thi, aur do saal baad unki maut hui. Uske baad kisi ne unki kursi nahi hilayi. Ek kursi poora ghar bana gayi.

 Gaon me aise nishaan har ghar me hain — ek joota, ek thaali, ek kursi. Woh bhoot nahi hain, par woh kisi ki kami ka sabse saaf nishan hain. Unhe dekhte waqt “unke saath kya hua” poochhna, “wahan kya rehta hai” nahi.

v-chhatarpur-talaab.title: Talaab ki mitti
v-chhatarpur-talaab.text:
Chhatarpur ke ek gaon ka talaab teen saal me sookh gaya. Uske beech me ek chhota mandir nikla — aadha dhasa hua, jiske darwaze par patriyan ug aayi thin. Gaon kehte the ki usme se raat ko ghanti aur rone ki awaaz aati hai.

Ghanti.

 Maine wahan ja kar dekha. Mandir ke andar ek lakeer me ek ghanti latki thi, jo hawa se hil kar deewar se takrati thi. Bas. Rone ki awaaz wahan ke shrign ke beech se aati hawa thi.

 Par gaon ne mandir ko “bhoot ka mandir” kehna pasand kiya. Ek purana “murti ka darr” bhi tha — mandir me rakhhi murti pani me gir gayi thi, uski shakal kharab ho gayi thi. Us murti ko “bhoot” kehna aasan tha, use dobara sthapit karna nahi.

 Humne gaon ke logo se baat ki. Ek budhe ne kaha, “Hum to bas mandir ko bacha rahe the, kahin koi tod na de.” Unki kahani ek suraksha kavach thi. Aur unki baat sahi thi — uske baad wahan ASI ka board laga, aur mandir ko saaf kiya gaya. Bhoot gayab nahi hue; sirf logon ne kaam karna shuru kiya.

v-noida-plot.title: Sector ka khaali plot
v-noida-plot.text:
Noida ke ek sector me ek plot khaali pada tha. Uske chaaron taraf towers the. Plot par koi imarat nahi thi, sirf ek toota hua boundary wall aur kuch jhopadiyaan jinme koi nahi rehta tha. Raksah kehte the wahan raat ko ek mazdoor aur uski aurat dikhte hain.

Jhopdi.

 Main ek raat wahan gaya. Jhopdi me ek chulha tha, ek thaali, aur ek bachche ka joota. Bahar ek chipped si chadar thi. Main wapas aaya aur doosre din site ke record dekhe. Us plot par teen saal pehle ek accident hua tha — ek mazdoor gir kar mara, aur uska parivaar wahan hi reh gaya tha.

 Wo jhopdi khaali nahi thi. Us raat main wapas pahuncha to ek ladki thi jo apne bhai ke liye roti bana rahi thi. Unke papa ki maut ke baad unke paas rehne ki jagah nahi thi, isliye woh site par hi neend guzaarte the. Gaon ne unhe “bhoot” keh diya kyunki unhe dekhna asaan nahi tha.

 Us plot ka sach developer ke record me nahi hai. Woh ek khaali plot ke bhoot ki kahani nahi, ek safety ki kahani hai — kyunki mazdoor gir kar maare jaate hain aur unke parivar bina kisi cheez ke reh jaate hain. Kahani wahan bhoot ki nahi hai. Wahan ek darr ki nahi, ek hisaab ki zaroorat hai.

v-mumbai-chawl-teesra.title: Mumbai ke chawl ka teesra floor
v-mumbai-chawl-teesra.text:
Mumbai ke ek chawl me teesre floor ka ek kamra band tha. Us par lakdi pakki thi. Padosi kehte the raat ko andar se TV chalta hai, aur ek baar ek phool se sajaya hua ek chhota mandir bhi dikha. Bachche darr ke maare seedhi chadhne se kaat-te the.

TV.

 Wo kamra ek budhe ka tha, jo saat saal pehle mara tha. Uska koi nahi tha. Par TV ki awaaz sach thi. Ek raat main neela chamakta roshna dekha. Padosi ne bataya ki building ke kisi meter me leakage hai, aur uske kamre me ek purana connection chal raha tha.

 Jo darwaaze ke neeche se aati awaaz thi, wo building ke pipe ki thi. Ek baat aur nikli: us budhe ke kamre se lagta hua ek karza document ab bhi kisi ko chahiye tha. Woh padosi hi the, jo raat ko us kamre me jaate the aur TV chalate the — kyunki kamre me kuch cheez unhe chahiye thi.

 Uski koi maut nahi thi. Ek band kamre ne sabki zindagi me ek ajeeb sa darr bhar diya. Maine bas utna kiya jo ho sakta tha: building society se kamra kholwaya. Andar ek TV, ek bistar aur ek dher kapde the. Bhoot ki kahani khatam. Suru hui building ki property ki kahani.

v-kolkata-ghat.title: Ghat ka naav
v-kolkata-ghat.text:
North 24 Parganas ke ek ghat par raat ko ek khali naav bandhi milti thi. Koi use nahi chalaata tha. Gaon kehte the usme ek aadmi baithta hai jo 1971 ke baad apne malik ka intezaar karta hai — aur jo malik ab kabhi nahi aayega.

Naav par ek aurat.

 Maine ek raat wahan dekha ki naav me ek aurat baithi thi. Maine awaaz di. Woh uthe bina boli — “naav meri nahi hai.” Woh ek vidhwa thi jo paas ke ghat par soti thi. Us raat usse dar lag raha tha, kyunki uske pati ki naav bhi yahi thi, aur woh aaj tak wapas nahi aaya.

 Naav ka naukar koi nahi tha. Naav ek mazdoor ka tha jo tasheen chhod gaya. Ghat ka kahani ka “naukar” aur us aurat ka dukh ek hi tha — kisi ka laut ke na aana. Gaon ne dukh ko bhoot ka naam de diya, kyunki dukh ko jhelna mushkil tha aur use kahani me daal dena asaan.

 Us raat maine naav us aurat ke haath me de di. Unhone mujhe nahi chaha. Par subah unhone apne ghar ke liye do roti mangai thi. Main is site par jo bhi likhta hoon, woh sirf itna kehta hoon: kuch bhoot dukh se bane hote hain, aur unka ilaaj ek roti ho sakta hai.

v-chennai-hostel.title: Hostel ka aakhri kamra
v-chennai-hostel.text:
Chennai ke ek ladkiyon ke hostel me aakhri kamra hamesha khaali rehta tha. Warden kehti thin kuch nahi hua, par usme koi nahi rehna chahti thi. Raat ko wahan se paani ki tapak aur ek purana Tamil gaana sunai deta tha.

Woh gaana.

 Main us kamre me do raat rahi. Pehlip raat tapak suni. Doosri raat gaana bhi suna — ek radio, jo kisi ne chalu chhod diya tha. Kamre me ek purana window jis se tapak rahi thi. Aur gaane wala radio us kamre ki aakhri rehne wali ladki ka tha, jisne hostel chhod diya tha.

 Woh ladki padhai chhod kar gaon chali gayi thi. Uska naam gaon me chalta tha — “wo jo pagal ho gayi”. Kamre ka “bhoot” uski yaad thi, kisi aur cheez ka nahi. Usne 2 mahine kuch nahi khaya, sirf radio suna. Warden ko lagta tha kamre me problem hai, aur ladki ko nahi.

 Warden ne mujhe bataya ki woh ladki ab theek hai. Kya woh sach me theek hai? Nahi maloom. Par ek baat pata thi: hostel ka bhoot kaafi saal tak us ladki ka naam bacha raha — aur uske saath uski bimari ka naam bhi chhupa raha. Har jagah, har kahani me, wahi hota hai.

v-shimla-ridge.title: Ridge ka chadhta saaya
v-shimla-ridge.text:
Shimla ke Ridge par shaam ke 5:40 baje ek lamba saaya gaon ke raste par chalta dikhta hai. Log kehte hain woh ek angrez officer hai jo church ke paas hi mara tha. Saaya hamesha ek hi waqt par aata hai.

5:40.

 Main wahan do shaam khada raha. Pehli shaam kuch nahi. Doosri shaam saaya aaya — aur main samajh gaya ki woh ek post ke saaye ka hai jo church ki ghanti se hilti hai. Ghanti ke saath ek hawa ka jhonka aata hai, aur ek board ka saaya sadak par girta hai.

 “Angrez officer” wali baat us church ke register me hai — 1880s me ek officer ki maut hui thi, par unhe Shimla me dafnaya gaya, is sadak par nahi. Gaon ne do alag baatein jod di: ek purana angrez, aur ek roz aane wala saaya.

 Shimla jaise shehron me purani imaraton ka gudha hua hisaab hota hai. Wahan saaya, ghanti aur hawa sabse purane kirdaar hain. Unhe bhoot kehna aasan hai. Unhe samajhna zyada maza deta hai — aur yahi is site ka kaam hai.

v-ooty-fernhill.title: Fernhill ka piano
v-ooty-fernhill.text:
Ooty ke ek purane palace hotel me raat ko piano bajta tha. Manager kahte the staff baja raha hai, staff kahta tha manager. Guests kehte the ek madam ka bhoot hai jo apni beti ko dhoondhti hai. Do saal me hotel ki booking gir gayi.

Piano ke andar.

 Main wahan ek raat ruka. Piano ke paas ek purana harmonium tha, aur uske peeche ek khidki jo hawadar se takrati thi. Raat 1 baje piano bajana shuru hua — par awaaz ki taraf dekha to khidki ka kaanp raha tha, aur piano ke taar us hawa se goonj rahe the.

 Us hotel ka sach isse bhi zyada ajeeb tha. Ek purana staff member raat ko wahan aata tha aur hawa ki khidki band karta tha, par kabhi piano ke taar ko theek nahi karwaya. Kyunki piano ki kahani aaane wale guests ko kheenchti thi. Manager ne khud kaha: “Bhoot se booking aati hai.”

 “Madam ka bhoot” wali kahani bhi hotel ki brochure me thi, bina kisi source ke. Aaj wahan ek renovation hui, aur piano wahan ek concert ke liye theek kiya gaya. Awaaz bandh ho gayi. Booking wapas aayi — is baar sangeet se, bhoot se nahi.

v-udaipur-haveli-chowk.title: Haveli ke chowk ki khidki
v-udaipur-haveli-chowk.text:
Udaipur ki ek haveli ki teesri khidki peele parde se bandhi hui hai. Kaha jaata hai ki 1800s me ek dulhan wahan se jhaanki thi, aur us raat ke baad ek bhi khidki nahi khuli. Gaon wale kehte the woh dulhan raat ko wapas aati hai.

Peele parde.

 Main andar gaya — aaj wahan ek boutique hai. Teesri khidki ke peeche se ek kamra hai jisme kisi ki almari thi, ek purana palang, aur deewar par ek bada sa safed nishaan. Dukaandaar ne kaha ki khidki kabhi nahi khulti kyunki wahan se dhup se purani lakdi kharab ho jaati hai.

 “Dulhan” ki kahani mein ek hissa sach tha: us haveli ki ek bahu ki shaadi ke do mahine baad maut ho gayi thi, aur uske baad us kamre me koi nahi gaya. Par raat ko jhaankne wali koi nahi. Jo log “dulhan” dekhte the, unke hisaab se woh ek chhaya thi; asal mein woh ek chhota turist tha jo tasveer lene wahan chadha tha.

 Haveliyan apni kahaniyan sambhal ke rakhti hain. Unke parde bandh rehte hain kyunki unke logon ki yaadein bandh hain. Unhe kholne ka haq tour ke paas nahi hai. Jo khidki band hai, us par bhoot ka label chipkane se pehle, uske peeche ke ghar ke bare me sochiye.

v-jaisalmer-reet.title: Reet ka qila gaon
v-jaisalmer-reet.text:
Jaisalmer se door ek chhota gaon reet me dhansta ja raha tha. Har saal ek ghar khaali hota tha, aur log shehar chale jaate the. Jo bache the, unke paas ek kahani thi: raat ko gaon ke bahar ek aurat khadi rehti hai, aur jo usse baat karta hai, wo bhi chala jaata hai.

Woh aurat.

 Main ek raat wahan ruka. Bahar ek aurat khadi thi. Maine paas ja kar poocha. Woh bacchon ko dudh pilane wali thi, jo raat 9 baje tak har ghar jaati thi. Gaon me usse “wo” kehna asaan tha, kyunki woh akeli thi aur baahar khadi rehti thi.

 Gaon khaali hone ki asli wajah paani ki tanki thi — jo ab 6 mahine me ek baar bharti thi. Aur sabse pehle jaane wale wahi the jo mazdoori ke liye shehar gaye. Unke jaane ke baad khali ghar the, aur khali gharon ke beech ek akeli aurat — aur kahani.

 Us raat us aurat ne mujhe chai pilai. Unhone kaha ki gaon me koi bhoot nahi hai, par logon ko kahani chahiye. “Bhoot ki wajah se dariya nahi bharti, beta,” unhone kaha. “Tanki bharti hai to gaon bachta hai.” Wo ek line poore Rajasthan ke khaali gaon ki sach hai.

v-deoghar-baba.title: Baba ke dar ke peeche
v-deoghar-baba.text:
Deoghar ke ek purane math me raat ko ek awaaz aati thi — “andar aa jao.” Vahi awaaz jo mandir ke pujari bolte the, aur wahi unke baba ki. Pujari ne kaha ki woh awaaz unke guru ki hai, aur unhe naam se bulati hai.

Andar.

 Main andar gaya. Wahan ek chhota kamra tha jisme ek palang, ek ghadi, aur ek baba ki tasveer. Awaaz phir aayi. Main darr gaya. Phir pata chala ki awaaz kamre ke andar se nahi, wahan rakhe ek purane tape recorder se aa rahi thi, jo ek bhajan ka program record karta tha aur chhoot se bajta tha.

 Pujari ne kaha ki unke baba ne woh recorder wahan isliye chhoda tha ki unhe apni awaaz yaad rahe. Woh har raat tape chalu karte the, apni marzi se. Par gaon me “baba ki awaaz” ki kahani chali, aur log wahan aane lage — darr ke, aastha ke.

 Aaj us math me ek chhota sa satsang hota hai. Log kehte hain bhoot nahi hai, sirf baba ki awaaz hai. Maine pujari se kaha: “Aap ne sach bata diya.” Unhone has kar kaha, “Main darr nahi, yaad rakhna chahta tha.” Yahi farq hai.

v-purulia-kuaan.title: Purulia ka sookha kuaan
v-purulia-kuaan.text:
Purulia ke ek gaon ka kuaan saal bhar khaali rehta tha. Log kehte the usme se raat ko paani tapakne ki awaaz aati hai, aur ek aurat ka chehra bhi dikhta hai. Gaon ki auratein wahan se paani lena bandh kar chuki thin.

Kudai.

 Panchayat ne kudai karwai. 18 foot par ek pipe mila — purani pipeline ka toota hua hissa, jisme raat ko paani ki boondein girti thin. Awaaz wahi thi. Kuein ke andar ki deewar par ek purana nishaan tha, jise log chehra samajhte the.

 “Aurat ka chehra” wali baat us gaon ki ek aurat se judi thi, jo kai saal pehle wahan se paani late hue gir gayi thi. Wo sach tha. Par uske baad kuein ko band nahi kiya gaya, aur woh khula chhoda gaya — jahan bachche khelte the.

 Us din ke baad kuein ke kinare par ek chhota board laga: “Dhyan rahein”. Gaon ki auraton ne paani wapas lena shuru kiya. Bhoot nahi gaya — bas uski jagah ek toota pipe aur ek khula kuaan aa gaya, jise kisi ne 20 saal tak theek nahi kiya.

v-kanker-jhopdi.title: Kanker ki jhopdi
v-kanker-jhopdi.text:
Kanker ke jungle ke kinaare ek chhoti jhopdi thi. Jisme koi nahi rehta tha, par har subah chulha garam milta aur aangan me jhaadu ke nishaan. Gaon kehte the ki wahan ek bhoot raat ka khana banata hai.

Chulhe wali subah.

 Hum raat bhar ruke. 4 baje ek budha aadmi aaya. Usne lakdi rakhi, aag jalai, aur chai banai. Woh gaon ka hi tha — ek bhatka hua mazdoor jise ghar nahi mila tha, aur jo raat me wahan sota tha kyunki uske parivaar ne use chhod diya tha.

 “Bhoot ka chulha” ki kahani ne usse bachaya bhi aur chhupaya bhi. Bachaya isliye ki koi jhopdi todne nahi aaya. Chhupaya isliye ki kisi ne uski madad nahi ki — sab ne uske chulhe ko dekha, us aadmi ko nahi.

 Us subah humne uske saath chai pi. Usne kaha ki woh kisi ko darr nahi dena chahta, bas raat bitane ki jagah chahiye. Gaon ki kahani uske liye ek chhat ban gayi thi. Kabhi kabhi sabse achhi jagah woh hoti hai jise log bhoot ka ghar samajh kar chhod dete hain.

v-osmanabad-dargah.title: Dargah ke peeche ki pahadi
v-osmanabad-dargah.text:
Osmanabad ke paas ek pahadi par purani dargah hai. Raat ko wahan se ghode ki taa-pak sunai deti hai — kaha jaata hai ki woh ek peer hain jo aaj bhi apni pahadi ka chakkar lagate hain. Gaon ke log raat me wahan nahi jaate.

Taa-pak.

 Hum chowkidaar ke saath gaye. Raat 11 baje awaaz aayi. Woh has kar bole: “Dekh lo.” Hum seedhi utre, aur wahan ek ghoda khada tha — dargah ke mutawalli ka, jo usse roz wahan baandhta tha. Pathar par uske khaaron ki awaaz door tak jaati thi.

 “Peer ki sawari” wali baat purani hai aur gaon me bahut izzat se sunai jaati hai. Us raat maine kisi ki aastha par sawaal nahi uthaya. Maine sirf itna dekha ki ek jaanwar ki rozana ki aawaaz ne ek kahani ko zinda rakha hai.

 Wapas aate hue chowkidaar ne kaha: “Yahan log shraddha se aate hain, dar se nahi.” Aur yahi farq hai. Dargah ki raat ka kissa bhoot ka nahi, ek riwaaj ka hai. Us riwaaj ne ek pathar par bani imarat ko 300 saal tak sambhala hai.

v-karnal-nahar.title: Nahar kinare ki roshni
v-karnal-nahar.text:
Karnal ke paas nahar ke kinare raat ko ek roshni chalti dikhti thi. Log kehte the woh ek mazdoor ki aatma hai jo nahar me doob gaya tha, aur apna theka dhoondhta rehta hai. Bachche wahan nahi jaate the.

Roshni ka raasta.

 Humne do raat dekha. Pehli raat kuch nahi. Doosri raat roshni aayi — dheemi, chalti hui. Hum paas gaye. Woh ek budha aadmi tha, haath me torch, jo raat me kinare ka kachra uthata tha. Uska theka sach me tha — nagar nigam ka safai ka kaam, raat ki shift.

 “Doobne wala mazdoor” wali baat us nahar me sach me hui thi — 1990s me ek mazdoor doob kar mara, aur uska koi case darj nahi hua. Uske baad nahar ke kinare roshni ki kahani chali. Jo roshni main dekh raha tha woh ek aur mazdoor thi, jo usi jagah par kaam kar rahi thi.

 Us raat humne uske saath chai pi. Unhone kaha ki unhe nahar ka woh kissa yaad hai, aur woh usi din se kaam par jaate waqt apna naam likh kar jaate hain. “Kahani se darr nahi lagta. Lagta hai ki koi mera naam bhi nahi jaanta.” Bhoot ki kahani ne ek mazdoor ko yaad rakha, aur ek doosre ko bhula diya.

v-tirupati-pahadi.title: Pahadi ki seedhi
v-tirupati-pahadi.text:
Tirumala ki pahadiyon me ek purani seedhi hai, jo jungle me gum ho jaati hai. Log kehte hain wahan ek bhakta aaj bhi chadhta hai, aur uski ghanti sunai deti hai. Yatris us raaste ko chhod dete hain.

Ghanti.

 Ek local guide ne humein bataya ki us seedhi par koi nahi chadta kyunki woh jungle me kho jaati hai, aur uske aage girne ka khatra hai. Raat me wahan se ghanti ki awaaz aati hai — ek mandir ki ghanti, jo purane raaste par latki hui hai aur hawa se bajti hai.

 “Bhakta ka bhoot” wali kahani usi purane raaste ki yaad hai. Pahle yatris paidal aate the, aur kai log raste me mar jaate the — thand, bimari, thakan. Us seedhi men aaj bhi un logon ka nishaan nahi hai, par unki yaad gaon me hai.

 Yahan ka sabse bada sach ye hai: pahadi par raat me jaana khatarnaak hai, aur jungle me bhatakna asli khatra hai. Kahani us raaste se logon ko door rakhti hai — aur shayad yahi uski sabse achhi duty hai. Humne wahan chadne ki koshish nahi ki. Humne bas ghanti suni aur laut aaye.

v-bhuj-jheel.title: Bhuj ki jheel
v-bhuj-jheel.text:
Bhuj ke bahar ek jheel hai. Uske kinare ek khaali gaon hai, jo 2001 ke bhukamp ke baad chhoot gaya. Log kehte hain raat ko wahan ek aurat khadi rehti hai. Gaon wale ab bhi wahan nahi jaate.

Jheel ka kinara.

 Hum ek social worker ke saath gaye. Wahan ek aurat mili jo khaali ghar me rehti thi. Unhone bataya ki unhone apna poora parivaar bhukamp me khoya. Woh wahan isliye rehti thin kyunki unke ghar ki jagah unke logon ki yaad thi.

 “Aurat ka bhoot” wali kahani unke aas-paas bani. Gaon ke log unse darte the, unse baat nahi karte the, aur raat ko wahan nahi jaate the. Ek insaan ki majboori ko bhoot kehna asaan tha — aur usse unki madad nahi karni padi.

 Us raat unhone hamare liye chai banayi. Unke haath kaanp rahe the. Humne unse poochha ki woh wahan kyun rehti hain. Unhone kaha: “Yahan mujhe raste par unke joote dikhte hain.” Hum wahan sirf ek khaali ghar dekhne gaye the. Woh wahan apna dukh dekhne rehti thin.

a-ashwatthama.title: Ashwatthama ka shraap
a-ashwatthama.text:
Yudh khatam ho gaya tha. Pandav jeet gaye the, aur jeetne wale apne dero me so rahe the. Us raat Dronacharya ka beta Ashwatthama jungle me baitha tha, aur uske paas ek hi baat thi: mere pita ko dhokhe se mara gaya. Uska dukh ek astra ban gaya.

Raat ka yudh.

 Usne Shiv ka naam liya, aur ek astra chhoda. Kahani kehti hai ki woh astra unke apne sar par hi laga. Usne apne pita ka naam liya aur ek brahman ko mara — aur us brahman ki patni ka shraap uske peechhe aa gaya: teri maut bhi nahi hogi, tu sirf jiya karega.

 Mahabharat kehta hai ki uske sar se ek ratna nikal kar liya gaya, aur uska shraap yahi tha ki sadion tak woh ghaav aur dard ke saath jeevit rahega. Woh apne pita ke liye lad raha tha, aur usne apne hi haathon se sabse bada anyay kiya. Isi liye ye kahani itni bhaari hai — jo sabse zyada pyaar karta hai, wahi sabse zyada andha hota hai.

 Maine ise gaon ke ek buzurg se suna tha. Unhone aakhir mein kaha: “Beta, shraap kisi ne nahi diya. Woh apne aap ko us raat ke baad chhod nahi paaya.” Aur ye shayad sabse sach wali baat hai.

a-hidimba.title: Hidimba ki raat
a-hidimba.text:
Pandav van me so rahe the. Unke paas hathiyaar nahi the, sirf thakan thi. Us raat Hidimba naam ka ek rakshas unhe dekh kar apni behen Hidimbi ke paas gaya: wahan sote hue log hain, tu jaake unhe jagaa, main khaa loonga.

Do bhai, ek raat.

 Hidimbi gayi. Usne unhe dekha, aur usne unhe jagaaya nahi. Usne Bhima ko uthaya aur kaha — bhaag jao. Bhima nahi bhaaga. Us raat Hidimba aaya, aur dono bhaiyon ke beech yudh hua. Bhima ne use maara. Aur us rakshas ki behen ne unka haath pakad liya.

 Mahabharat yahan ajeeb ho jaata hai. Hidimbi ka Bhima se ek putra hua — Ghatotkacha — jo aage Kurukshetra me Pandavon ke liye lada. Jo raat ek daanav ki kahani se shuru hui thi, woh ek putra ki kahani ban gayi. Rakshas ko sirf rakshas samajhna kahani ko chhota kar dena hai.

 Mere ek dost ne ise padhkar kaha: “Yahan sabse zyada insaan Hidimbi hai.” Main usse sehmat hoon. Bhookh wale ghar me ek ladki thi jisne hunger wale bhai se zyada insaaf dikha diya. Ye sirf ek purani kahani nahi — ye aaj bhi ghar-gali me hoti hai.

a-baka.title: Bakasur ka bhoj
a-baka.text:
Ek gaon me rehna hi ek shart ke saath tha: har hafte ek niwala paas jaata tha — ek insaan, bhel ke saath, rakshas ke liye. Us hafte ek haath se doodh maangne wali maa ki baari thi. Uska beta chhota tha. Woh sirf apne bachche ke liye maafi maang rahi thi.

Ek aadmi khud chala.

 Bhima bhookhe panda ban kar gaya. Woh gaon ke un logon ke paas gaya jo rakshas se darte the, aur unhone use bhel diya. Woh rakshas ke paas gaya, aur wahan ek chhota bachcha mila jo apna bhel kha raha tha. Bhima ne use kaha: ghar ja, main bhookh noch loonga.

 Rakshas aaya. Uska bhoj khali tha. Bhima ne usse lada, usse maara, aur gaon ko us shraap se aazad kiya. Gaon ne use jaa kar dekha, aur us saal koi niwala nahi gaya. Yeh katha ek asli sawaal chhodti hai: gaon ne kisi ko bhejna band nahi kiya tha. Unne sirf ek badal chuna tha.

 Mujhe ye katha sunate hue ek budhi ne kaha: “Ye kissa kahta hai ki jo gaon apna darr bujhaane ke liye kisi ek ko bhejta hai, woh gaon nahi — woh bhediya hai.” Main ye line bhoolta nahi. Kahani purani hai, sawaal naya hai.

a-ghatotkacha.title: Ghatotkacha ka aakash
a-ghatotkacha.text:
Raat ka yudh tha. Kurukshetra me din ka pahaad banta tha, par raat sirf rakshason ki thi. Pandavon ki taraf Ghatotkacha lada — Bhima aur Hidimbi ka beta. Woh aakash me khada tha, badalon ko kheenchta tha, aur Kaurava sena ki neend chhin leta tha.

Ek astra, ek baat.

 Karna ke paas ek aisa astra tha jo usne Arjun ke liye rakha tha. Us raat Duryodhana ne zor diya: ye rakshas abhi mara jaana chahiye. Karna ne apna ek hi bacha hua astra chhod diya — Ghatotkacha par. Woh gira. Uska maut ka weight Pandavon ne Bheem ke haath par mehsoos kiya.

 Kahani kehti hai ki us raat Pandavon ne ek bhookhe rakshas ko bhejnay ki koshish nahi ki; unke paas ek rakshas beta tha jo unke liye lada. Kurukshetra me koi safed-pushpak nahi tha. Sab ghoomte hue dhuze, khoon aur khaas the.

 Is katha me mujhe sabse zyada ye lagta hai: Ghatotkacha ko sabne “rakshas” kaha, par kisi ne uska pita ban kar unka haath nahi thaama tha. Is site par hum in kahaniyon ko horror ki tarah padhte hain, par ye bhi yaad rakhiye — kabhi kabhi asli darr ye hota hai ki koi apne “hum” me nahi aata.

a-tataka.title: Tataka ka van
a-tataka.text:
Raasta ek hi tha, aur woh van se hoke jaata tha. Van ka naam Tataka van tha. Kaha jaata tha ki waha ek rakshasi rehti hai jo raaste ko band kar deti hai. Rishi Vishwamitra ne Ram se kaha: jao use hataa do. Ram chhote the. Unka haath abhi hai. Unhone pehli baar dekha ki hathiyaar uthana kaisa hota hai.

Katha ka peelu hissa.

 Ramayan kehta hai ki Tataka pehle ek yakshini thi — khubsurat, balwan — jo ek rakt-bili se shraapit hui aur rakshasi ban gayi. Ye kahani kehta hai ki bhoj aur shap ke baad insaan kaise badal jaata hai. Ram ne use mara, aur van me se raasta khula.

 Is prasang par sabse zyada sawaal khada hota hai: ek rakshasi ko maarna — kya ye jeev ki raksha tha, ya sirf raasta banana? Kahani koi jawab nahi deti. Woh bas itna batati hai ki raasta khula aur aage chalne wala bachcha bada ho gaya.

 Meri nani ise sunate hue ek baat jodti thi: “Van me koi raasta band karta hai, to pehle usse poochho woh kyun khada hai.” Ramayan me Ram ne poochha nahi. Hindavi kahani me poochh na ek bade sawaal ki shuruaat hai, jawab nahi.

a-kabandha.title: Kabandha ka muh
a-kabandha.text:
Dandak van me ek ajeeb si cheez padi thi. Uska sir aur pair dono ek jagah the, aur nahi — uske sir ke beech me bas ek naak, ek muh aur ek aankh jaise the. Us ki lambi bahein sab kuch apni taraf kheench leti thin. Uska naam Kabandha tha.

Uska naam kya tha.

 Ram aur Laxman ne uske saath lada. Usne unhe pakad kar kheench liya. Unhone socha nai — uski bahen kaat di. Woh gir gayi. Uske sir se ek aawaz aayi — main kabandh nahi hoon, main ek gandharva hoon, is sharir ke andar bandha hua hoon. Mujhe jalaiye. Mere naam se aapko raasta milega.

 Unhone jalaya. Kahani kehta hai ki woh dhuan se safed hokar aakash me chala gaya, aur unhe bataya ki Sugriva kahan milta hai. Ek bhookha, ganda, darawana jeev asal me ek shraapit aatma thi — aur uske mukti ek hi baat thi: kisi ne usse uska naam yaad karaya.

 Yahi hissa mujhe Ramayan ka sabse sach hua hissa lagta hai. Ganda dikhne wala har shakhs bura nahi hota. Kuch log sirf bhool jaate hain ki unka asli naam kya tha, aur ek awaj jo yaad karaye, unhe azaad kar deti hai.

a-shurpanakha.title: Shurpanakha ka badla
a-shurpanakha.text:
Panchavati me ek jhopdi thi. Ram, Sita aur Laxman wahan rehte the. Ek din Shurpanakha aayi — Ravan ki behen. Usne Ram ko dekha aur chaaha. Woh usse maangi. Ram ne inkaar nahi kiya; unhone mazaak me Laxman ki taraf bhej diya. Laxman ne Sita ki taraf bhej diya. Dono ne mazaak kiya, aur uska roop us raat ujar gaya.

Badle ka hisaab.

 Shurpanakha ne Ravan ke paas jaakar apne kate hue roop ki baat kahi. Ravan ne ek baat aur suni: Sita. Usne Sita ko chhina. Van me darr ka ek dohra pautaada bana — Ram ne Laxman se Sita ki raksha ko kaha, aur Laxman ne Sita ko akele chhod kar Ram ke paas jana pada, kyunki kisi ne nikala nahi tha.

 Kahani me sabse ajeeb baat ye hai: Shurpanakha ke kate roop se Ravan ka yudh shuru hua. Aur Ravan ka yudh uski galti se nahi, uski behen ke chot se shuru hua. Ram ka mazaak bhi ek anjaam bana. Kahani ka koi bhi kirdaar saaf-saaf sabse achha nahi hai.

 Hum aksar is katha ko sirf “asur ne kiya” ki tarah sunate hain. Par kahani jitna brahman ek insaan ka mazaak aage jaakar kitna bada khatra ban sakta hai, utna hi khatra dikhata hai. Isliye ise padhte hue main una kirdaaron se darta hoon jo apne mazaak ko mazaak hi samajhte hain.

a-raktabija.title: Raktabija ka boond
a-raktabija.text:
Yudh mein ek asur khada tha jiska naam Raktabija tha. Uski khaas baat ye thi: uska ek boond khoon zameen par girta, aur usse wahi shakal ka doosra asur khada ho jaata. Jitna maaro, utna badhta. Devi ne dekha ki talwar se ye yudh khatam nahi hoga.

Kali ka roop.

 Devi Mahatmya kehta hai ki Devi ne apna ek roop liya — Kali ka. Uski zubaan lambi thi, aankhein laal. Woh Raktabija ko is tarah maarti gayi ki uska khoon zameen par girne se pehle hi pid gayi. Woh ek boond bhi zameen par nahi giri. Raktabija mara.

 Yeh kahani horror ki sabse purani structure hai — ek dushman jo maara nahi jaata, sirf uske ek pattern ko todna padta hai. Aaj ki filmon me wahi hota hai: jad se kaato, boond se nahi. Devi ne pattern tod diya, kul nahi.

 Gaon me is katha ko roop mein gaate hain: ek lambi zubaan, ek bhayankar chehra, aur neeche zameen par laal rang. Bachche darte hain. Buzurg kehte hain — ye maa ka roop hai. Ek maa apne bachche ko bachane ke liye bhayankar ho sakti hai. Darr aur raksha ek hi shakal me ho sakte hain, aur yahi devi kathaaon ka sabse bada sach hai.

a-mahishasura.title: Mahishasura ka bhainsa
a-mahishasura.text:
Mahishasura ke paas var tha: koi bhi purush usse nahi maar sakta. Woh bhainsa ban jaata, insaan ban jaata, aur jab bhi marne ke kareeb aata, bhainsa ban jaata. Devta har yudh har gaye. Mandiron me ghantiyaan shuru ho gayi — aur uske baad ek aawaz aayi jo unhone kabhi nahi suni.

Mandir ke dwar par.

 Devi ki katha kehti hai ki Brahma, Vishnu aur Mahesh ke tejas se ek aandhi uthi, jo ek aurat ke roop me khadi ho gayi. Uske das haath, ek sinha, aur ek aisi shakal jise dekhkar asur ki sena ke kuch log hi bhaag gaye. Woh dwar par khadi thi, aur usne kaha: Main hoon.

 Yudh nau din chala. Kahani kehta hai ki aakhri din Mahishasura bhainsa ban kar aaya, Devi ne usse patak diya, aur uske baad ek insaan ke roop me aaya — Devi ne uska sir kaat diya. Aaj Durga Puja ka nau-raat usi yudh ka hain, aur Dashami me Doorga pratima visharjit hoti hai.

 Meri dadi ise sunate hue kehti thi: “Bhaiyya, bhainsa nahi, sabse bada dushman hamesha woh hota hai jise koi maar nahi sakta.” Yahan Devi ek aurat thi, jo us var ko todi jise koi purush nahi tod sakta tha.

a-bhasmasur.title: Bhasmasur ka haath
a-bhasmasur.text:
Bhasmasur ne tapasya ki. Shiv prasann hue. Usne kaha — aisa var do ki main jise chhoo kar bhasm kar sakoon. Shiv ne var diya. Usi pal Bhasmasur ne haath uthaya aur Shiv ki taraf chal diya. Jis devta ne diya, wahi bhaga.

Mohini ka naach.

 Shiv ne Vishnu ko pukara. Vishnu ne Mohini ka roop liya — ek itni sundar aurat ki Bhasmasur thithak gaya. Usne kaha meri baat maan lo, main tumse shaadi karungi. Bhasmasur ne kaha jo kaho. Mohini ne kaha: mere jaise naach ke dikhao.

 Bhasmasur naachanesa laga. Uske haath sar par gaye. Woh apne hi haath se bhasm hua. Ye purani kahani ek bilkul modern sawaal chhodti hai: var kisi ki tapasya se milta hai, samajh se nahi. Bhasmasur ke paas taqat thi, par dimaag me nahi tha ki us taqat ko kis par lagayega.

 Gaon me is kahani ka ek chhota version chalta hai: “Jise sabse zyada taqat mile, usse sabse zyada poochh lo ki tum kis par use karoge.” Bhasmasur ne kisi se nahi poochha. Woh do minute me bhasm ho gaya. Purani kahaniyan aksar bilkul theek hote hain.

a-narasimha.title: Narasimha ki sandhya
a-narasimha.text:
Hiranyakashipu ko var mila tha: na din me maro, na raat me; na ghar me, na bahar; na insaan se, na kisi jaanwar se. Usne sabko kaabu me kar liya — apne hi bete Prahlad se nafrat ki kyunki woh Vishnu ko pujaata tha.

Sandhya ka waqt.

 Woh apne bete ko maara. Prahlad ne kaha Vishnu hum hain. Usne ek khambhe mein mazaak se maara — zara to dikha, is khambhe me Vishnu. Khambha phat gaya, aur usme se kuch nikla jo insaan nahi, jaanwar nahi. Ek sher jaisa, ek insaan jaisa.

 Woh samay itna sahi tha ki var lagu na ho — din nahi, raat nahi, sandhya. Jagah itni ajeeb thi ki var lagu na ho — dehleez, ghar nahi, bahar nahi. Woh usse dehleez par rakha, apne godh me, nakhunon se. Kaid ho — var ka. Isliye Prahlad ke Prahlad rehne ko wo katha aaj bhi gaate hain.

 Kahani ka sabse darawna hissa devta nahi hai. Woh ek pita hai jo apne bachche ko marne chala tha, kyunki bachcha apne Vishnu ko nahi chhod raha tha. Darr yahin se aata hai — pyaar aur haq ka jakadna.

a-yakshiprashna.title: Kuein ke paas woh aawaz
a-yakshiprashna.text:
Van me pandav rehte the. Pyaas lagi thi. Ek kuein dikha. Ek ne paani lene ki koshish ki, aur kuein se ek aawaz aayi — ruko, pehle jawaab do. Usne jawaab nahi diya. Woh gir gaya. Doosre bhi gaye. Wahi.

Sawaal poochhne wala.

 Yudhishthir aaye. Unhone dekha ki bhai jame hue hain. Unhone hathiyar rakha, aur aawaz se baat ki. Aawaz puchhi — kon sabse bada? Yudhishthir ne uttar diya. Aisa 40 sawaal hua. Har jawaab me unke bhaiyan ki saans laut aayi.

 Us aawaz ka naam Yaksha tha, jo asal me Dharamraj the — unke pita. Unhone apne bete ko sirf ek paani se roka tha, taki woh bina sochh samjhe kuch na kare. Kahani kehti hai ki sabse bada astra jawab hai.

 In kahaniyon me darr sirf bhoot ka nahi hota. Ek awaaz, ek sawaal, ek faisla — ye sabse zyada darawna combination hai. Woh kuein, jis par paani hai, koi rakshas nahi tha. Wahan sirf ek baap ki awaaz thi jo poochh rahi thi: sochkar chal raha hai na?

a-vetala-pratham.title: Vetala ka pehla sawaal
a-vetala-pratham.text:
Vetala ne apna pehla sawaal poochha. Ek raja ne ek rakshas ko maarne ke liye jangal me jalaaya, aur woh rakshas ne uski baat maani. Us rakshas ne kaha: ek baat suno. Raja ne kaha: suna do. Aur raja ne apni shart bhooli — jo jawaab dega, woh phaans jaayega.

Katha aur shart.

 Kahani me ek brahman tha jiske ghar me ek chor aaya. Brahman ne chor ko pakad liya. Chor ne kaha mujhe chhod do. Brahman ne use chhoda. Us raat chor ne brahman ka gala kaat diya. Agli subah woh brahman mara hua mila. Raja ka pradhan bada hua. Aur usne nirnay sunaya.

 Vetala ne poochha — brahman sahi tha? Chaudhary ne kaha: brahman galat tha, kyunki usne chor ko chhoda. Vetala ne kaha: jawaab theek hai. Laash uda gayi. Raja ko phir wapas jaana pada.

 Aur yahi is katha ki sazа hai. Raja ko galat jawaab dene se nahi, sahi jawaab dene se sazaa milti hai. Aaj bhi aisa hi hota hai — jab aap sach bolte hain aur mazaak khatam ho jaata hai, log aapse naaraaz hote hain. Vetala ka darr ye nahi ki woh laash hai. Darr ye hai ki woh aapki zubaan ko aapke haath se alag kar deta hai.

a-sinhasan.title: Sinhasan ki 32 putliyan
a-sinhasan.text:
Raja Bhoj ko ek purana singhasan mila. Us par 32 murtiyan thin — sundar, patthar ki. Jab woh baithne gaya, ek murti ne kaha: ruko. Main tumhe ek katha sunati hoon, phir batao ki tum is singhasan ke layak ho?

32 kathayein.

 Har murti ek katha sunati thi — ek raja, ek daan, ek nyay, ek shart. Har katha ke baad sawaal wahi: kya tum Vikramaditya jaisa ho? Bhoj har katha sunte, jawab dete, aur phir baithne se ruk jaate. Aakhir me 32 kathayein khatam hui, aur murtiyan chali gayi. Singhasan khaali reh gaya.

 Yeh kahaniyan aaj bhi Rajasthan, Gujarat aur Bundelkhand me gaayi jaati hain. Main jab bhi sunta hoon, mujhe lagta hai ki ye singhasan sirf ek aasan nahi hai — ye ek prashn-patra hai. Kissi bhi kursi par baithne se pehle 32 sawaal hone chahiye. Aaj ke samay me kaun 32 sawaal se guzarta hai?

 Bachpan me mujhe ye katha lambi lagti thi. Ab lagta hai ki woh sabse zyada imaandar horror hai — kyunki ismein koi bhoot nahi, koi raat nahi. Sirf 32 sawaal hain jinse bachna nahi tha. Aur woh 32 sawaal raja ke liye nahi the. Woh sunne wale ke liye the.

a-pishach-katha.title: Pishach ka bhoj
a-pishach-katha.text:
Kathasaritsagara me ek brahman shmashan se guzra. Wahan ek pishach baitha tha. Usne kaha — main bhookha hoon. Brahman ne poocha: tum khaate kya ho? Pishach ne kaha: main sirf woh khaata hoon jo marne se pehle kisi ka haq chhin chuka ho.

Katha ki shart.

 Us raat brahman ko ek gaon jaana tha. Us gaon me ek seth apni behen ki zameen hadap raha tha. Brahman wahan pahunche, raat me seth ke ghar ke paas se nikle — aur kuch der baad pishach ne kaha: aaj main bhookha hi rahunga.

 Kahani kehta hai ki brahman ne seth se zameen wapas dilwai, aur pishach ka bhoj bandh ho gaya. Ye theek wahi kahani hai jo aaj bhi gaon me chalti hai — bhoot ka bhoj zameen ke jhagde se juda hua. Pishach wahan sirf ek khaali pet nahi tha. Woh ek hisaab tha.

 Somadeva ki kahaniyan 11th sadi ki hain, par unmein aaj ka hisaab hai. Maine ise padhte hue socha: agar har anyay se ek pishach banta ho, to hamare gaon me kitne pishach honge? Aur un sab ko khaana khilaane ka ek hi tareeka hai — hisaab dena.

a-chausath.title: Chausath Yogini ka mandir
a-chausath.text:
Mitauli ke jungle me ek khula mandir hai. Chhat nahi hai. Chaaron or 64 chhote-chhote kaksh hain, aur unme deviyan thin. Ek kaksh hamesha khaali hai. Gaon kehta hai wahan ek yogini ab bhi baithti hai, isliye us jagah par koi ghaas nahi ugti.

Khaali kaksh.

 Main wahan do baar gaya. Doosri baar maine dekha ki us kaksh me koi nahi, bas ek patthar ki chabootara hai. Chhat nahi hone ka karan simple hai: mandir ki deewarein hi khaari chhat ka kaam karti hain, aur asli chhat kabhi bani hi nahi ya Sikh aakraman me gir gayi.

 “Khaali kaksh” ki kahani us jagah ke ek asli fact se aati hai — maurtiyan aaj kahan hain, koi nahi janta. Unme se kuch museum me hain, kuch nahi hain. Jab koi cheez kho jaati hai, to uski jagah ka khali aasra kahani bana jaata hai.

 Chausath Yogini parampara purani hai — 9th-sadi ke mandir, tantra aur yogini upasana se jude. Gaon ki os ki kahani aur mandir ki khali jagaho me kahaniyan bhar deti hain. Par yahan ka sabse bada sach yahi hai: ye imarat bachane layak hai, aur usse pehle use bhoot ki kahani ban jaana padega.

a-ellora.title: Ellora ka andhera
a-ellora.text:
Ellora ki gufaon me ek chhoti gufa bibhit hai jahan bijli nahi hai. Andar jate hi hawa tham jaati hai. Ek baar main wahan akela gaya, aur 10 minute baad mujhe laga ki koi kone me khada hai. Main bahar bhaga.

Gufa ka sach.

 Bahar ek guard baitha tha. Unhone has kar kaha: “Sir, har dusra banda bhaagta hai.” Wajah: andar ka temperature bahar se 8-10 degree kam hota hai, hawa ka rukh nahi hota, aur aapki hi saans ki awaaz wapas lautti hai. Hamare kaan usse doosre ke pair samajhte hain.

 Ellora me 100 se zyada gufayen hain, 600 se 1000 CE ke beech ki. Unme se ek bhi “bhoot ki gufa” nahi hai — sabhi bujhaye hue patharon ki sadiyon ki mahak aur hawa ka khel hain. Par har saal koi na koi wahan darr ke chakkar me chot khaata hai.

 Us din ke baad main usi gufa me dobara gaya. Andar ek dher pathar par baitha, aankh band ki, aur 3 minute lagatar suna. Achha laga. Jo awaz aap sun rahe hain, wo aapki hai. Ye sabse pehli cheez hai jo main har bhoot ki jagah par karta hoon — apni sansein ginta hoon.

a-ajanta.title: Ajanta ka band darwaza
a-ajanta.text:
Ajanta ki kai gufayen aaj band hain. Unme se ek ke darwaze par ek chhota sa lock hai, jo abhi bhi chamakta hai. Guide ne kaha: “Andar kuch nahi hai.” Maine poocha kya hai to unke bataya — 1950s me wahan se murtiyan nikali gayin, aur kuch kamre dhans gaye.

Andar kya tha.

 Main us guide ke saath raat tak ruka — woh Ajanta ke gaon ka tha. Usne bataya ki unke dada ke zamane me ek gufa me dhuan bhar gaya tha, kyunki kisi ne raat wahan chulha jalaya. Baad me wahan kaam bandh kar diya gaya. Kahani me raakh aur aawaz dono aa gaye.

 Ajanta me sadiyon tak bhikshu rehte the. Unke baad kuch bhi nahi raha — bas deewarein, chitra aur unke bante hue dhuen ke nishaan. Jab log un chitra ke saamne jaate hain, to unhe lagta hai ki koi dekh raha hai. Sach yahi hai: koi dekh hi raha hai — 1500 saal purane chitra, jo apne rang me aaj bhi khade hain.

 Aur wo band darwaza? Woh ASI ne band kiya tha, kyunki andar chhat giri hui thi. Jo cheez band hai, uske bare me kahaniyan aasaani se ban jaati hain. Par us darwaze ke peeche koi bhoot nahi — sirf kaam, mitti aur kisi ki thakan hai.

a-konark.title: Konark ka toota patthar
a-konark.text:
Konark ke mandir ka ek hissa gir gaya. Baaki khada hai, par uske andar kuch andhera hai jise log mehsoos karte hain. Kaha jaata hai ki kaal diye gaye nirmaan shilpi ne poori raat kaam kiya tha, aur jab mandir ka patthar nahi utar paaya, to unhone apni jaan de di.

Chaka aur suraj.

 Maine wahan ka chaka dekha — chhote-chhote jharokon me, ek chakra jiski har kiran me ek insaan hai. Jo patthar itna saaf tarasha gaya hai, us par us shilpi ke haath ka nishaan hai. Woh patthar kis kaam se bacha tha, kisi ko nahi maloom.

 “Konark ka bhoot” wali kahani usi toote patthar se banti hai. Asli baat ye hai ki mandir ka kuch hissa 600 saal pehle gir gaya, aur ASI ne use bacha liya. Jo log us toote patthar par khade hokar darr ki kahaniyan sunaate hain, unhe shilpi ki mehnat ki kahani sunani chahiye.

 Maine us raat socha: bhooot ki kahaniyan aksar toote hue kaam ke around banti hain. Magar jo cheez kaafi bhaari ho, woh khud hi darr aur shraddha dono bana deti hai. Konark me mujhe koi aatma nahi dikhi. Mujhe chhote patharon par khade log dikhe — aur unki thakan ka puraana hisaab.

a-mahabalipuram.title: Mahabalipuram ki paani me imarat
a-mahabalipuram.text:
Mahabalipuram ke kinare samundar ke paas ek mandir aadha doob kar khada hai. Gaon kehte the ki us shehar me ek doosra shehar paani ke andar hai, jise kisi ne nahi dekha. Phir 2004 ki tsunami ne lehar ko pichhe hataya, aur ek minute ke liye kuch patthar dikhe.

Lehar ke baad.
