 Us din gaon ke log samundar tak bhag gaye. Unhone chhote se patharon ki deewarein dekhi — ek mandir ka base, aur kuch chhote gopuram jaise dhanche. Lehar laut aayi aur sab wapas doob gaya. Ek puratan mandir jo paani me tha, woh asli tha.

 Pallava zamaane me Mahabalipuram ek port tha. Samundar 1300 saal me unchi ho gaya, aur kai imarat doob gayi. “Paani me shehar” wali kahani ek dam invention nahi thi. Iske alaawa vahin ke ASI/archaeology survey ne paani ke neeche dhanche darj kiye hain.

 Gaon wale ab bhi kehte hain ki tsunаmi wale din “purana Mahabalipuram” ek baar dikha tha. Main us par viswas kar sakta hoon, kyunki sach abhi bhi paani ke andar hai. Ye bhoot ki kahani nahi — ek doobi hui zameen ki kahani hai, aur ek samundar ka hisaab.

a-hampi.title: Hampi ki kali chhat
a-hampi.text:
Hampi me aaj bas patthar hain. Mandir, baazaar, kamal ka sarovar. Sulah ka ek hi sach hai: 1565 me vijayanagar sena har gayi, shehar tabah hua, aur log kabhi lauta hi nahi. Us raat ko wahan kisi ne paayal ki aawaz suni.

Aawaz ka rukh.

 Main Tungabhadra ke kinare baitha tha. Aawaz aayi — malhaar ki ghantiyaan, dholak. Main chal kar bhitar gaya. Kuch nahi. Phir ek gate ke paas mera torch kisi patthar par gira, aur ek chhoti aawaz aayi — bandar. Hampi me hazaaron bandar hain, aur unke pair patharon par aise ghoomte hain jaise ghungroo.

 “Sulah ka bhoot” kahani Hampi ke veeran bazaar se aati hai. Par asli baat ye hai ki Hampi ka vinaash ek shraap nahi tha — ek yudh tha. Us shehar me kaam, vyapaar, mithai aur bhaasha thi. Un sab ki yaad patthar me hai.

 Raat ko wahan sabse bada aap ka saaya hota hai. Main ek baar apni hi chhaya dekh kar ruk gaya. Us raat ke baad main bhtt se zyada us shehar ke logon ke bare me sochta raha, jinhone 1565 me apne ghar chhore the. Unke paas shraap nahi tha. Unke paas sirf ek raat thi.

a-sanchi.title: Sanchi ka stoop
a-sanchi.text:
Sanchi ka stoop 2,300 saal purana hai. Uske charon or chhoti chhatriyan hain, aur ek seedhi jo andar jaati hai. Raat ko wahan ek bhikshu khada dikhta hai — kaha jaata hai woh us stoop ka rakhwala hai. Ek raat humne seedhi par chad kar dekha.

Stoop ke andar.

 Andar kuch nahi tha. Ek pathar ka dhancha, hawa, aur ek chhoti roshni. Wo roshni ASI ke chowkidaar ki torch thi. Unhone humein seedhi se utaara aur daanta. Uske baad unke bhookh se baten ki — unhone bataya ki unke pita bhi yahan chowkidaar the.

 Stoop ke bare me shraap ki koi kahani nahi hai. Jo picture “bhikshu ki chhaya” ki hai, woh Sanchi ke ek chhote se mandir ke pujari ki hai, jo raat ko diya jala kar jata hai. Log use usi roshni me dekhte hain, aur kahani ban jaati hai.

 Sanchi ki asli shakti ok hai. Wahan 2,300 saal se log aate hain, aur kisi ne kuch nahi dekha jo proof ban sake. Par us ek stoop ke andar jaana mana hai kyunki usme hawa nahi hai. Kahani ko mana karna itna asaan hai. Isliye ab bhi wahan “bhoot” kehti hai — board par likha hai: andar mat jaiye.

a-chitrakoot.title: Chitrakoot ka vanvaas
a-chitrakoot.text:
Chitrakoot me Ram ka vanvaas tha. Mandakini behti thi, ped the, aur zindagi saadi thi. Sita ek din ek pipal ke neeche gayi. Us ped ke neeche ek aurat khadi thi, jise kisi ne nahi dekha tha — us ne Sita ko kaha: tum rajkumari ho, tum yahan kyun ho?

Us aurat ka naam.

 Ramayan me aisi koi aurat nahi hai. Par Chitrakoot ki lok-katha me hai — ek van-devi, jo har vanvaasi se poochhti hai ki woh ghar kyun chhod kar aaya. Sita ne kaha: main apne pati ke saath hoon. Devi ne kaha: phir tumhara ghar tumhare saath hai.

 Maine ye katha Chitrakoot ki ek budhi se suni. Unhone kaha ki woh devi “bharat ki har aurat” hai jo ghar chhod kar aayi. Aur us katha me Ramayan ka sabse bada sach hai — vanvaas mein sabse zyada dukh Sita ka tha, aur use koi pucchta bhi nahi tha.

 Ramayan ek dharm-granth hai, par woh ek ghar ki kahani bhi hai. Jab aap Chitrakoot jaayein, aur wahan ki hawa dekh kar “bhoot” ki baat karein — ek baar us aurat ke bare me bhi sochiye jise apna ghar chhodna pada tha. Uska dukh kisi shraap se kam nahi tha.

a-shmashan-kali.title: Shmashan Kali
a-shmashan-kali.text:
Tantra sahitya me shmashan ka ek alag sthan hai. Wahan Kali ki upasana hoti hai — raat me, diye ke saath, aur ek aisi dhyan-avastha me jisme darr apne aap girr jaata hai. Gaon wale ise “kali maa ka basera” kehte hain. Raat me wahan diya dikhta hai.

Diya aur aadmi.

 Meri bua ke gaon ke shmashan me ek aadmi raat ko diya jalata tha. Gaon ke log use “pagal” kehte the. Unhone kisi ko kuch nahi bataya. Wo sadhak the — ek parampara ke, jisme shmashan-sadhana hoti hai. Wo wahan dhyan karte the, aankh band, aur ghar laut jaate the.

 Yeh kaam karna aasan nahi hai. Shmashan me raat ka mahaul, jaanvar, aur akelapan — sabse bada dushman andar ka darr hota hai, bahar ka nahi. Unhone mujhse kaha: “Jo yahan darr ke aata hai, woh darr ke hi chala jaata hai.”

 Is file me koi vidhi nahi hai, aur jaan-boojh kar nahi hai. Tantra sahitya ka samajhna aur uski nakal karna do bilkul alag baatein hain. Jo mujhe samajh aaya, woh ye: unki raat ki sadhana ka sabse bada hissa discipline tha — roz, ek hi waqt, bina kisi ko dikhaye. Darr wahan sirf ek aadat thi jise unhe chhodna tha. Humein bhi wahi chhodna hai.

a-bhootgana.title: Bhoot gana ki baraat
a-bhootgana.text:
Purano me Shiv ke saath ek poora gana chalta hai — bhoot, pishach, pret, gana, aur unke sardar. Unhe dekh kar devta bhi raste chhod dete hain. Unki baraat raat me nikalti hai, shmashan se guzarti hai, aur jahan se guzarti hai wahan ka mahaul badal jaata hai.

Baraat ka raasta.

 Ek gaon me aaj bhi kehte hain: raat ko agar shor, dhol aur kisi anjaan baraat ki awaaz aaye, to raaste se hat jao. Maine ek baar woh kiya — raat 11 baje, gaon ki gali me dhol aur shor. Main ek deewar se chipak gaya.

 Woh shiv ki baraat nahi thi. Ek shaadi ki baraat thi jo raat me gaon se guzar rahi thi, aur usme nashe me log the. Par gaon ki baat galat bhi nahi thi — us baraat se rasta chhodna sahi tha. Woh log nashe me the, unke haath me lathi thi, aur raat me kisi bhi baraat se door rehna samajhdari hai.

 Purano ki baraat aur gaon ki baraat me ek hi niyam hai: jo raat me kisi ke raaste par aaye, usse dur hat jao. In dono me bhoot ho ya na ho, khatra asli hota hai. Shiv ke gana ki kahaniyan sunne me achhi hain. Gaon ke raaste par wo niyam kaam ka hai.

a-kal-bhairav.title: Kal Bhairav ka kutta
a-kal-bhairav.text:
Kal Bhairav ke mandir ke bahar ek kutta hota hai — pathar ka, ya asli. Kaha jaata hai woh Kashipur ka rakhwala hai, aur raat me woh kisi ko andar nahi jaane deta. Ek mandir me raat ko kutte ke rone ki awaaz aati thi.

Rone wala kutta.

 Wo asli kutta tha. Mandir ke pujari use khilate the, aur woh raat me bhaukte hue mandir ke peechhe chala jaata tha. Pujari kehte the ki “wo kisi cheez ko dekh raha hai”. Par ek raat unhone bataya ki woh kutta ek hi jagah par bhauka — jahan mandir ke pusht ki chhat kamzor thi.

 Kal Bhairav ki kahaniyan raksha ki hain. Mandir ke kutton ko log dar ka naam dete hain, par woh mandir ke sabse bade rakhwale hain — kyunki woh chor, saanp aur andhere ko pehle pehchaan lete hain. Unki awaaz bhayanak lagti hai, par kaam raksha ka hai.

 Maine us raat pujari ke saath baith kar mandir ki chhat dekhi. Agli subah ek pathar gir gaya. Kisi ko chot nahi lagi. Dar ki baat ye hai ki us raat jo bhaunk raha tha, woh kisi bhoot ko nahi dekh raha tha — woh ek dhili chhat ko dekh raha tha. Zyaadatar jagahon par, mandir ka kutta sach me bhoot pakadta hai.

a-jarasandha.title: Jarasandha ka ghar
a-jarasandha.text:
Magadha ka raja Jarasandha. Uski sena itni badi thi ki Krishna ne usse seedha yudh nahi kiya. Kahani kehti hai ki uski maut do tukdon se judi thi — kyunki uska jeevan do tukdon se jud kar bana tha. Uske jeevan ka poora dhancha ek shraap tha.

Do tukde.

 Kahani kahta hai ki uske pita ne uske do tukde jungle me phenk diye the. Ek rakshasi ne unhe ek saath rakha, aur woh jeeta. Uska naam Jarasandha pada. Uski maut ka tareeka bhi wahi tha: uske shareer ke do tukde door rakhe jaayein.

 Krishna ne Bhima se kaha ki usse malla-yudh me charhna hai — aur jab woh mara jaaye to uske shareer ke do tukdon ko aamne-saamne nahi rakhna. Woh isliye nahi ki unhe shraap ka mazaak karna tha. Unhe pata tha ki uski jaan kaise bandhi hui hai.

 Is kahani me mujhe sabse ajeeb lagta hai ki ek raja ki taqat itni thi ki Krishna ne use seedha nahi maara. Ek shraap ka dhancha uski sena se bhi bada tha. Aaj bhi log apni taqat par bharosa karte hain, aur us chhoti si jagah ko bhool jaate hain jahan unka dhancha bandha hua hai.

a-gandhari.title: Gandhari ki aankhein
a-gandhari.text:
Gandhari ne apni aankhein bandhi hui thin — shaadi ke din se, kyunki unke pati Dhritarashtra andhe the. Usne 100 bete paaye. Yudh mein woh sab mare. Jab unhe bataya gaya, unhone aankhein kholi — aur us pal se pehle unhone Kurukshetra ko bina dekhe hi ek shraap de diya.

Shraap ka waqt.

 Krishna unke paas aaye. Gandhari ne kaha: agar maine tumhe roka hota, to kya yudh nahi hota? Krishna ne kuch nahi kaha. Gandhari ne kaha: jis tarah mere bete mare, usi tarah tera kul bhi marega — 36 saal baad.

 Mahabharat kehta hai ki woh shraap poora hua. Dwarka ka vinaash hua, aur Yadav kul khatam ho gaya. Kahani ka darr ye hai ki ek aurat ne sirf aankhein khol kar itna bada shraap diya tha. Uski aankhon me ek bhi aansu nahi tha, kyunki usne saalon se aankh band ki hui thi.

 Mere liye ye Mahabharat ka sabse bhayanak hissa hai. Koi rakshas nahi, koi bhoot nahi. Ek maa thi, 100 laashein, aur ek aisa shraap jo apne hi ghar ko ukhaad dega. Darr aksar sabse shant logon se aata hai — kyunki jab woh chup rehte hain, to sab kuch andar hi jalta rehta hai.

c-lambi-dehar.title: Lambi Dehar mines
c-lambi-dehar.text:
Mussoorie se Lambi Dehar jaane wala raasta chuna-patthar ke dher ke beech se jaata hai. Yahan 1960s tak khaanein chalti thin. Phir ek din kaam band ho gaya. Kisi ne bataya ki maalik ne aakhri baar andar dekha aur baad me uski laash mili. Aaj bhi raat ko wahan kaali kali ghaas aur khaali gufa dikhti hain.

Jaanch.

 Hum ek dhopahar gaye. Gufa ke bahar ka hawa bhaari tha. Andar jaate hi aankh me jalan — chuna patthar ki dhool aur kai saal ki band hawa. Hamare saath ek local guide tha, jo bola: “Yahan 10 minute se zyada nahi.” Hum 8 minute me bahar aaye, sar dard kar raha tha.

 Khaan ka band hona asli hai. Uske aas-paas chuna patthar ki kheti, sookhe kuein aur aadhi giri hui deewarein hain. Raat ko “aawaz” wahan hawa ke rukh aur chhote pattharon ke girne se aati hai. Jo log yahan ghoomne aate hain, unme se koi bhi andar 20 minute se zyada nahi rukta — kyunki andar saans lena mushkil hota hai.

 “Aadmi ka bhoot” wali kahani kisi verified police file me nahi hai. Par ek baat file me hai: khaan band hone ke baad yahan kai log ghoomne aaye, aur kuch gir kar ghayal hue. Unhe bachane ke liye yahan board lagane pade.

c-dumas.title: Dumas Beach ki kaali ret
c-dumas.text:
Dumas Beach ki ret kaali hai, aur raat ko wahan koi nahi rehta. Kahaniyan kehti hain ki ek bhoot kisi ko bulata hai, aur jo aage jaata hai woh paani me kho jaata hai. Yahan har saal log doobte hain. Humne wahan teen raatein bitayi — ek police chowki ke saamne, ek ghat par, aur ek samundar ke kinare.

Jaanch.

 Pehli raat: koi awaaz nahi, sirf lehar aur hawa. Doosri raat: ek aadmi paas aaya, jise humein laga ki koi hai — woh nashe me tha aur bhatak gaya tha. Humne use chowki tak chhoda. Teesri raat: ek awaaz jo gaane jaisi thi — ek dukaan ka radio jo khula reh gaya tha.

 “Bulaya jaata hai” wali baat do doobne ki ghatnaon se banti hai. Police record ke mutabiq yahaan zyada tar maut un logon ki hoti hai jo raat me sharab pi kar paani me jaate hain, ya unhe tairna nahi aata. Kaali ret mein pair dhans jaata hai, aur raat me dhara samajh nahi aati.

 Teen raat ke baad humne wahan ek board pada dekha — “Raat me paani me na jaiye.” Kisi ne use nahi hataya. Bhoot ki kahani ek police warning hai jo “darawani” hai, isliye log use yaad rakhte hain. Humein bhi yahi karna hai: kahani yaad rakhiye, par paani se door rahiye.

c-dsouza-chawl.title: D'Souza Chawl ka kuaan
c-dsouza-chawl.text:
Mahim ke D'Souza Chawl ke beech ek kuaan hai, jise uthli se dhaka gaya hai. Log kehte hain ki ek aurat wahan raat 9 baje khadi dikhti hai, aur jo usse dekhe woh bimaar pad jaata hai. Kuch logon ne bataya ki woh apne baal pehne parde me hai — wahi shakal jo Mumbai ki purani film me thi.

Jaanch.

 Hum do log gaye. Chawl ke logon ne bahut kuch sunaya. Humne kuein ki uthli khud ka ali — gili, phislan. Kuein ke andar paani ka level kam tha aur usme kachra pada tha. Hawa me ek ajeeb badbu thi.

 Aadhi raat ko humne khud dekha: ek safed shakal. Woh ek aurat thi jo kuein ke paas kapde dhone aayi thi — raat me, kyunki din bhar paani nahi hota. Safed kapde, geele baal, aur kuein ki roshni me uska chehra chamak raha tha. Usne humein dekh kar kuch bhi nahi kaha. Usne apni balti uthai aur chali gayi.

 Us raat ke baad humne kuein ka paani test karwaya. Usme bacteria kaafi zyada tha. Jo log bimaar pad rahe the, unme zyada tar bachche the — jinke ghar ke paas kuein tha. Chehra real tha, bhoot nahi. Aur kuein ki water quality ek asli public health issue hai.

c-ramoji.title: Ramoji Film City ka floor
c-ramoji.text:
Hyderabad ke film city me ek purane studio ke floor par raat ki shift me kaam karna mushkil tha. Log kehte the wahan ek junior artist ki aatma hai, jo scene ke beech me lights gira deti hai. Do haadse hue bhi — koi zyada ghayal nahi hua.

Jaanch.

 Production manager ne do camera lagwaye aur ek structural engineer bulaya. Teen hafte tak recording hui. Recording me ek raat, 1:40 baje, ek light ka stand jhukta dikha. Uske baad 3 ghante me do baar aur. Kisi ko kuch dikha nahi.

 Engineer ne stand ke base par rust aur jhukav dekha, aur studio ke floor me seepage. Purana wiring bhi kaam nahi kar raha tha — short circuit se light flicker kar rahi thi. “Aurat ka saaya” wali baat ek purani junior artist ki kahani se aayi thi jo wahan kaam karti thi aur film chhod kar chali gayi thi, kisi ki maut se nahi.

 Manager ne teeno stands badle aur wiring theek karwai. Lights girna bandh ho gayi. Us raat ke baad staff ne kaha studio “saaf” ho gaya. Sach yahi tha: koi aatma nahi thi, sirf ek zang laga hua stand tha jise kisi ne teen saal se check nahi kiya.

c-mukesh-mills.title: Mukesh Mills ka floor
c-mukesh-mills.text:
Mazgaon ki Mukesh Mills 1980s me bandh ho gayi. Tabah chhat, khaali shed, aur samundar ki nami. Yahan shooting ke liye log aate hain — kyunki ye jagah film ke liye perfect hai. Aur kai units ne yahan kaam ke baad bataya ki kuch “hai”.

Jaanch.

 Ek unit ke lightman ne bataya ki raat me unhe kandhe par haath ka ehsaas hua. Dusre ne kaha ki ek aurat ka dupatta dekha. Humne wahan ek raat bitayi. Shed me hawa ka rukh ajeeb tha — ek darwaze se andar, doosre se bahar. Samundar ki nami ne chhat ki chadar ko bhaari kar diya tha.

 Raat 2 baje humne woh cheez suni — ek khich-khich, jo deewar ke andar se aati thi. Woh purane lohe ke pipe the, jinme samundar ki hawa ke saath paani ghusta tha. “Kandhe par haath” wala hissa: chhat se girti pattiyan, jo chalte hue kandhe se takraati thin.

 Uski ek aur wajah thi — mill ki chhat ka ek hissa itna kamzor tha ki ASI jaisi koi agency nahi, par BMC ne usse band kar diya. Jo log wahan shot karte hain, unhe chhat aur bijli se darr lagna chahiye. Woh cheez real hai. Aur woh cheez zyada khatarnaak hai.

c-jamali-kamali.title: Jamali Kamali ki qabr
c-jamali-kamali.text:
Mehrauli ke Archaeological Park me ek chhota kamra hai jisme do qabrein hain — Jamali aur Kamali. Kaha jaata hai ki yahan raat ko koi jinn guzarta hai, aur jo andar jaata hai woh bahar nahi aata. Ye kahani Delhi ke school ke bachchon me sabse popular hai.

Jaanch.

 Hum din me gaye. Kamra khula tha, ek guard bahar baitha tha. Andar do qabrein, ek chhoti khidki, aur deewar par likha hua tha. Guard ne kaha ki raat me yahan koi nahi ruka. Humne poocha ki phir kahani kahan se aayi, to unhone ek baat batayi jo aaj bhi sach hai: yahan ke aas-paas ek jungle hai, aur raat me yahan bijli nahi hoti.

 Baahar park me sadiyon purane khandahar hain, aur raat me yahan saanp, kutton ke jhund aur bhatke hue log aate hain. ASI ne is jagah par “raat me entry mana” ka board lagaya hai — safety ke liye, bhoot ke liye nahi. Us board par bhoot ka zikr nahi hai. Log us board ko padhte nahi, kahani padh lete hain.

 “Jamali ka jinn” ki kahani 1500s ke ek sufi sant aur unke saathi ki yaad se judi hai. Unke bare me likha hua kaafi hai. Unki qabrein ek heritage hain — aur unke kamre me raat ko ghus kar “proof” dhoondhna na jaan ko khatre me daalna hai, na unki izzat ko.

c-agrasen.title: Agrasen ki Baoli
c-agrasen.text:
Hailey Road ki Agrasen ki Baoli — 108 seedhiyan neeche, teen taraf deewarein, aur ek aisi khamoshi jo shehar ke beech ho. Kaha jaata hai ki neeche paani ka rang kaala hai, aur wahan se ek aawaz aati hai jo kisi ko dhoondhti hai. Netflix ki ek film ke baad yahan bheed lagne lagi.

Jaanch.

 Hum subah 7 baje gaye. Neeche paani hai — hara, sthir. Uske paas khada hone par awaaz aati hai: apne hi pair ki khich, deewar se wapas. Baoli ka dhancha aisa hai ki awaaz 3-4 baar laut kar aati hai. 108 seedhiyan bahut hain — chadhte hue saans phoolti hai, aur dil dhadakta hai.

 Film ke baad yahan raat me log aane lage the, aur kuch gir gaye. ASI ne timing fix ki aur raat me band kar diya. “Aawaz dhoondhti hai” wali baat awaaz ki goonj hai, aur “kaala paani” — paani ke andar anjan jagah se aata hai, ghaas aur sadiyon ki mitti se.

 Baoli ka asli jadoo ye hai ki 600 saal pehle yahan log paani lene aate the, aur unki awaazein inhi deewarein se takrati thin. Aaj wahi deewarein hamari awaaz lautti hain. Kabhi kabhi bhoot ki kahani ek itni achhi tarah bani hui imarat hoti hai ki woh khud hi kirdaar ban jaati hai.

c-malcha-mahal.title: Malcha Mahal
c-malcha-mahal.text:
Delhi ke Ridge forest me Malcha Mahal ek toota hua shikar-gah hai. 1984 me yahan ek khandaan aaya — aur unhone dawa kiya ki woh Awadh ke shahi khandaan ke waris hain. Woh andar rehte the, bahar nahi jaate the, aur unke ghar me bijli nahi thi. 2017 me aakhri waris ki maut hui.

Jaanch.

 Yahan “bhoot” ki kahaniyan 2017 ke baad shuru hui. Aas-paas rehne wale kehte hain raat ko wahan roshni dikhti hai. Humne forest department ke guard se baat ki. Unhone bataya ki jungle me raat ko do-chaar log aate hain — shikar, ya kuch aur. Aur kuch roshniyan unki torch hoti hain.

 Asli kahani us khandaan ki thi: ek maa, ek beti aur ek beta, jinke paas paisa nahi tha, bijli nahi thi, aur koi unse milne nahi aata tha. Woh logon se darte the, isliye jungle me rehte the. Unke marne ke baad ek kamre me unke kapde, kuch tasveerein aur ek bister mila.

 Uss jagah par bhoot ki kahani sunane se pehle ye samajhna zaroori hai: woh teen log asli the. Unka akelapan asli tha. Aaj jo log wahan raat ko jaate hain, unhe jo dikhta hai woh kisi ki yaad hai — aur us yaad ka izzat karna bhoot se darrne se zyada zaroori hai.

c-dow-hill.title: Dow Hill ka school
c-dow-hill.text:
Kurseong ke Dow Hill me ek purana school aur ek khaali building hai. Yahan ki sabse mashhoor kahani: ek ladke ka sar seedhiyon par dikhta hai, aur ek “headmaster” ki aatma. Iske saath ek asli hissa jodta hai — 1968 ke baad yahan kuch laashein mili thin, aur ek murder case darj hua tha.

Jaanch.

 Hum wahan school ke caretaker se mile. Unhone bataya ki raat me unhe bhi kuch mehsoos hota hai, par unhone kabhi kuch dekha nahi. “Sar wali” kahani 1968 ki laashon ke baad bani. Us waqt ka case aaj bhi khula hai — kisi ko sazaa nahi hui.

 Building ka sach ye hai: purani lakdi ki seedhiyan, jo raat me thandi hone par karakti hain; ek chhat jisme barish ka paani jama hota hai; aur ek aisa corridor jahan bijli nahi hoti. School ke bachche in sab ko “headmaster” ki kahani se jodte hain, kyunki school ki har imarat me koi na koi aisi kahani hoti hai.

 Par ek cheez ko humein bhoot ki kahani ke naam par bhoolna nahi chahiye: 1968 me yahan kuch bachche mare the, aur unki maut ka koi jawab aaj tak nahi mila. Us file ko “haunted school” ke naam se yaad rakhna unke liye insaaf nahi hai. Woh ek khuli jaanch hai.

c-national-library.title: National Library ki raat
c-national-library.text:
Kolkata ki National Library ek purani haveli me hai — Belvedere Estate. Warren Hastings yahan rehte the, aur ek samay me yahan ek duel bhi hua tha. Library ke staff ki kahani: raat me kitaabein girती hain, kursiyan khinchti hain, aur ek aawaz dhoop me bhi sunai deti hai.

Jaanch.

 Hum ek staff member ke saath raat 11 baje tak ruke. Do baar kitaabein girin — dono baar ek hi almari se. Almari ka ek khana dhila tha. Uske upar AC ka vent tha, jo thanda hawa chhodta tha. “Kursi khinchne” ki awaaz lift ke darwaze se aati thi.

 “Hastings ki aatma” wali baat Belvedere ki purani history se judi hai. Haveli me ek duel hua tha — par usme koi Hastings ke khandaan ka nahi mara tha. Jo aawaz hai, woh ek 200 saal purani imarat ki hawa, lakdi aur lift hai.

 Library ke staff ne mujhe ye bhi bataya: raat me imarat me sirf do log hote hain. Unke liye woh aawazein darr nahi, bas “kaam ka alarm” hain — agar almari gir jaaye to kitaab kharab hogi. Unhone mujhe ek baat kahi jo mujhe pasand aayi: “Bhoot ho ya na ho, akela aadmi raat me yahan nahi rehta.”

c-writers-building.title: Writers' Building ka pehla floor
c-writers-building.text:
Kolkata ke Writers' Building me raat ko ek clerk dikhta hai — safed dhoti, file haath me, corridor ke aakhri kamre tak. Kaha jaata hai ki woh ek employee hai jo kaam ke beech mara tha. Kuch logon ne usse dekha, kuch ne bas use suna.

Jaanch.

 Hum wahan ek guard ke saath gaye. Raat 1 baje corridor me koi nahi tha. Ek kamre me roshni thi. Andar ek aadmi baitha tha, file khole hue. Woh ek clerk tha — outsourced staff, jise raat ki shift mili thi aur jo apna kaam subah tak khatam nahi kar paata tha.

 Guard ne kaha ki “clerk ka bhoot” ki kahani 50 saal purani hai. Us kahani ki jad ek asli ghatna thi — ek employee ko duty par dil ka daora aaya tha aur unki maut hui thi. Uske baad raat ki shift me logon ko lagne laga ki woh ghoom raha hai. Us ke baad raat ki shift me kaam karne wale log kam ho gaye, isliye jagah khaali lagi, aur jagah khaali lage to kahani zyada sach lagti hai.

 Us raat maine us clerk se baat ki. Unhone kaha: “Sab mujhe bhoot samajhte hain. Main bas 6 baje tak file khatam karna chahta hoon.” Aaj bhi Writers' Building ke bahar koi aapko yahi kahani sunayega. Us aadmi ne subah tak kaam kiya. Woh asli tha.

c-brij-raj.title: Brij Raj Bhavan
c-brij-raj.text:
Kota's Brij Raj Bhavan ek heritage imarat hai. 1857 me yahan ek British officer mara tha, aur kahani kehti hai ki uski aatma ab bhi hai. Guards ne kaha ki raat me unhone pipe ki khushbu mehsoos ki, aur unhe kisi ke saath koi room me baithne ka ehsaas hua.

Jaanch.

 Humne do raatein wahan bitayi. Pehli raat kuch nahi. Doosri raat, 1 baje, corridor me taaza tambaku ki khushbu aayi. Hum tezi se uthe — koi nahi tha. Subah manager ne has kar kaha ki yahan raat ka guard baith kar beedi peeta hai. Humne guard se poocha, usne has kar haan kaha.

 “Officer ka bhoot” ki kahani vahan ki heritage ke liye kaafi kaam karti hai. Hotel ke brochure me bhi zikr hai. Par room me ek bistar, ek purana escritoire aur ek kursi hai — jo logon ko lagta hai kisi ne abhi chhoda. Woh asli me kisi ne chhoda tha: restoration ke time.

 Brij Raj Bhavan ek khoobsurat imarat hai. Wahan sach me raat ka guard beedi peeta hai, aur heritage ki chhaten awaaz karti hain. Aur yahi baat is jagah ki asli kahani hai — ek imarat jo 170 saal se apni yaad khud rakhti hai, bhoot ki zaroorat ke bina.

c-savoy.title: Savoy Hotel ka kamra 112
c-savoy.text:
Mussoorie ka Savoy 1902 se chal raha hai. Yahan ek writer ne khud ko mara tha — woh sach hai. Uske baad se hotel me ek “lady in grey” ki kahani chalti hai, jo kamre ke darwaze par aati hai. Staff kehte hain woh guest ki dress me hoti hai.

Jaanch.

 Hum office ke record tak nahi pahunche, par ek purane staff se baat hui. Unhone bataya ki “lady” wali kahani 1960s se hai, jab ek guest ne raat me help ke liye bell bajai thi aur phir koi nahi mila. Us raat hotel ke staff me sirf do log the.

 Hotel ka dhancha aisa hai ki purane wings me darwaze bilkul ek jaise hain. Log galat kamre khol dete hain. Ek baar humne khud ek aurat ko corridor me dekha — woh ek guest thi jo apna kamra dhoondh rahi thi. Humne use raasta dikhaya. Us raat “lady in grey” ka wahi silsila tha.

 Writer ki maut ke bare me jo sach hai, woh bhoot ki kahani se badi hai: ek aadmi akela tha, aur usne dard me aisa kiya. Hotel ne us kamre ko band nahi kiya. Aaj wahan log rehte hain, aur kahani chalti hai. Asli dukh ko hotel marketing me badal dena sabse ajeeb cheez hai jo humne dekhi.

c-three-kings.title: Three Kings Church
c-three-kings.text:
Cansaulim ke Three Kings Church pahadi par hai, aur wahan se poora Goa dikhta hai. Kahani kehti hai ki yahan teen padri rehte the, aur ek ne baaki dono ko zeher de diya kyunki unhe ek khazana chahiye tha. Uske baad uski aatma wahan bhatakti hai, aur ghanti raat me bajti hai.

Jaanch.

 Hum shaam ko chadhe. Church band thi. Ek chowkidaar wahan tha. Unhone bataya ki ghanti hawa se bajti hai, kyunki uska ek hissa dhila hai. Us raat humne ghanti suni — hawa tez thi. Usne ye bhi bataya ki log raat me church ke andar ghuskar “proof” dhoondhne aate hain, aur ek baar kisi ne darwaza tod diya.

 Teen padri wali kahani gaon ke logon me hai, par church ke record me aisi koi hatya nahi hai. Jo hai woh ye: church 1600s me bana, pahadi par bijli girती hai, aur raat me wahan koi nahi rehta. Khazane ki kahani barso se chalti hai, kyunki ek baar kisi ne wahan khudai ki aur kuch nahi mila.

 Us pahadi par sabse bada khatra church ya bhoot nahi hai — rasta hai. Raat me utarte hue humne ek doosre ko pakad kar chalna pada. Goa ke pahadi churchon par roz log phisalte hain. “Bhoot” wali kahani kaafi logon ko raat me wahan jaane se rokti hai. Shayad wahi uski sabse achhi duty hai.

c-gp-block.title: GP Block ka khaali ghar
c-gp-block.text:
Meerut ke GP Block me ek ghar khaali pada hai. Log kehte hain raat ko wahan ek aurat khadi hoti hai jo paani maangti hai, aur ghar ke andar se aawazein aati hain. Mohalle ke bachche wahan se darr ke guzarte hain.

Jaanch.

 Hum do shaam wahan gaye. Pehli shaam ek budhi aurat darwaze par aayi aur paani maanga. Humne diya. Woh ghar ke teen kamre me se ek me rehti thi. Baaki ghar band tha aur uske bhai ka tha, jo shehar me chala gaya tha. “Aawazein” kisi aur ke aane se aati thin — gaon ke bachche, jo sharaarat me andar jaate the.

 Us aurat ne humein apni poori kahani batayi — pati ki maut, bete ka chala jaana, aur ek ghar jise bechne ka koi rasta nahi. Woh akeli thi, aur mohalle ne uske akelapan ko “bhoot” ka naam de diya. Uske ghar par log thookte the, aur koi paani lene nahi aata tha.

 Humne mohalle me ek chai ki dukaan par baat ki. Do logon ne ek baar wahan kuch dekha tha, par teenon ne ye bhi kaha ki woh aurat “ajeeb” hai. Ajeeb ka matlab yahan akeli tha. Us raat humne uske liye khana le kar gaya. Bhoot nahi mila. Ek aurat mili jise koi nahi dekhna chahta tha.

c-bhool-bhulaiya.title: Bhool Bhulaiya
c-bhool-bhulaiya.text:
Bara Imambara ka Bhool Bhulaiya 1784 me bana. Isme 489 darwaze hain aur sirf ek asli exit. Kaha jaata hai ki andar jaane wale kuch log kabhi bahar nahi aaye — unhe raste me koi mila, koi aawaz aayi, koi haath pakdaane ko aaya.

Jaanch.

 Hum guide ke saath andar gaye. 3 minute me hum bhool gaye ki hum kis taraf se aaye. Corridor tang, chhat neechi, aur hawa nahi. Guide ne kaha: “Bina guide ke aaye to 2 ghante lag jaayenge.” Humne 11 minute me 3 door — aur sabhi band.

 “Aawaz” wali baat aaj bhi hoti hai. Andar awaaz 4-5 baar goonjti hai, aur saamne se aati lagti hai. Log use “koi hai” samajh lete hain aur ghabra kar bhaagte hain, phir kisi doosre corridor me pahunch jaate hain. Ek baar ek tourist aadhi raat tak andar rah gaya, aur security ne use nikala.

 Ye imambara ek engineering ka kamaal hai. Uska “bhoot” uski architecture hai. Darr ka asli kaaran: andhera, tang raasta, aur doosri taraf jaane wale log. Kahani sunne me maza aata hai, par bina guide ke andar na jaana sabse samajhdari ki baat hai.

c-nahargarh.title: Nahargarh ka raat ka qila
c-nahargarh.text:
Nahargarh Fort raat me Jaipur par girta hua dikhta hai. Usme ek mahal hai, jaise Madhavendra Bhawan, jisme 12 kamre hain. Kaha jaata hai raat ko wahan ek cheekh sunai deti hai — ek dulhan ki, jise ek raja ke maarne se pehle chillaaya tha. Koi record me nahi.

Jaanch.

 Guard ne humein raat 9:30 baje baahar chala diya, par baithne diya. Unhone bataya ki cheekh ki awaaz har barish me aaati hai — au ek khaas jagah se. Hum wahan raat 10:30 tak ruke. Awaaz aayi. Woh ek chhipkali thi — ek bada chipkali jo deewar par se gir kar aawaz kar rahi thi, aur mahal ki goonj se ek cheekh si lagti thi.

 “Dulhan ki cheekh” wali baat qile ki ek purani aur asli ghatna se nahi aati. Qile ki history me koi aisi dulhan nahi. Ye kahani turismo ke saath chalne lagi, kyunki log raat ka darr chaahte hain. Guard ne khud kaha: “Yahan koi bhoot nahi. Yahan bas bahut bada khaali jharna hai.”

 Nahargarh ka asli rahasya uski taffe ki hai — 12 kamre, ek hawaadaar chhat, aur ek aangan jahan aandhi. Raat me wahan khade ho kar aapko cheekh sunai degi. Woh aapke kaan aur deewar ke beech ka khel hai. Isliye raat 10 baje ke baad entry band hai — bhuton ke liye nahi, deeware ke liye.

c-ramappa.title: Ramappa temple ka shilpi
c-ramappa.text:
Ramappa temple ke bare me do ajeeb sach hain: ek, ki ye apne shilpi ke naam par hai — jo shayad hi kisi mandir ke saath hua ho. Doosra, iske patthar (brick) paani me tairte hain. Aur ek kahani hai ki raat me shilpi ka bhoot kaam karta hai.

Jaanch.

 Hum shaam ko wahan gaye. Mandir ke bahar ek chhota board tha, jise ASI ne lagaya hai: “Raat me entry mana.” Andar ek guard tha. Unki baat: “Yahan koi shilpi nahi aata, sirf bandar aate hain.” Us raat humne patthar par khich-khich suni — woh ek bandar hi tha.

 Shilpi ki kahani isliye bani ki mandir ka naam Ramappa hai, aur mandir ke andar ek shilpi ki murti hai. Kaam ki shreshthatā ne ye kahani banai ki woh aaj bhi kaam kar raha hai. Par asli sach ye hai ki 1213 me is mandir ko banane me saikdon logon ka jeevan laga — unke naam kisi register me nahi hain.

 UNESCO ne 2021 me Ramappa ko World Heritage status diya. Ye site ka sabse bada imaandari ka hissa hai: hum ek mandir ko bhoot ki jagah banate hain, jabki woh insaan ke hunar ki jagah hai. Us raat humne us shilpi ki murti ke saamne khade ho kar unhe salaam kiya — jinhe naam nahi mila.

c-rohtas.title: Rohtasgarh ka khazana
c-rohtas.text:
Rohtasgarh qila pahadi par hai, aur usse jodne wali ek purani baat hai: rani ka khazana. 1576 me jaala ke baad qila tabah hua, aur kehte hain ek rani apne gehne lekar bhag gayi. Raat ko wahan ek aurat khadi dikhti hai, jo kuch dhoondhti hai.

Jaanch.

 Gaon ke log batate hain ki pichhle kuch saalon me logon ne raat me khudai ki. Humein wahan koi khazana nahi mila, par humein un gaddhon ke nishaan milе — aur ek hai jo police ne bharaa tha. Unhone ek aadmi ko pakda tha jisne qile ki deewar ka patthar ukhaad diya tha.

 “Rani ka bhoot” ki kahani purani hai, par uska asli kaam aaj kuch aur hai: woh lootera se bachati hai. Gaon ke buzurg kehte hain ki jo khazana dhoondhne raat me jaata hai, woh qile ko todta hai. Jin nishaano ke bare me hum baat kar rahe hain, woh un logon ke hain jinhe patthar bechna tha.

c-bhangarh-case.title: Bhangarh: file kya kehti hai
c-bhangarh-case.text:
Bhangarh duniya ki har “most haunted” list me hai. Is file me kahani nahi — sirf woh cheezein hain jo likhi hui hain. Ek: qile ke darwaze par ASI ka board. Do: Rajasthan Tourism ka page. Teen: gaon ke logon ki zubaani.

Teen source, teen baatein.

 Board par likha hai ki sunrise se pehle aur sunset ke baad entry mana hai. Us par “bhoot” ka ek shabd nahi hai. Tourism page par do lok-katha hain — Ratnavati aur Baba Balau Nath — aur woh saaf likhta hai ki ye “popular belief” hai. Gaon ke log kahani sunate hain, aur unme se koi bhi ye nahi kehta ki usne raat me kuch dekha.

 Humne Teen raat wahan bitayi. Pehli raat: kuch nahi. Doosri raat: kutte, aur ek parinda. Teesri raat: qile ke darwaze par ek guard, jo raat 8 baje taala lagata hai. Uski baat: “Yahan kuch nahi hai. Par log raat me aate hain, aur gir jaate hain. Isliye taala.”

 “Teen log raat bitate hain, subah nahi uthte” — ye line internet par sabse zyada phaili hai. Uska koi akhbaar, FIR, ya hospital record nahi mila. Bhangarh ke bare me sabse bada sach yahi hai: jagah khaali hai. Aur khaali jagah me darr khud bhar jaata hai.

c-kuldhara-case.title: Kuldhara: date ka sawaal
c-kuldhara-case.text:
Kuldhara ko “ek raat me khaali hua gaon” kaha jaata hai. Kahani me ek hakam, ek ladki, ek shraap aur 84 gaon hain. Is file me hum dates dekhte hain — kyunki dates hi wo cheez hain jo kahani ko sabse zyada chunauti detе hain.

Teen date.

 Ek: Kuldhara me aabadi ke nishaan 1291 se milte hain. Do: demographic record ke mutabiq gaon ki aabadi 1815 se pehle hi girne lagi thi. Teen: 84 gaon ke ek saath khaali hone ka koi ek hi record nahi hai. Matlab “ek raat” wali baat sabse kamzor hissa hai.

 Gaon khaali hone ke kaaran aam taur par paani, mehngai, tax, raaste aur mauke hote hain. Kuldhara ke aas-paas paani ki kami ek asli baat hai — yahan ke kuein sookhe hain. Ek study ne earthquake se aaye nuksan ki baat bhi likhi hai, par woh ek theory hai, jawab nahi.

 Humne gaon ke ek buzurg se poochha: “Ek raat me sab chala gaya?” Unhone kaha: “Beta, raat me log chalte hain, shehar nahi. Shehar dheere-dheere khaali hota hai.” Woh sahi the. “Ek raat” ek acchi kahani hai, par ek gaon ka ujadna ek lambi katha hoti hai.

c-shaniwar-case.title: Shaniwar Wada: awaaz ka source
c-shaniwar-case.text:
Shaniwar Wada ki awaaz Pune ki sabse mashhoor kahani hai. “Kaka mala vachva” — Kaka, mujhe bachao. Ye 1773 me ek 16 saal ke Peshwa ki aakhri pukaar thi. Us raat ke baad qila jal kar tabah hua, aur aaj woh awaaz lautti hai.

Teen jagah.

 Hum teen jagah gaye: Delhi Darwaza, mastani jharokha aur pacheh ka aangan. Teen jagah hawa ka rukh alag tha. Delhi Darwaza par hawa tez aati hai; wahan ek purana lohe ka gate hai, jo har jhonke par aawaz karta hai. Uski aawaz ek pukaar jaisi lagti hai — khaas kar raat me.

 Record kya kehta hai: 1773 ki hatya history hai. Us raat ki “awaaz” ka koi record nahi hai — na koi video, na koi audio, jo verify ho sake. Jo recordings internet par hain, unme se kisi ka source nahi hai. Ek bahes me ek engineer ne bhi likha ki deewar ki aawaz ek pukaar jaisi goonjti hai.

 Is file ka nateeja dukh bhara hai. Us raat 16 saal ka ek ladka mara — uske chacha ne darwaza nahi khola. Awaaz “aaj bhi aati hai” kehna us dukh ko ek ghost story bana dena hai. Hum yahan rukte hain: 1773 me kuch hua tha. Uske baad ka har aawaz kahani hai.

c-alipore-jail.title: Alipore Jail ki cell 13
c-alipore-jail.text:
Alipore Jail ab ek museum hai. Kohinoor jail ke cell ki deewarein, phansi ka kamra, aur kai azadi ke senaniyon ki yaadein. Staff kehta hai raat ko ek cell me kuch awaaz hoti hai — ek aadmi ke chalne ki, sandiyon wali. Ek cell me aaj bhi ek kursi rakhi hai.

Jaanch.

 Hum us cell me gaye. Andar thanda sa tha. Wahan ek purana fan tha jo tej chal raha tha. Staff ne humein bataya ki cell me raat ko awaaz hoti hai — par usne khud bataya ki woh awaaz purane fan se aati hai, jo cell ke darwaze tak chal raha hota hai.

 Jail ki asli kahani awaazon se badi hai. Yahan 1908 me ek political case chala, aur yahan kai logon ko phansi hui. Yahan ki diwarein un logon ke naam rakhti hain. Museum ke ek guard ne (jo 30 saal se wahan tha) mujhse kaha: “Beta, yahan koi bhoot nahi. Yahan sirf history hai. History kaafi hai.”

 Aaj Alipore Jail ek museum hai — log aate hain, tasveerein lete hain, aur “cell 13” ki kahani sunte hain. Wahin ke record me cell 13 kisi death se judi nahi hai. Jo hai woh ek purana fan, ek lamba corridor, aur un logon ki yaad hai jinhone apna sab kuch diya.

c-teresa.title: Tarapith ke shmashan ki raat
c-teresa.text:
Tarapith ek shakti-peeth hai. Mandir ke paas hi shmashan hai, jahan sadhana hoti hai. Raat me wahan aawazein aati hain — dhun, hey, dhol. Log kehte hain wahan aatmaayein ghoomti hain. Hum wahan ek pujari ke saath gaye.

Jaanch.

 Raat 10 baje hum pahunche. Mandir ke paas bheed thi — bhakt, sadhu, aur kai log jo raat bhar jaagte hain. Shmashan me koi aisa nahi tha jise dekh kar darr lage. Ek sadhak dhyan me baithe the. Pujari ne kaha: “Yahan jo aawaz hai, woh unki hai.”

 Tarapith ki asli baat ye hai ki ye ek jeevit parampara hai — log yahan aate hain, dhyan karte hain, apne dukh rakhte hain. Doosri baat: raat me yahan dhuan, shor aur bheed hai. Aawaz ka source dhoondhna mushkil nahi hai — bhopali, sadhna, aur mandir ki ghantiyaan.

 Pujari ne mujhe ek baat kahi jo maine likh li: “Jahan log dard le kar aate hain, wahan bhoot ki baat mat karo.” Main is file me usi baat ko rakhta hoon. Tarapith ka darr kisi aatma ka nahi hai — yahan kisi ka dard itna bada hai ki woh aawaz ban jaata hai. Tum us aawaz ko bhoot kehkar chale jao, to dard wapas jaisa hai waisa rahega.

c-ramoji-kothi.title: Kanpur ki band kothi
c-ramoji-kothi.text:
Kanpur me ek kothi band padi thi. Do saal tak koi kiraaydar nahi aaya. Padosi kehte the raat ko wahan roshni dikhti hai, aur ek aadmi khada hota hai. Kahani chalne se ghar ki keemat gir gayi. Ek din ek family ne usse dekha aur wahi kahani suni.

Jaanch.

 Hum wahan ek shaam gaye. Roshni thi — kyunki ghar ka ek chowkidaar wahan rehta tha. Uska koi kayada nahi tha, bas woh chaahta tha ki ghar khaali na lage. Usne khud kaha: “Agar koi kiraaydar aaye, mujhe naukri milegi.”

 Ghar ki keemat girne ki asli wajah kuch aur thi: ek karze ka vivaad, aur koi sale nahi ho rahi thi. “Bhoot” wali kahani ne us ghar ko aur sasta kar diya. Ek baar uski ek neighbour ne kaha: “Humein to lagta hai koi jaan bujh kar kahani phaila raha hai.” Uske baad usne ghar khareed liya.

 Ye file is site par ek alag tarah ka case hai — ismein bhoot ek property strategy tha. Us raat humne us ghar me ek aadmi ko dekha jo wahan naukri ki talash me rukha tha. Bijli bhi thi, aur bina bhoot ka naam liye ghar bik gaya. Yahan ek yaad rakhne layak baat hai: ghar ki keemat girne ka kaaran bhoot nahi hota, kisi ka faayda hota hai.

t-ullu-40-raat.title: Ullu ka chaalis raat ka jaagran
t-ullu-40-raat.text:
Mere ek rishtedaar ne, jinke gaon mein bijli abhi bhi shaam saat baje ke baad nahi aati, mujhe wahi baat sunai jo maine WhatsApp par sau baar padhi thi: ullu ko chaalis raat jaagakar rakhna. Raat bhar uske saamne diya jalta rahe, use sone na do. Chaalisvi raat ke baad wo sammohit ho jaata hai, aur phir wo apne maalik se insaan ki zubaan mein baat karta hai. Aur jo baat sabse zyada bikti hai — wo batata hai ki sona kahan dabaya hua hai.

Gaon mein kahani kaise chalti hai.

 Is kahani ke do hisse hamesha saath chalte hain. Pehla hissa dar ka hai: ullu raat ka pakshi hai, uski aawaz ashubh maani jaati hai, chhat par baith jaaye to koi marne wala hai. Doosra hissa lalach ka hai: agar ullu raat ka rakhwala hai, to wahi rakhwala sabse bada khazana bhi jaanta hoga. Ek hi pakshi ko dar aur lalach dono ne pakad kar rakha hai.

 Maine apne rishtedaar se poocha ki unhone khud kabhi dekha hai? Nahi. Kisi ne dekha hai? Ek aadmi ne, jiske “bhaiya ke saale” ne ki thi. Naam, gaon, saal — kuch bhi poora nahi tha. Sirf itna tha ki kahani pakki thi.

Ek doosri taraf.

 Phir main Farrukhabad ke ek aadmi se mila jo pichhle aath saal se ghayal aur bebas ullu pakad kar forest department ko deta hai. Unke paas ek chhote kamre mein pandrah ullu the — chhoti ullu, barn owl, aur ek bada rock eagle owl jise kisi ne thekedaar se kharida tha. Unhone mujhe bataya ki “chaalis raat jaagane” ki baat sach hoti to is tijaarat mein lagne wale logon ke paas sabse pehle sona hota. Par unke paas sirf toote pankh the, aankhon mein infection, aur ek chamach se doodh pilane wala kaam.

 Unhone ek baat kahi jo mujhe ab tak yaad hai: “Ullu ki aankh roshni se aisi hi takti hai jaise aapki aankh phone ki torch se. Raat bhar jaagane ka matlab uske liye maut ka raasta hai, sona ka nahi.”

Jo asli hai.

 Ullu raat ka shikari hai. Din mein wo aaram karta hai, raat mein shikaar. Uska dimaag, uski aankhein aur uske pankh raat ke liye bane hain, insaan ki baat ke liye nahi. Kisi bhi pakshi ke paas insaan ki tarah bolne ka gala nahi hota — jitni bhi awaazein wo nikaale, wo swar-peti ki seema ke andar hi rehti hain. Aur “chhupa hua sona” dhoondhne wali koi indriy kisi jaanwar ke paas nahi hoti, warna puratatva vibhag ke paas ullu naukri par hote.

 Jo cheez asli hai wo ye hai: is kahani se pakshiyon ki tijaarat chalti hai. Diwali ke aas-paas demand badhti hai, daam hazaaron se lakh tak jaate hain, aur pakshi ko bechne wale aapko wahi “chaalis raat” wala sapna dikhate hain. Sapna muft hai. Pakshi ka daam aap bharenge, aur uske baad uske marne ka, infection ka, ya forest department ke case ka kharcha bhi.

t-kachhua-sona.title: Kachhua ke pet mein sona
t-kachhua-sona.text:
Chhoti si dukaan, ek steel ka tub, usme paani, aur usme ek tara-kachhua. Dukaandaar keh raha tha: “Iske pet mein sona hai. Jis ghar mein ye rahega, wahan khazana khud baahar aayega.” Daam — chalis hazaar, “aap to jaante hi hain, main aapko kam mein de raha hoon”.

Bazaar ka hisaab.

 Kachhua ko sona dhoondhne wala, sona ugalne wala, ya khazana sambhalne wala batana koi naya kaam nahi hai. Kayi jagah isi kahani ke saath kachhue ki haddi, kachhue ka kavach aur “kachhue ka tel” bikta hai. Kahani ka dhaancha ek hi hai: ek jaanwar jo dheere chalta hai, isliye lagta hai bahut kuch jaanta hai; aur jo bahut dheere chalta hai, use bechne ke liye zyada mehnat nahi chahiye.

 Jo maine us dukaan mein dekha, wo kahani se zyada bhayankar tha. Kachhue ke kavach par spray paint se “sone” jaisa rang, aankhon mein infection, aur tub ke paani mein wahi gandagi jisme wo hafton se baitha tha. Uske saath wala doosra kachhua mar chuka tha — dukaandaar ne use ek kapde mein lapet kar peeche phenk diya.

Ek vaigyanik ki baat.

 Ek wildlife veterinarian ne mujhe bataya ki kachhua bikta hai kyunki log usse “zameen ka rakhwala” maante hain. Par asli kachhua ka kaam doosra hai: wo nadi ke andar ki safai karta hai, mara hua maans aur gandi cheezein khaata hai, aur Ganga ko saaf rakhne mein uski bhoomika insaan se kam nahi. “Jis jaanwar ko aap khazana samajh kar ghar le jaate hain, wo nadi ka safai-karmchari hai. Ghar mein wo bhookha mar jaata hai,” unhone kaha.

Jaal aur kanoon.

 Bihar, UP aur Bengal mein kachhue ki tijaarat ek bada illegal dhandha hai. Pakadne wale, thekedaar, aur bechne wale — teenon ek hi zanjeer ke kadi hain. Aur kachhua ghar mein rakhne wale ko is baat ka pata bhi nahi hota ki wo bhi us zanjeer ka hissa ban gaya hai.

t-diwalii-ullu-bazaar.title: Diwali ki raat, ullu ka bazaar
t-diwalii-ullu-bazaar.text:
Diwali ka mahina aata hai aur shehar ki ek purani mandi mein kuch cheezein mehngi ho jaati hain. Mithai nahi. Ullu. Ek interview mein ek shikaari ne kaha tha: “Jo ullu chahte hain, unhe pata hota hai kahan poochna hai. Hum sirf pakadte hain. Maarta tantrik hai.”

Kaan wale ullu.

 Sabse zyada daam un ulluon ka lagta hai jinke sar par do chhote “kaan” dikhte hain. Wo asli kaan nahi hain — pankhon ke guchhe hain. Kahani ne unhe sabse zyada shakti wala bana diya, aur isi wajah se rock eagle owl, dusky eagle owl aur brown fish owl sabse zyada bikte hain. Pandrah prakar ke ullu ab tak tijaarat mein pakde ja chuke hain — unnis se zyada nahi, kul tees mein se.

 Daam do hazaar se shuru hokar lakh tak jaata hai. Beech mein thekedaar, gaadi wala, mandi ka dalal, aur ant mein wo aadmi jo apne ghar ki takleef ka ilaaj pakshi se karne aaya hai.

Ek raat ka hisaab.

 Ek forest officer ne mujhe bataya ki Diwali ke aas-paas unke paas calls badh jaati hain — kisi ne gaadi mein cage dekha, kisi ne chhat par jaal. Par pakadne par bhi case banana mushkil hota hai, kyunki gawaah darte hain. “Log samajhte hain hum unki aastha par hamla kar rahe hain. Hum sirf ek jaanwar bacha rahe hain,” unhone kaha.

 Yahan ek chhoti si baat dhyaan dene layak hai. Jin logon ko “ashubh” ullu se darr lagta hai, unhi ke kheton mein ullu chuhon ka safaya karta hai — wo kisan ka sabse sasta dost hai. Jo pakshi raat bhar khet ki rakhwali karta hai, use pakad kar marne se fasal nahi badhti, darr aur kam nahi hota. Sirf ek jaanwar mara jaata hai.

Aap kya kar sakte hain.

 Ullu bechte hue kisi ko dekhein to photo lene se pehle forest department ya police ko khabar dein — 1926 ya 112. Kisi ko ullu bechne ka lalach de rahe hain to unhe yaad dilaiye: ye criminal case hai, teen se saat saal tak. Aur agar aap un logon mein hain jo sach mein ullu se darte hain — ek raat khet ke kinare baithiye. Wo chuhon ka shikaar karega, aapko nahi.

t-giddh-haddi.title: Giddh ki haddi jo sona dhoondhti hai
t-giddh-haddi.text:
Ek haddi, lal kapde mein lipti. Sadhu keh rahe the: “Jahan sona dabaya hoga, wahan ye garam hogi. Aap keval haath mein leke ghar ke aangan mein ghoom lijiye.” Daam chha hazaar — “aap pehle insaan hain jinhe main de raha hoon”.

Garam hone ka kamaal.

 Haddi garam hoti hai. Iska karan koi khazana nahi hai — iska karan hanth ki garmi hai. Koi bhi cheez jise aap chalees minute tak muthi mein dabaye rakhein garam ho jaati hai. Jo aadmi aapko ye “test” karne ko kehta hai, wo aapko sirf apna haath dikha raha hai, zameen ke neeche kuch nahi.

 Is family ne haddi ko paanch din tak thanda-garam kiya, aangan mein ghooma, aur phir raat mein khud khudai shuru kar di. Wo puraane ghar ke neeche tak pahunch gaye. Kuch nahi mila — ek ghul raha pipe mila, aur ek daraar jo baarish ke paani se poori tarah kamzor ho chuki thi. Chhat ke ek hisse ko sahara dena padta hai aaj.

Giddh ka sawaal.

 Is kahani ka wo hissa jo sabse dard deta hai, wo haddi ka aana hai. India mein giddh ki aabadi pichhle tees saal mein tabaah hui hai — daklofenak jaisi dawa ki wajah se, jise giddh ke marel huye jaanwar ke shareer mein jaane par unke gurde fail jaate the. Aur yahan log haddi ko “jaadu” samajh kar kharid rahe hain. Giddh pehle se hi mar raha hai; hum uski haddi bhi bech rahe hain.

t-tantrik-khazana.title: Aangan ke neeche ka khazana
t-tantrik-khazana.text:
Bundelkhand ke ek ghar mein ek saadhu aaye. Unhone aangan mein khadi hokar aankhein band ki, phir kaha: “Neeche saat foot par ek tijori hai. Do sau saal purani. Is ghar ka purwaj ne dabai thi.” Ghar wale ruk gaye. Ghar ki chhat tapak rahi thi, beti ki shaadi aane wali thi, aur ek saadhu ne thoda sa aasmaan khol diya.

Dhandhe ka dhaancha.

 Khazana-wali baat ka ek pattern hota hai, aur wahi pattern ise puraane dhokhon ki list mein rakhta hai. Pehle “gyaan” muft milta hai — jagah, gehrai, tint. Phir ek chhoti rukaawat aati hai: “khazana band hai, bandhan kholna hoga”. Bandhan kholne ke liye pooja chahiye, pooja ke liye saamagri chahiye, saamagri ke liye paisa chahiye. Paanch sau se shuru hokar pandrah hazaar, phir pachaas hazaar. Har martaba “bas ek aur cheez” aati hai.

 Is ghar mein wahi hua. Khudai shuru hui, do martaba raat ka “muhurat” badla, ek “nishan” ke liye bakri chahiye thi. Aadhe raste par aangan ki zameen kamzor padi, deewar mein daraar aayi. Saadhu ne kaha “bandhan takleef de raha hai, humein agla step lena hoga”. Ghar wale wahi ruk gaye — kyunki agla step tab shuru hota hai jab pehla paisa doob chuka hota hai.

Khazana mila to kya hota.

 Aur ek baat jo koi nahi batata: agar khazana sach mein milta, to bhi wo poora unka nahi hota. Indian Treasure-Trove Act, 1878 kehta hai ki zameen mein chhupa hua maal milne par jise mile, use Collector ko likhit soochna deni hogi, khazana sarkari khazane mein jama karwana hoga, aur chhe mahine tak daavedaar bulaye jaate hain. Jo log raat mein chupke se khazana nikaal le jaate hain, wo chor nahi, khazana chhupane wale mulzim hote hain.

 Aur purani jagah par khudai? Uske liye puratatva vibhag ki ijazat chahiye. Zameen mein padha ek puraana sikka history hai, milkiyat nahi.

t-kuaan-sikka.title: Purane kuein ke sikke
t-kuaan-sikka.text:
Thanjavur ke bahar ek ghar ke pichhe puraana kuaan tha, jo pehle se hi band tha. Baarish ke baad uski deewar gir gayi, aur safai ke dauraan neeche se ek matka nikla — usme chhote tambe ke sikke, ek chhota deepak, aur do chhalle. Ghar ke mard pehle khush hue, phir dare.

Do din baad.

 Do din baad ek aadmi aaya jo khud ko “vaastu-shastri” kehta tha. Usne sikke chhue, aankhein band ki, aur kaha: “Ye maal shraapit hai. Ise ghar se nikalna hoga, warna teen peedhi tak rog.” Nikalne ka tarika? Use dena. Usne teen hazaar maange. Ghar walon ne de diye.

 Is kahani mein sabse zyada dukh ki baat ye hai ki jo cheez unhe mili thi, wo asli purani thi — aur unke paas reh sakti thi, ya kam se kam ek record ban sakta tha. Unke haath mein ek purane gaon ka hissa aaya tha, aur unhone use ek aadmi ke darr ke badle bech diya.

Purani cheez ka sahi raasta.

 Zameen se nikalne wali purani cheez ek document ki tarah hoti hai. Sikke se pata chalta hai kis saal, kis raajya mein, kis dhaatu ki tijaarat thi. Isliye kanoon usse “khazana” nahi, “antiquity” maanta hai. Aise maal ki kharid-farokht, aur desh se bahar bhejna, Antiquities and Art Treasures Act, 1972 ke tehat niyamit hai. Aur Treasure Trove Act ke tehat milne ki soochna dena zaroori hai.

 Sahi raasta lamba lagta hai — thana, Collector, puratatva vibhag, kagaz, intezaar. Par usi raaste par ek sach bachta hai. Doosre raaste par sirf ek aadmi ka jhooth bachta hai.

t-aaina-khazana.title: Tel mein tairta hua aaina
t-aaina-khazana.text:
Punjab ke ek gaon mein ek budhiya mujhe apne kamre mein le gayi. Farsh par ek thali, usme sarson ka tel, aur usme ek chhota aaina. “Aankh band karo, khazane ki jagah socho, phir aankh kholo. Aaina jahan andhera dikhaye, wahan khudai karo.” Unki aankhon mein poori yaqeen thi. Unke bete ne saat saal pehle ek zameen bechi thi, aur wo aaj bhi kehti hain ki paisa zameen ke neeche hi hai.

Jo dikhta hai.

 Tel mein doobta hua aaina andhere ko laal aur dhundhla kar deta hai. Aankh ko ek jagah tikane mein takleef hoti hai, aur thodi der baad dimaag khud hi aakritiyan bana deta hai — chehre, darwaze, siko. Iska naam koi jaadu nahi, ye wahi cheez hai jisse aap badal mein jaanwar dekhte hain. Jab aap pehle se “khazana” soch kar baithe hain, to dhundhle dhabbe ko khazana dikhna asambhav nahi, swabhaavik hai.

 Asli khel aaine ke baad shuru hota hai. Aaine mein jo “jagah” dikhi, uske aas-paas jo aadmi khudai karwata hai, wahi aapko “saamagri” bechta hai, wahi mazdoor lagata hai, wahi aapki zameen ke papers dekhta hai.

Budhiya ki baat.

 Maine us budhiya se poocha ki aap aaina rakh kar ek din bhi khud khudai kyun nahi karwayi? Unhone kaha: “Beta, khudai ke paise chahiye. Isliye main doosra raasta dhoondh rahi hoon.” Unke paas lalach nahi tha — majboori thi. Aur majboori wahi darwaza hai jahan se ye saara dhandha ghar mein aata hai.

 Unke bete ne baad mein mujhse kaha ki unki maa ko sahi ilaaj ki zaroorat hai, aur wo mahine mein ek baar doctor ke paas jaati hain. Ghar ki baat ghar mein rahe. Par ek baat main zaroor likhunga: us kamre mein sabse zyada asli cheez unki takleef thi, aaina nahi.

t-potli.title: Padosi ke aangan mein dabayi potli
t-potli.text:
Palamu ke ek gaon mein subah ek aurat ne apne aangan mein potli dekhi — lal kapde mein lipti, dhage se bandhi, kuch andar bhari hua. Wo cheekhi. Aadhe ghante mein gaon ikattha tha, aur faisla ho chuka tha: ye kaam padosi ka hai. Padosi Dalit tha.

Do saal ka nuksan.

 Gaon ne potli ka “ilaaj” karne ke liye ek ojha bulaya. Usne paanch hazaar liye. Padosi ke ghar ka paani band kar diya gaya, unka naam bazaar mein liya jaane laga, unki beti ko school chhodna pada. Do saal baad ek police case chalne par sach nikla: potli ek nayi bahu ne dabayi thi — apni saas se ladai ke baad, is umeed mein ki “kuch ho jaayega”. Andar kuch aisa tha jo darne layak nahi tha: thodi mitti, ek sikka, aur ek purana dhaga.

 Is kahani mein bhoot, jadu, ya shraap nahi tha. Sirf ek ghar ki ladai thi, jise gaon ne jaadu ke naam par doosre ghar par thop diya.

Potli ka asli kaam.

 Gaon mein “kala jadu ka nishan” ka ek saaf kaam hota hai — wo faisla kar deta hai ki galti kiski hai. Jab kisi ghar mein bimari aati hai, fasal kharab hoti hai, ya paisa nahi hota, to jawab chahiye hota hai. Science ka jawab dheere aata hai, aur potli ka jawab turant mil jaata hai. Chhote gaon mein turant milne wala jawab sabse khatarnaak hota hai.

 Aur kanoon? “Daayan” ya “jadu” ka ilzaam lagakar kisi ko maar-peet, samajik bahishkar, ya zabardasti “ilaaj” — ye apradh hai. Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha jaisi kai jagahon mein witchcraft-accusation ke khilaaf alag kanoon hain, aur bade rajyon mein bhi dhara 323, 354, 506 ke tehat case banta hai.

t-chhalawa-bimari.title: Chhalawa, ya ek bimari jiska naam nahi tha
t-chhalawa-bimari.text:
Sola saal ki ladki. Raat ke do baje uth kar cheekhna, apne aap se baat karna, aankhein palatna, phir subah kuch yaad nahi. Gaon ne naam rakh diya: chhalawa. Ojha aaye, jhaad-phook ki, ek “nishan” bataya gaya, aur ek kamre mein use akela baandh diya gaya — “taaki kuch galti na kare”.

Nau mahine.

 Nau mahine gaye. Do ojhe, teen mandir, ek “bhabhut wala baba”, aur ek baar tantrik ne kaha ki ye “purani chudail” hai jo unke khandan se judi hai. Tab tak uski padhai chhoot chuki thi, wo kamzor ho chuki thi, aur ghar ka paisa khatam. Phir ek naye doctor ne poocha: “Kabhi dimaag ka EEG karwaya hai?”

 Answer: wo “mirgi” thi — epilepsy. Uska ek khaas prakar, jisme doura aane se pehle ka anubhav ajeeb hota hai aur uske baad confusion. Wo cheekhna, wo baatein — sab doure ka hissa. Dawa shuru hui. Teen mahine mein wo raat bhar sone lagi. Aaj wo ek school mein padhati hai.

Do cheezein jo main kahna chahta hoon.

 Pehli: is kahani mein ojhe ne kuch “kharab” nahi kiya — unhone wahi kiya jo unhone seekha tha. Nuksan laaptaawahi ne kiya. Nau mahine ka ilaaj na milna ek aisa nuksan hai jo kabhi wapas nahi aata.

 Doosri: “chhalawa” ek aisa shabd hai jo har ajeeb vyavhaar ko ek hi naam de deta hai. Mirgi, mansik bimari, nasha, neend ki kami, thyroid, aur ek bachche ka dukh — sab ek hi shabd ke neeche chhup jaate hain. Aur jab sab ek naam ho jaate hain, to ek hi ilaaj chalta hai: jhaad-phook. Jo kaam nahi karta, wo teen mahine baad bhi nahi karta, aur us bachche ka time chala jaata hai.

t-angithi-bhoot.title: Angithi wala bhoot
t-angithi-bhoot.text:
Sardiyon ki raat. Ek kamre mein do log, ek koyla ki angithi, aur band khidki. Raat ke teen baje ek ko uthne mein dikkat hui — sar dard, ulti jaisa, dil ki dhadkan tez. Doosre din unhone kaha ki kamre mein koi saaya tha, aur gaon mein baat phail gayi: us kamre mein bhoot hai.

Ek hafta.

 Ek hafta kamra khaali pada. Phir ek purane doctor ne, jo mahine mein ek baar wahan aata tha, kamre mein dekha — band khidki, angithi, aur thodi si kaali gardan. Unhone sabse pehle khidki kholi. Phir bole: “Koyla jalane se ek gas banti hai jise carbon monoxide kehte hain. Wo dikhti nahi, sunai nahi deti, aur usi se sar dard, ulti, dhundhla dikhna aur ajeeb anubhav hote hain.”

 Unhone bataya ki hadse aksar sardi mein hote hain, aur har saal log angithi se aise hi hote hain — neend mein hi, kyunki carbon monoxide ka pehla asar neend hi hai. Aapko darr nahi lagta, aap so jaate hain.

Kamre ki deewar.

 Us hafte jo “saaya” dikha tha, uski bhi wajah thi: deewar par purana choona, ek bulb jo angithi ke dhuen se pila pad gaya tha, aur neend mein deewar dekhta ek aadmi. Aur jab ek kamre mein gas bharne lagti hai, to aankhon ke saamne dhabbe aana ek jaani hui baat hai.

 Yahan sabse ajeeb baat kya thi? “Bhoot” wali baat sunaye jaane ke baad, parivaar ne ek tantrik ko bulaya — aur kisi ne khidki kholne ka khayal nahi kiya. Darr ne dhyaan ek jagah rakha, aur asli wajah bilkul bagal mein thi.

t-elanthoor.title: Elanthoor: jab “khazana” ke liye insaan mara gaya
t-elanthoor.text:
Ye koi lok-katha nahi hai. Pathanamthitta zile ke Elanthoor gaon mein 2022 mein ek aisa case saamne aaya jo poore desh ko hila gaya. Do auratein — dono lottery ticket bechkar apna ghar chalati thin — ek “tantrik” aur ek jode ke paas pahuncheen, is vaade par ki unhe paisa, taraqqi ya “kismat” mil jayegi. Dono ki hatya kar di gayi.

Case file.

 Police ke mutabik, do auratein — Roslyn aur Padma — lalach aur bharose ke saath us ghar tak aayi thin. Unke saath jo hua, wo dharm, shakti ya khazana nahi tha; wo kidnap, yatar aur hatya thi. Kerala police ne teen aaropiyon — Muhammed Shafi, Bhagaval Singh aur unki patni Laila — ko October 2022 mein giraftar kiya. Aaraop ke tehat hatya, apaharan, baltkaar aur saboot mitane jaisi dharaayein hain. Muqadma abhi bhi adalat mein hai; 2025 tak aaraopiyon par dharaayein taey ki ja rahi thin aur nateeja nahi aaya.

 Is case ne Kerala mein ek purani baat phir se utha di: kya “black magic” ke naam par hone wale apradhon ke liye alag kanoon ki zaroorat hai? Kerala mein aisi ghatnaon ke khilaaf aaj bhi zyada tar mamle aam IPC dharaon ke tehat chalte hain.

Do auratein, do ghar.

 Is case ki sabse chhoti detail sabse bada sach batati hai. Dono mahilayein lottery ticket bechti thin — matlab wo apne haal par mehnat karti thin. Unke paas paisa nahi tha, isliye “jaldi amiri” ka jhooth unke liye sirf jhooth nahi, ek darwaza lagta tha.

 Har “tantrik” janta hai ki kahan dhoondhna hai. Wo shahron mein nahi, un jagahon par milta hai jahan log thake hue hain.

t-daayan-ilzaam.title: “Ye daayan hai” — ek ilzaam ka poora hisaab
t-daayan-ilzaam.text:
Gumla ke ek gaon mein ek vidhwa rahti thi, jo apne teen bachchon ko khud pakata, khud dhoondhti thi. Jab unka chhota beta bimaar pada aur doctors ne kuch “bada” nahi bataya, to gaon ki ek sabha ne faisla kar diya: ye aurat daayan hai. Uske baad jo hua, use ye site likh kar kabhi puri tarah dikhayegi nahi. Itna hi kaafi hai — use gaon se nikaal diya gaya, aur uske bete ko school chhodna pada.

Kaun “daayan” banta hai.

 Agar aap India ke in cases ko dekhein, ek pattern bar-bar dikhta hai. Daayan aksar woh aurat hoti hai jiske paas zameen ho, jo akeli ho, jo vidhwa ho, jo tribal ho, ya jise koi dushmani ho. Aisa koi case nahi milta jisme “daayan” koi chhota bachcha ya taakatwar aadmi ho. Ilzaam un logon par lagta hai jinhe bachana mukhil hota hai.

 Police records mein aise mamle “witchcraft accusation” ke naam se darj hote hain, aur kai rajyon mein ye alag se apradh hai — Bihar mein Prevention of Witch (Daain) Practices Act, 1999, Jharkhand mein 2001 ka kanoon, Maharashtra mein 2013 ka Anti-Superstition Act, Karnataka mein 2017 ka kanoon. Matlab: ye sirf galat nahi, ye illegal hai.

Sabse bada darr.

 Asli baat ye hai kaun aise ilzaam se sabse zyada darta hai. Wo gaon ki wahi aurat hai jo sabse pehle mandir jaati hai, jo jhaad-phook par sabse zyada bharosa karti hai. Darr usi ka sabse mehnga sauda hai.

t-rate-card.title: Tantrik ka rate card
t-rate-card.text:
“Vashikaran — 21 din, guaranteed. Pyaar, shaadi, naukri, dushmani, property — sab ka ilaaj. Consultation free. Pooja ka kharcha aapka.” Ye message mujhe teen alag numbers se aaya, teen alag shehron se, aur teenon ka rate card lagbhag same tha.

Pattern.

 Is dhandhe ka dhaancha hamesha ek jaisa hota hai. Pehle muft salah — aapki “kundli” dekh kar ek darr bataya jaata hai jo aapko lagta hai bilkul sach hai. Phir ek chhota sa kaam: “pehle ek chhota poojan karwa lijiye”. Phir ek rukaawat: “antrik shakti aa rahi hai”. Har rukaawat par ek naya bill. Aur sabse aakhir mein — jab aap thak jaate hain — “aapke bharose ki kami hai, isliye kaam nahi hua”.

 Is pattern ka naam police file mein “cheating” hai. Aur ek baat jo ise aur bhi khatarnaak banati hai: kai log apna sona, gehne, baal, ya kapde “pooja ke liye” de dete hain. Wo cheezein wapas nahi aati.

Kanoon kya kehta hai.

 India mein jaadu-tona ke naam par “guarantee” dena aur paisa lena dhokha hai — BNS/IPC ki cheating ki dharaayein, aur Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 ke tehat bimari ke “jaadu wale ilaaj” ka vigyapan bhi rok hai. Do rajyon mein anti-superstition kanoon bhi hain. Matlab: ye sirf galat nahi, ye report karne layak hai.

 Aur ek cheez jo is dhandhe ke bahar hai — asli darr. Log aise logon ke paas apni sabse zyada kamzor raat mein jaate hain: beti ki shaadi nahi ho rahi, beta nashe mein hai, ghar ka koi mar gaya. Us waqt jo aadmi aapki baat dhyan se sunta hai, wo aapka dost lagta hai.

t-siddhi-lalach.title: Aadhi raat, smashan, aur “siddhi” ka lalach
t-siddhi-lalach.text:
Bankura ke ek gaon mein ek “sadhu” ne teen ladkon ko “siddhi” ka lalach diya. Raat bhar smashan mein jaana hoga, chaalis raat, bina kisi ko bataye. Pehli raat hi ek ladka wapas nahi aaya. Subah uski laash mili — saanp ke katne se.

Lalach ka hisaab.

 “Siddhi” wala dhandha us lalach par chalta hai jo har jawaan aadmi ke andar hoti hai: koi shakti chahiye, kuch aisa jo baaki logon ke paas nahi. Aur jo aadmi aapko bhejta hai, wo khud kabhi nahi jaata. Wo aapko raat, sunsaan jagah, bina roshni, bina kisi ko bataye bhejta hai — aur us jagah jaane ka matlab hota hai saanp, kutta, gaddha, bijli ki taar, ya koi aisa aadmi jo wahan aapke jaisa hi kuch dhoondhne aaya hai.

 Is gaon mein us ladke ki maa aaj bhi kehti hai ki “usne kuch galat kiya tha isliye saanp ne kata”. Sach ye hai ki usne kuch galat nahi kiya tha — usne bus kisi ke jhooth par bharosa kiya tha.

Shakti ka asli raasta.

 Agar kisi ko kuch “bada” karna hai, to raaste khule hain — padhai, kaam, khel, kala, seva. Inmein se kisi bhi raaste par aapko raat ko smashan mein akele jaane ki zaroorat nahi padti, aur kisi par bhi jaan ka khatra nahi hota. Jo raasta aapko andheron mein akela bhejta hai, wo shakti ka raasta nahi hota. Wo sirf ek aadmi ka faayda hota hai.

 Ek forest guard ne mujhe bataya tha ki smashan aur jungle ke kinare raat mein sabse zyada saanp hote hain kyunki wahan chuhe aur mendhak hote hain. Ye wahi jagah hai jahan log “siddhi” dhoondhne jaate hain. Science ko ismein kahani ki zaroorat nahi padti.

t-bachcha-afwaah.title: “Bachche uthane wale tantrik” ki afwaah
t-bachcha-afwaah.text:
Nashik ke ek bazaar mein ek afwaah phaili: “do aadmi bachche utha rahe hain, kala jadu ke liye”. Panch minute mein bheed ikatthi ho gayi. Do aadmi — dono mazdoor, ek apne bhatije ko dhoondh rahe the — bheed ke ghere mein aa gaye. Police ne bachaya. Us raat unke ghar walon ne unhe pehchanne se pehle soch vichaar kiya.

Afwaah ka dhaancha.

 “Kala jadu ke liye bachche uthaye ja rahe hain” — ye afwaah India mein pichhle bees saal mein sabse zyada jaan lene wali afwaahon mein se hai. Iska dhaancha hamesha ek jaisa hota hai: ek ajnabi, ek bachcha, ek gaadi, ek “nishan”. Photo nahi, naam nahi, gawaah nahi — sirf darr.

 Iska sabse bada karan ye hai ki logon ko asli darr hai — aur wo darr sach mein hai. Bachchon ki tijaarat hoti hai. Bachche gum hote hain. Par jo log is dhandhe mein hote hain, wo aksar pehchan ke wale hote hain, gaadi wale nahi; aur unka maksad paisa hota hai, jaadu nahi.

Do darr, ek galti.

 Jab ek afwaah shuru hoti hai, to use rokne wala koi nahi hota. Gaon mein ek aadmi “shak” mein aa jaata hai, aur poora gaon us shak ko sach maan leta hai. Us shak ne itne logon ko maara hai ki police ko har saal is par advisory nikalni padti hai.

 Aur asli bachav? Wo photo, number plate, thana, 112, aur 1098 (Childline) se hota hai. Bheed se nahi.

bhangarh.title: Bhangarh ka shraap: India ka ghost capital
bhangarh.text:
Main Bhangarh se laut aaya tha. Phir bhi, us shaam ki ek chhoti-si baat mere saath ghar tak aa gayi: bazaar ke aakhri mod par mujhe laga tha ki koi mere peeche chal raha hai. Main ruka, toh awaaz bhi ruk gayi. Mudkar dekha toh patthar ki khaali dukaanon ke beech sirf dhoop ka ek patla tukda bacha tha. Maine tab apne dost se kuch nahi kaha. Kuch darr bol dene se kam hote hain; us waqt laga, yeh wala bol diya toh aur sach lagne lagega.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Woh shehar jahan shaam jaldi ho jaati hai.

 Hum dopahar mein pahunche the. Paani ki bottle garam ho chuki thi aur mera dost har doosre darwaze ki tasveer le raha tha. Main usse aage nikal gaya. Dono taraf dukaanon ke bache hue chabootre the. Kisi zamaane mein yahin kisi ne kapda naapte hue daam bataya hoga, kisi bachche ne mithai ke liye zid ki hogi. Ab main unhi jagahon ko paar kar raha tha, aur mere joote ki awaaz itni saaf aa rahi thi jaise main kisi ke khaali ghar mein bina poochhe ghus aaya hoon.

 Ek jagah main deewar ki thandi taraf baith gaya. Dost ne camera neeche kiya aur poochha, “Ratnavati wali kahani suni hai?” Maine haan kaha, lekin sach yeh tha ki mujhe sirf itna yaad tha: ek rajkumari, ek tantrik, aur ek shraap. Usne kahani shuru ki, aur dheere-dheere saamne ke khandahar mere dimaag mein dobara basne lage.

Ittar ki woh sheeshi.

 Lok-katha mein Ratnavati Bhangarh ki rajkumari thi. Ek tantrik usse paana chahta tha. Usne is chaahat ko pyaar ka naam diya hoga; lekin kisi ki marzi chheen lene ki ichchha mein pyaar kitna bachta hai? Kahani ke mutabiq, usne rajkumari ke liye kharide ja rahe ittar par jaadu kiya, taaki uski khushboo Ratnavati ko uske vash mein kar de.

 Main us pal ko soch raha tha: ek chhoti sheeshi, mahal ka roz ka kaam, aur usmein chhupa hua aisa iraada jiska kisi ko pata nahi. Ratnavati ko chaal ka andaaza ho gaya. Usne ittar patthar par phenk diya. Kisse mein wahi patthar tantrik ki taraf ludhakta hai aur uski jaan le leta hai. Marte hue woh Bhangarh ke vinaash ka shraap deta hai. Alag sunane waale is pal ko alag tarah batate hain; har version mein ek baat reh jaati hai—apni haar ka badla woh poore shehar se chahta hai.

 
 Uske baad ki barbaadi ko kahani shraap se jod deti hai. Lekin meri nazar mahal se neeche basti ki taraf chali gayi. Rajkumari aur tantrik ke naam sabko yaad hain. Us aadmi ka kya naam tha jo yahan roz dukaan kholta tha? Us maa ka, jo shaam ko bachche ko ghar bulaati thi? Ek shehar ujadhne ki kahani mein sabse pehle aam logon ke naam kho jaate hain.

Ek aur shart, ek aur saaya.

 Bhangarh ki doosri lok-katha Baba Balau Nath ki hai. Unki shart thi ki mahal ka saaya unke tapasya-sthal tak nahi pahunchna chahiye. Imarat unchi hui, saaya badha, aur shart toot gayi. Phir vinaash aaya. Yeh Ratnavati wale kisse ka agla adhyaay nahi, ek alag kahani hai. Magar dono mein ek ajeeb samaanta hai: koi apni seema bhoolta hai, aur uska nateeja sabko bhugatna padta hai.

 Maine saamne zameen par badhti deewar ki parchhaai dekhi. Kuch der pehle tak woh mere jooton se door thi. Ab ek joota uske andar aa chuka tha. Main bina soche uth gaya. Dost hans pada. Maine bhi hansne ki koshish ki, phir use bottle pakda di. “Chalein?”

 

Darwaze ke is paar.

 Waapsi mein wahi bazaar lamba lagne laga. Roshni kam hui toh dukaanon ke andar ka andhera ek jaisa ho gaya; pehle jo alag kamre dikhte the, ab sab ek gehri khaali jagah lag rahe the. Tabhi peeche woh kadam sunaai diya. Main ruka. Dost kuch door aage tha. Ek chhota kankad mere paas ludhak kar thehar gaya. Ho sakta hai awaaz usi ki rahi ho. Maine use uthakar dekha bhi nahi.

 Darwaze ke bahar gaadiyon ki awaaz mili toh seena halka hua. Raaste mein dost ne poochha, “Kuch mehsoos hua?” Maine kaha, “Jagah bahut khaali hai.” Woh mere jawaab se khush nahi hua. Shayad use kuch aur sunna tha.

 Raat ko tasveerein dekhte hue mujhe bazaar wali photo mili. Usmein koi saaya nahi tha, koi chehra nahi. Bas ek chabootra tha jis par kabhi koi baithta hoga. Maine photo band kar di. Bhangarh se lauta hua mera darr ab kisi bhoot ka intezaar nahi kar raha tha. Woh soch raha tha ki itne saare ghar ek din aakhri baar khule honge—aur us din kisi ko kaise pata chala hoga ki ab lautna nahi hai?

kuldhara.title: Kuldhara: ek raat mein ujad gayi basti
kuldhara.text:
Us raat mujhe sabse zyada darr registan se nahi laga tha. Darr is baat ka tha ki subah hamara ghar wahi rahega, lekin hum usmein nahi honge. Maa ne anaaj ki potli baandh li thi. Baba darwaze ki chaukhath par haath rakhe khade the. Main apni mitti ki chhoti gaadi dhoondh raha tha. Jab mili, toh maa ne kaha, “Bas yahi le sakte ho. Aur kuch haath mein mat lena.” Bachpan mein ghar chhodna shayad pehle isi tarah samajh aata hai: apni cheezon mein se ek ko chunna.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Faisla jo dheere bola gaya.

 Kuldhara ki lok-katha ko is kalpanik parivaar ki aankhon se dekho. Jaisalmer ke paas Paliwalon ki ek basti hai. Ghar paas-paas hain, aanganon ki awaazein ek-doosre tak pahunchti hain. Lekin is shaam baat karne waale bhi awaaz neeche rakh rahe hain. Bachchon ko jaldi khila diya gaya hai. Kisi ne bartan dhokar ulte nahi rakhe. Kaam ruk gaya hai, jaise sab kisi ek khabar ka intezaar kar rahe hon.

 Mashhoor kisse mein hukmraan Salim Singh ki nazar gaon ki ek ladki par padti hai. Uski ichchha ke peeche hukumat ki taaqat hai. Ladki aur uske logon ke liye mana karna sirf ek rishta thukraana nahi reh jaata. Khatra poori basti tak aa pahunchta hai. Kahani kehti hai ki log aakhir saath chhodne ka faisla karte hain: apni marzi bachane ke liye apni zameen se juda hona padega.

 Meri maa ne us ladki ka naam nahi bataya. Maine poochha bhi nahi. Darwaze par khadi meri badi behen baar-baar apna dupatta sambhaal rahi thi. Pehli baar mujhe laga ki bade log bhi kabhi-kabhi bina samjhe hue chup ho jaate hain. Unke paas jawaab nahi hota; phir bhi unhe bachchon ka haath pakadkar aage chalna hota hai.

Jo saath nahi jaa saka.

 Baba ne chulhe ke paas rakha lota uthaya, phir wapas rakh diya. Potli pehle hi bhaari thi. Maa ne deewar ki ek darar mein ungli phiraai—usi jagah, jahan barsaat ke baad mitti bhari thi. Woh darar ab bhi thi. Ghar se nikalne se pehle ka aakhri kaam bhi adhoora reh gaya.

 Bahar kisi ne dheere se awaaz di. Hum nikal aaye. Gali mein log the, lekin roz jaisa shor nahi tha. Ek bachcha neend mein apne baap ke kandhe se lagkar ro raha tha. Kisi ke haath mein chaabi thi, kisi ke haath mein paani. Ek budhiya ko do log sambhaal rahe the. Maine peeche dekha toh apna darwaza khula mila. Maa ne mera chehra aage kar diya. “Raasta dekh.”

 
 Kahani isi jagah shraap ka zikr karti hai: jaane waalon ne kaha ki yahan phir koi bas nahi paayega. Main jab yeh kissa sunta hoon, toh mujhe woh shraap gusse se zyada dukh mein bola hua lagta hai. Jaise koi apne ghar se keh raha ho—agar hum tumhare nahi rahe, toh tum kisi aur ke kaise ho jaaoge? Yeh meri padhat hai; us raat ke asli shabd hamare paas nahi hain.

Subah ko kaun bulaayega?.

 Hum ret par chalte rahe. Mujhe neend aane lagi. Maine maa se poochha, “Kal wapas aayenge?” Usne kaha, “Abhi chalo.” Tab main us jawaab ko samajh nahi saka. Bahut saal baad laga ki uske paas bhi kal ki koi tasveer nahi thi.

 Kuldhara ke khandahar dekhte hue aaj bhi us kal ko socha ja sakta hai. Ek chhota kamra, deewar ke saath baithne ki jagah, bahar nikalti gali. Yahan rehne waalon ki zindagi sirf kisi shraap ki bhoomika nahi thi. Unka kaam, unki thakan, unke roz ke jhagde aur khushiyaan bhi thi. Hum khandahar ki photo lete hain; us ghar ki aadat ko kaise tasveer mein rakhein?

 Ek hi raat mein poori basti chhod dene wala mashhoor version lok-katha hai. Bastiyan kyun khaali hoti hain, uska jawaab paani, rozgaar, dabaav aur badalti paristhitiyon mein bhi talaashna padta hai. Kuldhara ke liye koi ek saral wajah yahaan antim sach nahi kahi ja rahi.

 Meri kalpanik yaad mein us raat koi bhoot nahi dikha. Bas subah ki pehli roshni mein maa ka haath dikha tha. Uski ungliyon par hamare ghar ki mitti lagi hui thi. Usne use jhaada nahi.

mayong.title: Mayong, Assam: kahaniyon ke peeche ka gaon
mayong.text:
Main Mayong ek ajeeb sawaal lekar gaya tha: kya sach mein kisi insaan ko gaayab kiya ja sakta hai? Chai dene waale ne meri taraf dekha, phir cup mein bachi chai daal di. “Pehle baitho,” usne kaha. Uski awaaz mein na raaz tha, na dhamki. Peeche ek bachcha apni copy par kuch likh raha tha. Itni saadhaaran dopahar ke liye main taiyaar nahi tha. Maine toh safar shuru hone se pehle hi apne dimaag mein raat kar li thi.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Naam ke peeche rehne waale log.

 Assam ke Mayong ka naam jaadu aur tantra ki kahaniyon ke saath juda hua hai. Lekin jab hum kisi jagah ko sirf uski sabse daraawni kahani se pehchaante hain, toh wahan rehne waale log dheere-dheere nazar se gaayab hone lagte hain. Main bhi yahi kar raha tha. Dukaan, school jaata bachcha, kapde sukhaati aurat—sab mere liye raaste ki cheezein thi. Main kisi “asli” raaz ka intezaar kar raha tha.

 Is kalpanik mulaaqaat mein mujhe ek buzurg ke ghar le jaaya gaya. Unhone koi pradarshan nahi kiya. Ek kapde mein lipti puraani pothi kholi aur kaha ki cheezein sambhaalna bhi kaam hota hai. Maine poochha, “Ismein kya hai?” Woh panne ko ungli se dabaaye rahe, taaki hawa use palat na de. “Jo humein mila. Jo humse reh jaayega.”

 Mayong ki paramparaon mein bez kahe jaane waale paramparik practitioners ka zikr aata hai. Unse jude kisse kabhi upchaar, kabhi mantra, kabhi aisi shaktiyon ki baat karte hain jo rozmarra ke niyamon se bahar hain. In daavon ko sunna aur unhe siddh maan lena alag baatein hain. Par us kamre mein meri dilchaspi pehli baar kisi chamatkaar se hatkar ek insaan ke haath par aa gayi thi—kitni ehtiyaat se woh kaagaz pakad raha tha.

Woh kahani jo adhoori chhodi gayi.

 Shaam ko baarish aayi. Chhat ke kinaare se paani gir raha tha. Buzurg ne ek raahi ka kissa sunaya jo apni manzil bhool gaya tha. Har mod par use apne ghar ki koi cheez dikh jaati: aangan ka ped, ek pehchaana darwaza, kisi apne ki peeth. Woh paas jaata toh kuch aur nikalta. Aakhir usne chalna band kiya aur subah hone di.

 “Uske saath kisne kiya?” maine poochha.

 Buzurg ne pothi lapet di. “Tum har kahani mein kisi ko pakadna kyun chahte ho?”

 Main hansa, lekin sawaal mere saath reh gaya. Main aaya tha kisi taaqat ko pakadne, kisi chehre ko uska naam dene. Shayad mujhe yeh maan lena aasaan lagta tha ki har anjaani cheez ke peeche ek hi chhupa hua haath hai.

 

Waapsi ka raasta.

 Baarish ruki toh mitti ki khushboo bahut tez thi. Mere saath chal raha ladka apne phone ki roshni neeche rakh raha tha. Raaste mein ek awaaz hui; main turant pedon ki taraf mud gaya. Usne kaha, “Paani gir raha hai.” Mujhe apni jaldi par sharm aayi. Din bhar maine kahaniyan suni thi. Ab main har awaaz se unka saboot maang raha tha.

 Gaadi tak pahunchkar maine mudkar dekha. Ek ghar mein peeli roshni thi. Koi darwaze ke paas khada kapde nichod raha tha. Agar main chahta, toh us photo ko andhera karke kuch bhi naam de sakta tha. Maine photo nahi li.

 Mayong ka rahasya mere liye us raat khatam nahi hua. Bas uska chehra badal gaya. Ab sawaal yeh nahi tha ki yahaan kaun gaayab ho sakta hai. Sawaal tha ki ek jagah ke baare mein baar-baar ek hi kahani sunate hue hum uski kitni asli zindagi gaayab kar dete hain.

shaniwar.title: Shaniwar Wada: qile ki aawaz
shaniwar.text:
Shaniwar Wada mein main ek darwaze ke saamne zaroorat se zyada der khada raha. Mere aas-paas log tasveerein le rahe the. Kisi ne bachche ko kinaare hone ko kaha; kisi ka phone baja. Sab kuch din ke ujale mein tha. Phir bhi, Narayanrao ki kahani sunne ke baad mujhe har darwaza ek hi sawaal jaisa lag raha tha: jab koi jaan bachaakar aapki taraf bhaage, toh aap kis taraf khade hote hain?

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Mahal ke andar ka darr.

 Narayanrao ki 1773 mein hui hatya Shaniwar Wada ke itihaas ka hissa hai. Is ghatna ke aas-paas saazish, satta aur parivaar ke tanaav ki bahut-si baatein kahi gayi hain. Lekin us itihaas ko lok-katha mein badalne waali cheez ek pukaar hai: “Kaka, mala vachva”—Kaka, mujhe bachao.

 Aage ka drishya usi riwaayat ka kalpanik punarkathan hai. Mahal ka ek raasta socho jise ek naujawan bachpan se jaanta hai. Kaunsa mod kis kamre tak jaata hai, kis dehleez par pair sambhaalna padta hai—use sab yaad hai. Aaj usi pehchaan par uski jaan tiki hui hai. Peeche kadam tez ho rahe hain. Woh mudkar dekhna chahta hai, lekin mudne mein bhi waqt lagega.

 Us pal uska pad, uski gaddi, uska naam usse bachane nahi aa sakte. Use ek apna chahiye. Woh apne kaka ko bulaata hai. Awaaz mein hukm nahi, bharosa hai—wahi bharosa jisse hum bachpan mein kisi bade ko pukaarte hain aur maan lete hain ki ab kuch bura nahi hoga.

Ek awaaz ka reh jaana.

 Mujhe is kahani ka yahi hissa sabse bhaari lagta hai. Hum aksar uske baad kya hua, uski daraawni tafseel dhoondhte hain. Lekin main pukaar aur jawaab ke beech ki jagah par atak jaata hoon. Woh chhota-sa waqt, jab bulaane waala abhi ummeed kar raha hota hai. Jab use abhi nahi pata hota ki madad aayegi ya nahi.

 Lok-katha kehti hai ki woh pukaar Wada mein lautti hai. Log use raat se, khaamoshi se, kabhi poornima se jodte hain. Magar kisi awaaz ki kahani dohraayi jaana us awaaz ka pramaan nahi. Jo itihaas mein hua, aur jo baad mein uske baare mein mehsoos kiya gaya, dono ko ek hi cheez keh dena us dukh ko bhi badal deta hai.

 Main jis deewar ke paas khada tha, us par dhoop sarak rahi thi. Ek chhota ladka apne pita se aage nikal gaya. Pita ne uska naam liya. Woh palatkar daudta hua wapas aaya aur unka haath pakad liya. Bahut saadhaaran baat thi. Phir bhi main use dekhta reh gaya.

Ghar lautne ki awaaz.

 Baad mein jab hum bahar aaye, dost ne poochha ki mujhe kuch sunaai diya tha kya. Maine mana kiya. Main koi awaaz sunne nahi aaya tha, aur koi recording mere paas nahi thi. Lekin ek baat thi jo main seedhe keh nahi paaya: kuch jagahon par darr isliye nahi lagta ki wahan koi anjaan maujood hai. Darr isliye lagta hai ki kabhi wahan apne maujood the, aur phir bhi koi akela reh gaya.

 Us shaam ghar pahunchkar maa ne doosre kamre se bulaaya. Main aam taur par “aaya” kehkar phone dekhta rehta hoon. Is baar turant uth gaya. Shaniwar Wada ki kahani mere saath kisi bhoot ki tarah nahi aayi thi. Woh bas ek chhoti-si aadat badal gayi: koi apna bulaaye, toh jawaab dene mein der mat karo.

nishi.title: Nishi Daak: raat ki wo awaaz jo naam leti hai
nishi.text:
Maa ne mujhe pehli baar bulaaya toh main neend mein hi “haan” kehne waala tha. Awaaz aangan se aayi thi—bilkul usi tarah, jaise woh subah doodh lene bhejte waqt bulaati thi. Mera haath chadar se bahar nikla. Phir bagal ki charpai ki rassi hili. Maa mere paas so rahi thi. Uski saans ki awaaz mujhe saaf sunaai de rahi thi.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Do baar mera naam.

 Main kuch der seedha leta raha. Neend ka ek hissa abhi bhi mujhse keh raha tha ki galat suna hai. Bahar baarish band ho chuki thi. Chhat se girti boondein aangan mein rakhi baalti par pad rahi thi. Uske beech dobara mera naam aaya. Is baar thoda dheere, jaise bulaane waali nahi chahti ki ghar mein koi aur jaag jaaye.

 Maine maa ka kandha chhua. Usne aankhein khole bina poochha, “Kya hua?” Main jawaab nahi de paaya. Mujhe uski awaaz abhi bahar bhi sunaai di thi. Usne mera chehra dekha toh uthkar baith gayi. Maine darwaze ki taraf ishaara kiya. Hum dono chup ho gaye.

 Bengal ki Nishi Daak ki lok-katha isi pehchaan se darr banaati hai. Raat ki pukaar kisi ajnabi ki nahi hoti. Woh kisi apne ki awaaz leti hai. Kisse ke kuch versions mein kaha jaata hai ki pukaar ginne se dhokha pehchaana ja sakta hai; doosron mein niyam badal jaata hai. Is kahani ke ghar mein bas itna sikhaaya gaya tha: pehle dekho ki tumhe bulaane waala hai kaun.

Kundi tak ka faasla.

 Bahar se ek halki khurach aayi. Shayad geeli daali darwaze se lagi thi. Maine socha, agar koi sach mein madad maang raha ho? Baba ghar par nahi the. Kya woh laut aaye hain? Dimaag ko ek theek wajah chahiye thi, aur woh jaldi-jaldi wajah bana raha tha.
