 Main uthkar darwaze tak gaya. Neeche ki daraar se bas andhera dikh raha tha. Kundi thandi thi. Use chhoone se pehle maa ne meri kalai pakad li. Zor se nahi. Bas itna ki mera haath ruk jaaye. Main uski taraf muda. Usne mere paas aakar kaha, “Pehle yahin se poochho.”

 
 Maine bahar awaaz di. Jawaab nahi aaya. Phir maine poochha ki kaun hai. Sirf baalti mein boond giri. Jo pukaar itni apni lagi thi, uske paas mere sawaal ka ek bhi jawaab nahi tha. Hum darwaze se hat gaye. Maa ne diya thoda paas kar liya. Bachi hui raat humne baat karte hue bitaayi—khet ki, rishtedaaron ki, agle din ke kaam ki. Woh chhoti baatein us waqt ghar ki deewaron jaisi lag rahi thi.

Subah ka aangan.

 Ujale mein aangan chhota nikla. Darwaze ke paas koi nishaan nahi tha. Ek daali neeche jhuki hui thi; hawa mein hilne par lakdi se lagti thi. Maa ne use hata diya. Main sochta raha ki aadhi neend, baarish aur pehle se suni kahani milkar kitna kuch bana sakti hain. Mujhe aaj bhi nahi pata ki us raat maine kya suna hota—kyunki yeh Nishi ki lok-katha ka kalpanik anubhav hai, kisi gawah ki report nahi.

 Lekin kahani ka woh pal aasaani se nahi jaata. Andhere se koi tumhara naam le, toh tum awaaz se pehle rishta pehchaante ho. Nishi ka darr usi chhote-se bharose mein rehta hai. Kundi abhi band hai. Tumhara haath us tak pahunch chuka hai.

naalebaa.title: Naale Baa: deewaron par likhi ek prarthana
naalebaa.text:
Subah darwaza khola toh saamne waale ghar par safed akshar likhe the: Naale Baa. Dopahar tak gali ke chaar aur darwazon par wahi shabd aa gaye. Shaam ko maa ne mujhse chalk mangwaayi. Maine kaha, “Aap bhi?” Usne mere haath se chalk le li. “Likh dene se kya jaata hai?” Mujhe tab laga tha ki darrne waale humse alag log hote hain. Raat tak meri yeh galatfahmi door ho gayi.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Gali mein pahunchi khabar.

 Kannada mein Naale Baa ka matlab hai “kal aana.” Bengaluru se judi is shehri lok-katha mein darwaze par likhe yeh shabd raat ko aane waali aatma ko agle din lautne ke liye kehte hain. Jab woh kal aaye, tab bhi uske liye kal hi likha mile. Is chhote-se taalne mein kahani apna bachav dhoondhti hai.

 Hamaari kalpanik gali mein khabar kisi ek aadmi ke paas nahi thi. Dukaan waala kehta tha ki usne paas ke mohalle mein suna hai. Paas ke mohalle ka aadmi kehta tha ki uske rishtedaar ke yahan hua hai. Kisi ke mutabiq aurat apne ki awaaz mein bulaati thi; kisi ke mutabiq bas dastak deti thi. Chehra kisi ne theek se nahi dekha tha. Lekin har agla sunane waala pichhle se zyada yakeen mein tha.

 Maa ne likha toh chalk ka tukda beech mein toot gaya. Main use uthaane jhuka. Bahar se aata hua ek padosi ruk gaya. “Hamare yahan bhi kar dena,” usne kaha. Woh wahi aadmi tha jo dopahar ko sab par hans raha tha. Humne uski taraf dekha bhi nahi. Kuch darr aise hote hain jinmein ek-doosre ki sharm bacha lena aasaan lagta hai.

Pehli dastak.

 Raat ko kundi hilli. Main turant uth baitha, lekin maa mujhse pehle jaag rahi thi. Doosri taraf se mere bhai ki awaaz aayi. Woh kaam se der se lauta tha. Roz ka waqt tha; roz ka andaaz bhi. Phir bhi maa ne darwaza nahi khola.

 “Phone karo,” usne mujhse kaha.

 Maine number milaaya. Bahar phone baja. Bhai ne uthaakar poochha ki kya hua. Us ek chhoti-si tasdeeq ke baad maa ne kundi kholi. Woh andar aaya toh hansne laga, phir hamaare chehre dekhkar ruk gaya. Usne khaana maanga. Maa thaali laane gayi aur main darwaze par khada safed akshar dekhta raha. Mujhe laga, darr ka sabse bada kaam yahi hai: woh pehchaani awaaz ko bhi pehli baar suna hua bana deta hai.

Kal jo aata hi nahi.

 Agle din kuch nahi hua. Uske agle din bhi nahi. Dheere-dheere log der tak bahar baithne lage. Bachche phir gali mein khelne lage. Darwaze par likha raha. Baarish ne pehle ek akshar halka kiya, phir doosra. Kisi ne use dobara gehra nahi kiya.

 Kaafi baad ghar ki putai hui. Rang waale ne poochha ki yeh likha hua bhi mita de? Maa ne kaha, “Haan.” Main paas khada tha. Mujhe us raat par hansi nahi aa rahi thi. Mujhe yaad tha ki bhai ke phone ki ghanti sunte hi hum dono ne ek saath saans chhodi thi.

 Naale Baa ki kahani mein aatma har roz kal ke liye taal di jaati hai. Hamaari gali mein, shayad, log ek-doosre se keh rahe the: aaj ki raat kisi tarah nikal jaaye. Kal hum thoda kam darenge.

yakshi.title: Yakshi: nariyal ke ped ke neeche khadi aurat
yakshi.text:
Usne raasta nahi poochha. Bas kaha, “Thodi door saath chaloge?” Main pehle hi der se laut raha tha. Kerala ki us kalpanik pagdandi par baarish ke baad mitti naram thi, aur mere jooton mein paani ghus chuka tha. Phir bhi main ruk gaya. Uski awaaz mein aisa kuch tha jo mana karne ko badtameezi bana raha tha. Ghar pahunchne ki jaldi ek pal ko bhool gaya.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Ped ke neeche.

 Woh ped ki aadhi chhaon mein khadi thi. Maine uska chehra saaf nahi dekha; bas halki saari aur kandhe tak aate baal. Usne ek taraf ishaara kiya. Main us raaste ko jaanta tha—ya mujhe aisa laga. Din mein wahan se kuch ghar dikhte the. Ab patton ke beech sirf andhera tha.

 Bachpan mein suni yakshi ki kahani mujhe tab yaad nahi aayi. Jab hum kahani sunte hain toh sochte hain ki hum nishaan turant pehchaan lenge. Par asli uljhan ki tarah likhe is drishya mein koi bada sanket nahi tha. Ek insaan ne saath maanga tha. Maine haan keh di thi.

 Kerala ki lok-kathaon mein yakshi ke kai roop hain. Kuch daraawni kahaniyon mein woh raahi ko apni taraf kheenchti hai, pehchaane raaste se door le jaati hai. Lekin yakshi ka vishaal saanskritik roop sirf is ek bhayankar chhavi mein sama nahi jaata. Yeh kissa usi horror waale roop se prerit hai, har yakshi-parampara ka parichay nahi.

Ghar ki roshni.

 Hum chale toh mujhe ek khidki dikhne lagi. Uske andar peeli roshni thi. Maine poochha, “Wahi ghar hai?” Usne haan nahi kaha. Bas chalti rahi. Khidki jitni paas aani chahiye thi, utni aayi nahi. Maine apne kadam gine; phir khud par hansne ka mann hua. Thakan mein aadmi ajeeb kaam karta hai.

 Thodi der baad usne poochha, “Ghar mein tumhara intezaar kaun kar raha hai?”

 Maine maa ka naam liya. Yeh kehte hi mujhe yaad aaya ki maine ghar phone nahi kiya tha. Main ruka. Phone ki roshni jalaayi. Saamne khidki nahi thi. Do geele patton ke beech door ki roshni atki hui thi. Pagdandi ka kinaara mere pair se bahut paas tha. Neeche paani ki halki awaaz aa rahi thi.

 Maine uski taraf dekha. Woh ped ke us paar thi, ya shayad wahan koi tha hi nahi. Is kalpanik kisse ka darr us ek nazar mein hai: hum jis cheez ko saath chalne waala samajh rahe the, uski jagah khaali bhi ho sakti hai.

Jo yaad ghar laayi.

 Main wapas muda. Jaldi mein bhaaga nahi; har kadam neeche dekhkar rakha. Main us pal ko koi badi bahaaduri nahi keh sakta. Mujhe bas ghar ki rasoi yaad aa gayi thi, aur thaali dhak kar rakhne ki maa ki aadat.

 Yakshi ke kisse aksar yahin khatam nahi hote. Kuch mein raahi bachta hai, kuch mein nahi. Mere version mein woh ghar pahunchta hai aur apni der ka bahaana banaata hai. Raat ki poori baat bol nahi paata, kyunki bolte hi use khud poochhna padega ki woh kis ke saath chal raha tha.

 Agle din us raaste par ek aurat mile toh woh use bhoot nahi samajhta. Woh jaanta hai ki yeh kahani hai. Lekin uske baad se der ho jaaye toh ghar phone zaroor karta hai—kabhi-kabhi kisi apne ki saadhaaran awaaz hi humein apna raasta yaad dilaati hai.

chudail.title: Chudail / Daayan: darr ka chehra auraton ka kyun hota hai
chudail.text:
Dadi kahani sunate waqt sabse pehle diye ki baati chhoti karti thi. Main kehta, “Roshni kyun kam kar rahi ho?” Woh kehti, “Tel bachega.” Mujhe lagta tha ki woh jaan-boojhkar andhera kar rahi hai. Phir woh khet ke paas waale ped ki baat shuru karti, aur main apne pair charpai par upar kar leta. Uski kahani mein ek aurat hoti thi. Uska naam kabhi nahi hota tha.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Pair jinhe dekhna nahi tha.

 Dadi ke kisse ka raahi mela dekhkar laut raha tha. Jeb mein bache do sikke aapas mein bajte the. Woh thaka hua tha aur ghar ki roti soch raha tha. Ped ke neeche ek aurat ne use roka. “Aage tak chhod doge?” usne poochha. Raahi ne bina soche haan kar di.

 Kuch door chalne par use ajeeb laga ki aurat ke kadam ki awaaz uski chaal se nahi mil rahi. Jab woh rukta, do kadam aur padte. Jab chalta, awaaz der se shuru hoti. Woh neeche dekhna chahta tha, lekin andhera tha. Aur phir, kahani mein, baadal hata. Chaand ki roshni mein usne pair dekhe—ulte.

 Yahin main dadi ka haath pakad leta. Woh thoda rukti, mujhe paani deti, phir aage sunaati. Raahi ne bhaagne ke bajaay saamne door jalta diya dekha aur usi taraf chalna jaari rakha. Aurat uske kaan ke paas kuch kehti rahi. Dadi uski baat kabhi poori nahi bataati thi. Woh kehti, “Jo suna hi nahi, use dohraayenge kaise?”

 

Subah kisi aur ka naam.

 Raahi ki kahani ka ant har baar badal jaata. Kabhi woh mandir pahunchta, kabhi ghar; kabhi subah log use raaste mein paate. Lekin mere liye uska ek doosra ant tha. Agle din main gali ki ek akeli rehne waali aurat ko dekhkar usse bachkar nikal gaya. Uske baal khule the. Bas itni-si baat mere bachpan ke dimaag ko kaafi lagi.

 Dadi ne dekh liya. Usne mujhe waapas bulaaya aur us aurat ko paani diya. Phir mere saamne usse ghar ki chhat ki marammat ke baare mein baat karti rahi. Woh dono hansin bhi. Mujhe samajh nahi aa raha tha ki raat ki kahani aur dopahar ki yeh baat ek hi duniya mein kaise hain.

 Aur jab woh aurat chali gayi, dadi ne kaha, “Kahani ka darr kisi insaan ke peeche mat laga dena.” Is punarkathan mein mujhe sabse zaroori wahi line lagti hai. Usne kahani ka maza nahi chheena. Usne bas uski seema bata di.

Darr ko uska ghar do.

 Chudail aur daayan ke naam alag ilaakon mein alag maayne aur kahaniyan lete hain; unhe ek hi tayashuda roop kehna sahi nahi. Yahan ulte pair waala drishya ek kalpanik horror-kissa hai. Kisi ki shakal, akelapan, umr ya zindagi ki mushkil uske khilaaf saboot nahi banti.

 Aaj bhi kabhi hawa se darwaza hile toh dadi ki awaaz yaad aa jaati hai. Main ek pal ko pair samet leta hoon, phir uthkar kundi dekh leta hoon. Kahani mere andar ab bhi zinda hai. Bas ab uska koi padosi nahi hai jise main uska naam de doon.

muhnochwa.title: Muhnochwa: 2002 ka 'chehra nochne wala'
muhnochwa.text:
Raat ko chhat par lete hue main pehle taaron ko dekhta tha. Us garmi mein main sirf roshni dhoondhta tha—koi chhoti-si chamak jo achanak meri taraf aaye. Neeche se maa ne bulaaya ki andar aa jaao. Kamra bhatti ki tarah garam tha. Chhat par hawa thi, lekin ab neend nahi thi. Kisi ne ek naam de diya tha, aur us naam ne khula aasmaan bhi chhota kar diya tha: Muhnochwa.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Khabar jo har ghar mein badli.

 2002 mein Uttar Pradesh se judi Muhnochwa ki khabrein aur afwaahein is kisse ka sandarbh hain. Neeche ka parivaar kalpanik hai. Unki gali mein pehli khabar chai ki dukaan par aayi: kisi par raat mein kuch jhapta. Doosre aadmi ne roshni jodi. Teesre ne kaha ki woh chehra nochta hai. Shaam tak har kisi ke paas uski shakal thi, aur koi do shaklein ek jaisi nahi thi.

 Baba ne kaha, “Suni-sunaai baat hai.” Phir unhone torch mein naye cell daale. Maine unhe dekh liya. Unhone mujhe dekh liya. Hum dono ne kuch nahi kaha. Ghar ke bade aksar bachchon ko bharosa dene ki koshish mein apna darr chupaa lete hain; kabhi-kabhi bas torch ki nayi roshni use zahir kar deti hai.

Roshni ka chhota tukda.

 Us raat gali ke doosre sire se cheekh aayi. Main charpai se uchhal kar khada hua. Saamne ki chhat par koi torch ghuma raha tha. Uski roshni meri aankhon par padi aur ek pal ke liye mujhe kuch nahi dikha. Main peeche hata. Baba ne meri baanh pakad li. Munder meri soch se zyada paas thi.

 Neeche log poochh rahe the ki kya hua. Har jawaab mein “suna hai” tha, lekin bolne ka andaaz “dekha hai” waala hota ja raha tha. Kisi ne kaha ki agle mohalle mein hamla hua. Agle mohalle se aaye aadmi ne kaha ki usne toh hamaari taraf ki awaaz suni thi. Khabar ghoomkar apne shuru hone ki jagah dhoondh rahi thi, aur use woh jagah nahi mil rahi thi.

 Maa mujhe neeche le gayi. Baba bhi aa gaye. Unhone torch mez par rakhi; roshni chhat ki taraf thi. Pankhe ki thami hui parchhaai deewar par badi lag rahi thi. Maine poochha, “Aapne dekha?” Unhone der se kaha, “Nahi.” Mujhe us raat unka yeh chhota jawaab sabse sachcha laga.

Naam se pehle nishaan.

 Shikayat, chot aur ghabraahat ko suna jaana chahiye. Lekin ek hi naam ke neeche aayi har baat ka ek hi kaaran maan lena bhi galat hai. Is ghatna ke baare mein alag vyakhyaayein di gayi hain; yahaan kisi ki chot ka door se diagnosis nahi kiya ja raha. Udte praani ki lokpriya tasveer ko pramaan samajhne ka aadhaar nahi hai.

 Kuch din baad hamaari kalpanik gali dobara der tak jaagne lagi—ab baatcheet ke liye. Main phir chhat par soya. Hawa aayi toh neend bhi aayi. Baba ne jaane se pehle charpai munder se door kar di.

 Mujhe koi chamakta jeev nahi mila. Mujhe apni baanh par baba ki ungliyon ka dabaav yaad raha. Us raat jis cheez ne mujhe girne se roka tha, uska naam Muhnochwa nahi tha. Woh ek aadmi tha jo mere paas khada tha, aur jisne waqt par haath badha diya.

pichhla.title: Pichhla Bhoot: peeche reh gayi aahat
pichhla.text:
Peeche se aayi aahat pehli baar mujhe bazaar se lautte hue sunaai di. Main ruki toh woh bhi ruk gayi. Mudkar dekha, gali khaali thi. Us raat maine ghar mein kuch nahi bataya. Agli subah padosan ne kaha ki kisi aur ko bhi aisa laga tha. Do baatein milin, phir unke beech ek naam aa gaya: Pichhla Bhoot. Naam milte hi aahat zyada saaf sunaai dene lagi—chahe bahar kuch bhi na ho.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Darwaze band hone lage.

 Yeh ek kalpanik gaon ki kahani hai, kisi darj police case ka punarnirmaan nahi. Yahan log ek-doosre ko pehchaante hain, phir bhi afwaah ke liye kaafi jagah hai. Kisi ne chhat par saaya dekha. Kisi ne kaha ki uski choti ke paas kuch chhua. Teesre ne daawa kiya ki ek aurat ke baal kat gaye. Jab us aurat se poochha gaya, toh pata chala ki baat kisi doosre ghar ki thi.

 Lekin sawaal jawaab se tez chal rahe the. Shaam ko meri chhoti behen ne khidki band kar di. Maa ne use khola, kyunki andar garmi thi, phir kuch der baad khud band kar diya. Mujhe gussa aa raha tha ki kisi anjaani cheez ne hamaare ghar ka roz ka tareeka badal diya. Saath hi main khidki ke paas baithna nahi chahti thi.

Kiski awaaz thi?.

 Ek raat bahar halchal hui. Kuch log ek ajnabi aadmi se sawaal kar rahe the. Woh kisi ka pata dhoondh raha tha; uski boli hamaare ilaake ki nahi thi. Kisi ne dheere se wahi naam kaha. Bas ek shabd, lekin uske baad log aur paas aa gaye.

 Mere baba bahar nikle. Unhone aadmi ko bithaaya, paani diya aur jis ghar ka pata tha, wahan kisi ko bulaane bheja. Thodi der mein uska rishtedaar aa gaya. Ajnabi chala gaya. Gali waale bhi laut gaye. Koi badi ghatna nahi hui. Phir bhi us raat mujhe der tak neend nahi aayi. Sochti rahi, agar woh rishtedaar ghar par nahi milta toh?

 Maine pehli aahat ke baare mein baba ko bataaya. Unhone na mera mazaak banaaya, na turant uska naam rakha. Poochha ki kahan thi, kitna ujala tha, kisi ko dekha tha ya sirf suna tha. Yeh sawaal kahani jaise nahi lagte the. Inmein romaanch kam tha. Lekin bolte-bolte mujhe apni baat ka woh hissa samajh aaya jo mujhe maaloom tha, aur woh hissa bhi jo main baad mein jod rahi thi.

Mere peeche kya reh gaya.

 Afwaah dheere-dheere kam hui. Khidki phir khulne lagi. Main behen ke saath bazaar gayi. Usi mod par aahat sunaai di toh dono palte. Ek kutta hamaare peeche aa raha tha. Hum hase, lekin maine is ek baat se har puraani shikayat ka jawaab nahi bana diya.

 Is kahani mein bhoot pakda nahi gaya, aur koi chhupa hua hamlaavar bhi lekhak ki taraf se ghoshit nahi kiya ja raha. Ant mein ek ladki bas apna raasta dobara istemal karna seekhti hai. Woh dhyaan rakhti hai, zaroorat par madad maangti hai, aur jo nahi dekha uske baare mein “nahi dekha” kehti hai.

 Ab kabhi peeche aahat ho toh main mudkar dekhti hoon. Darr ab bhi hota hai. Bas main use kisi bekasoor ka naam nahi deti.

bhulona.title: Bhulona: wo raasta jo lauta deta hai
bhulona.text:
Teesri baar kuaan dikha toh maine lantern zameen par rakh di. Main wahi raasta chal raha tha jahan bachpan mein bina chappal dauda tha. Din mein aankhein band karke ghar pahunchne ka ghamand tha mujhe. Ab raat mein aankhein khuli thin, aur main apne ghar se door tha ya paas, yeh bhi nahi bata paa raha tha.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Bas ek mod aur.

 Khet se nikalte waqt der ho gayi thi. Maine socha, lamba pakka raasta kyun loon? Med se nikal jaaunga. Ghar par roti rakhi hogi. Pehle mod tak sab theek tha. Doosre par laga ki ped kuch alag jagah hai. Main ruka nahi. Thaka aadmi apni pehli galti maanne mein der karta hai, kyunki maanne ka matlab hota hai wapas chalna.

 Phir kuaan aaya. Uske kinaare ka toota hissa pehchaana hua tha. Maine khud se kaha ki galat taraf nikal gaya. Peeche muda, ek doosri med pakdi aur kadam tez kar diye. Thodi der baad lantern ki roshni mein wahi toota kinaara ubhar aaya.

 Is baar maine kuaan chhooa. Jaise haath se jaanch lene par pata chal jaayega ki yeh pehla waala hai ya koi aur. Patthar thanda tha. Mere haath par nami lagi. Main hasna chahta tha. Awaaz gale mein hi atak gayi.

Apne hi kadmon ka ghera.

 Gaon ke kisse mein aise bhatkaave ko Bhulona ya Bhulauna kaha jaata hai. Kahin ek adrishya saathi raasta badal deta hai; kahin ek hi mod baar-baar laut aata hai. Koi kapda ulta pehenne ki baat karta hai. Yeh kahani ke niyam hain, raasta milne ki bharosemand vidhi nahi.

 Mere kalpanik raahi ko bhi dadi ki kahi baat yaad aayi. Usne kurta kheenchkar dekha, phir haath neeche kar liya. Use pehli baar mehsoos hua ki woh bahut tez saans le raha hai. Kaafi der se chala aa raha tha, lekin soch nahi raha tha. Har baar bas is yakeen ke saath mod leta ki abki baar ghar zaroor hoga.

 Main kuaan se door ek saaf jagah baith gaya. Lantern paas rakh li. Paani ka aakhri ghunt piya. Door se kisi engine ki awaaz aayi, phir band hui. Maine apna naam zor se nahi pukaara; gaon ki taraf madad ke liye awaaz di. Jawaab nahi mila. Kuch der baad phir di. Is baar bahut door se awaaz lauti.

Raasta subah ne nahi, aadmi ne dikhaya.

 Mujhe lene aaya aadmi mera padosi tha. Usne poochha ki main idhar kyun baitha hoon. Maine kuaan dikhaya. Usne roshni ghumaa kar doosri taraf ki med bataayi. Main uske peeche chala. Ghar itna paas nikla ki mujhe aur sharm aayi. Usne meri lantern pakad li aur kaha, “Pehle khaana kha lena.” Usne kahani nahi maangi.

 Subah wapas gaya toh mod saaf the. Raat ko jo ek deewar jaisi dikhti fasal thi, uske beech raasta khula tha. Andhera aur thakan ek sambhav vyakhya hain; yeh kahani kisi vyakti ki medical jaanch nahi. Bhulona ka apna lok-katha waala roop alag hai.

 Uske baad maine us raaste ko chhod nahi diya. Bas der ho toh apni pehchaan par itna ghamand nahi karta. Mujhe kuaan yaad rehta hai. Aur usse bhi zyada woh waqt, jab maine pehli baar chalna band kiya—aur tabhi ghar lautna shuru hua.

datiyana.title: Datiyana: 'Bhootonwala Mandir'
datiyana.text:
Maine socha tha “Bhootonwala Mandir” ke paas pahunchkar log awaaz dheemi kar denge. Lekin subah wahan pahunchte hi ghanti sunaai di. Ek aadmi pooja karke laut raha tha. Kisi ne jhaadu ek taraf rakha tha. Main apne saath jo daraawna drishya laaya tha, usmein yeh rozmarra ki shaanti fit nahi ho rahi thi.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Eenton ke paas khada sawaal.

 Datiyana, Hapur, Uttar Pradesh ka yeh mandir ek aisi lok-katha se juda hai jisme bhoot vinaash karne nahi, nirmaan karne aate hain. Mashhoor riwaayat kehti hai ki mandir ek raat mein bana. Mandir ka hona aur uske banne ka yeh kissa do alag baatein hain. Meri yatra aur neeche ki baatcheet ek kalpanik narration hain.

 Main eenton ko dekh raha tha. Kisi imarat ko door se dekhne par uska roop dikhta hai; paas jaao toh chhote faisle dikhne lagte hain—ek satah, ek kona, ek jod. Maine paas baithe buzurg se poochha, “Raat mein ban gaya tha?” Unhone meri taraf dekha. “Yahi kahani hai,” bole. Unhone “maine dekha tha” nahi kaha. Farq chhota tha, lekin mujhe sunaai diya.

Raat ki kalpana.

 Phir maine us raat ko apne dimaag mein banaaya. Gaon so raha hai. Kisi ghar mein bachcha karvat badalta hai. Bahar bahut halki aahat hai, jaise koi ek eent doosri ke paas rakh raha ho. Ek aur, phir ek aur. Na kisi mazdoor ki pukaar, na kisi ka naam. Bas kaam badhta ja raha hai.

 Is kalpanik drishya mein ek aadmi neend se uthta hai, darwaze tak aata hai, phir ruk jaata hai. Use darr bhi hai aur jaanne ki ichchha bhi. Woh darwaza nahi kholta. Subah bahar nikalta hai toh us jagah ek imarat khadi milti hai jahan kal usne khula aasmaan dekha tha. Kahani sunne waala uske saath hairaan hota hai. Phir sawaal aata hai: jo haath dikhe nahi, unka naam kaun bataayega?

 Yeh drishya lekhak ki kalpana hai. Lekin isse mujhe lok-katha ki ek khoobi samajh aati hai. Kabhi kahani kisi cheez ka jawaab dene se zyada uske saamne rukna sikhaati hai. Purani imarat itni aasaan nahi thi jitni door se dikh rahi thi. Use banaane mein kisi ka hunar laga hoga, kisi ka waqt.

Jahan log darne nahi aate.

 Buzurg uthkar andar chale gaye. Main bahar reh gaya. Ek parivaar aaya; bachche ne poochha ki ghanti baja sakta hai kya. Uski maa ne use utha diya. Ghanti ki awaaz hawa mein phaili. Yeh unka pooja ka sthaan tha. Mere liye sirf ek horror location maan lena bahut chhoti nazar hoti.

 Lautte waqt maine mandir ko phir dekha. Mujhe koi saaya nahi dikha. Lekin ab main eenton ke peeche kuch aur soch raha tha: un logon ko jinke naam hum bhool gaye, aur un kahaniyon ko jo bhoolne ki jagah bhar deti hain.

 Datiyana ka kissa mere liye ek sawaal par thehra—agar humne banaane waalon ko yaad nahi rakha, toh kya unke kaam ko dekhkar hairaan rehna bhi ek tarah ki der se aayi izzat hai?

vetala.title: Vikram aur Vetala: ek jawaab ki keemat
vetala.text:
Laash ka wazan pehli baar uthaate hue Vikram ko jitna laga tha, waapsi mein usse zyada lag raha tha. Kandhe par kapda bheeg chuka tha. Peeche pedon ki shaakhein hil rahi thi. Raja ne kadam sambhaale. Use bas ek kaam karna tha: is deh ko le jaana, aur raaste bhar chup rehna. Tab uske kaan ke bilkul paas awaaz aayi—“Raja, raasta lamba hai. Ek kahani sunoge?”

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Jawaab ki keemat.

 Vikram aur Vetala ki kathaaon ke kai roop milte hain. Is punarkathan mein wahi parichit dhaancha hai: deh mein Vetala, use laata raja, aur raaste mein poochha gaya sawaal. Jawaab jaante hue chup rehne par anisht ki shart hai; jawaab dene par maun tootega aur Vetala laut jaayega. Raja ko sirf bal se nahi, apne vivek se bhi parakha jaata hai.

 Is baar Vetala jo kahani sunaata hai, woh is edition ke liye likhi gayi ek nayi paheli hai. Ek kasbe mein raat ko anaaj ka godaam jalne lagta hai. Pahredaar ke paas uski chaabi hai. Andar se ek aadmi ki awaaz aati hai. Pahredaar jaanta hai ki koi andar hona nahi chahiye. Shayad chor hai. Darwaza khole toh anaaj lootne ka khatra hai; band rakhe toh aadmi mar sakta hai.

 Woh darwaza kholta hai. Aadmi bach nikalta hai. Kuch anaaj bhi log utha le jaate hain. Subah maalik pahredaar ko doshi kehta hai. Pahredaar apni galti nahi chhupaata: usne darwaza khola tha. Lekin woh yeh bhi kehta hai ki us waqt use ek awaaz sunaai di thi, aur us awaaz ka jawaab dena tha.

Raja bol pada.

 Vetala poochhta hai, “Kya pahredaar ne apna kartavya toda? Usse godaam bachaane ko rakha gaya tha.”

 Vikram kuch kadam chup chalta hai. Use shart yaad hai. Phir woh kehta hai ki jaan bachaana us pal pehla kartavya tha. Chori ki jaanch baad mein ho sakti thi; aag mein mar chuke insaan se baad mein koi sawaal nahi poochha ja sakta. Darwaza kholna aur chori karna ek hi kaam nahi. Ek ko doosre ka dosh dekar nyaay nahi hoga.

 Kandhe par wazan halka hua. Hansi sunaai di. Vikram ko samajh aa gaya ki phir bol pada hai. Vetala ped ki taraf laut chuka tha. Raja kuch pal wahin khada raha, phir wapas muda. Uske jawaab ne kisi khel ko nahi jeeta tha. Phir bhi woh use wapas nahi leta.

Aakhri mod.

 Paramparik katha-chakra ke ant ki taraf Vetala raja ko us tapasvi ki chhupi chaal se saavdhaan karta hai jisne use deh laane bheja tha. Raja aakhir sirf aadesh maanne se nahi, samajhkar faisla lene se bachta hai. Alag versions mein vivaran badalte hain; yahaan unhe ek hi aitihasik ghatna nahi maana gaya.

 Mujhe is kahani mein ped se latakti deh se zyada woh baar-baar palatkar chalta aadmi yaad rehta hai. Thaka hua, jhunjhlaaya hua, phir bhi ek kathin sawaal ka aasaan galat jawaab dene ko taiyaar nahi. Vetala uski raah rokta hai, lekin usi raaste par uski soch bhi saaf hoti hai.

 Raat khatam hoti hai. Kissa band hota hai. Sawaal phir bhi paas baitha rehta hai: agar sahi jawaab dene se tumhara kaam aur mushkil ho jaaye, tab bhi kya tum use bologe?

monkeyman.title: Monkey Man: Delhi, 2001
monkeyman.text:
Dilli ki us garmi mein hum chhat par sote the. Neeche kamre ki deewarein din bhar ki dhoop chhodti rehti thin. Upar kam se kam hawa thi. Phir ek raat pados ki chhat se awaaz aayi: “Aa gaya!” Main neend se utha toh pata bhi nahi tha ki kis se bhaagna hai. Bas sab bhaag rahe the. Kisi ki chappal reh gayi, kisi ki charpai ulat gayi. Mere pita seedhi ke saamne khade ho gaye aur bole, “Ek-ek karke. Dhakka mat do.”

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Jiski shakal koi ek nahi bata saka.

 2001 ka Delhi Monkey Man scare is kalpanik parivaar ki kahani ka sandarbh hai. Us daur ki reporting mein raat ka darr, alag-alag daave aur police ki jaanch milti hai. Lekin ek hi praani ki pakki pehchaan nahi milti. Kisi bayaan mein dhaatu ke panje the, kisi mein laal aankhein, kisi mein chhaton ke beech lambi chhalaang. Har badhti tafseel ne use aur aasaani se sochne laayak banaaya, zaroori nahi ki aur sachcha.

 Mere liye uska pehla roop akhbaar mein bana sketch tha. Maine use der tak dekha. Phir shaam ko paani ki tanki ke paas ek kaali bori dekhi toh wahi chehra yaad aaya. Bori hilli nahi. Main use dekhkar bhi nazar hata nahi paa raha tha. Ek tasveer mere dimaag mein us jagah pahunch gayi thi jahan pehle sirf puraana saamaan rakha tha.

Pahra dene waale bhi thake the.

 Hamaari gali mein log der tak jaagne lage. Koi torch rakhta, koi bas doosre ghar ki chhat par baithe aadmi se baat karta. Raat ke do baje ki baatein aksar bahut saadhaaran hoti thin—paani kab aayega, kaam kitne baje jaana hai, bachche soye ya nahi. Un saadhaaran baaton ke beech achanak koi poochhta, “Udhar kuch hila?” Aur sab ek saath chup ho jaate.

 Us raat ki cheekh ke baad jab hum neeche pahunche, meri chhoti behen ro rahi thi. Usne kuch dekha nahi tha. Use bas laga ki main chhat par reh gaya hoon. Main uske paas baith gaya. Bahar ab bhi log poochh rahe the ki kaun aaya tha. Ghar ke andar sawaal chhota tha: sab aa gaye?

 Pita waapas upar gaye, munder ke paas giri charpai seedhi ki aur hamaari chadarein le aaye. Unhone kisi praani ka bayaan nahi diya. Kaha, “Aaj neeche hi soenge.” Garam farsh par hum paas-paas let gaye. Neend der se aayi, par behen ne mera haath chhod diya.

Jab shehar phir soya.

 Afwaah ka zor ghata toh zindagi apni zarooraton ke saath wapas aayi. Logon ko subah kaam par jaana tha. Humein bhi hawa chahiye thi. Hum phir chhat par sone lage. Maine tanki ke paas ki bori din mein khud hataayi. Usmein puraane kapde the.

 Isse har us waqt ki shikayat ka jawaab nahi mil jaata. Darr aur choton ko halka kehna aasaan hai jab raat guzar chuki ho. Lekin khabar mein kisi daave ka chhapna, ya kisi ka ghabraakar gir jaana, us daave waale jeev ka saboot nahi banta.

 Mujhe us daur ki sabse saaf yaad kisi panje ki nahi hai. Woh seedhi par khade mere pita hain—khud jaage hue, khud pareshan, phir bhi humein dheere utarne ko keh rahe hain. Dilli ki us raat mein hamaare liye sabse zaroori awaaz wahi thi.

llorona.title: La Llorona: paani ke kinare rone wali
llorona.text:
Nadi ghar se dikhti nahi thi, lekin raat ko sunaai deti thi. Bachpan mein mujhe lagta tha paani hamesha ek hi awaaz karta hai. Us raat pehli baar laga ki uske beech koi ro raha hai. Main khidki tak gaya. Chandni mein kinaare ka raasta safed dikh raha tha. Wahin, pedon ke aage, ek aur safedi khadi thi. Hawa mein hilti hui. Maine naani ko bulaaya. Unhone khidki ke paas aakar bahar dekha aur mera kandha apni taraf kar liya.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Rone waali aurat.

 La Llorona ka matlab hai “rone waali aurat.” Mexico aur Latin America ki is lok-katha ke bahut-se versions hain. Ek mashhoor roop mein ek maa apne bachchon ko paani mein kho deti hai; kuch versions mein unki maut ke liye woh khud zimmedaar hoti hai. Pachhtaava uski kahani ka ant nahi banta. Uske baad shuru hoti hai talaash, jo maut ke baad bhi khatam nahi hoti.

 Naani ne us raat poori kahani nahi sunaayi. Bas kaha ki nadi ki taraf nahi jaana. Main bistar par aa gaya, lekin kaan khidki ki taraf lage rahe. Rone ki awaaz paas aati, phir paani mein mil jaati. Mujhe lagta koi chal raha hai. Phir lagta, shayad main uske chalne ki aahat khud bana raha hoon.

Kinaare par chhota-sa joota.

 Is kalpanik punarkathan mein saalon baad wahi bachcha bada hokar lautata hai. Naani ka ghar khaali ho chuka hai. Woh khidki kholta hai aur nadi ki awaaz pehchaan leta hai. Us raat bijli chali jaati hai. Kamre mein baithe-baithe use phir woh rona sunaai deta hai—bahut neeche, bahut thaka hua. Is baar woh bachcha nahi hai. Use lagta hai ki kisi ko madad chahiye.

 Woh roshni lekar darwaze tak jaata hai. Raaste par ek chhota joota pada hai. Geela. Uske aage mitti mein paani ki dhaar kheenchti hui nadi ki taraf jaati hai. Woh kisi ko pukaarta hai. Rona ruk jaata hai.

 Yahi khaamoshi use rok deti hai. Rona door se aa raha tha, lekin uske band hote hi use apne bahut paas kisi ki saans ka ehsaas hota hai. Woh roshni ghumaa kar dekhta hai. Koi nahi. Phir bahut dheere awaaz aati hai: “Tumne unhe dekha?”

Ghar ki taraf.

 Woh jawaab nahi jaanta. Use pata bhi nahi ki sawaal usse kiya gaya hai ya raat se. Woh peeche hatkar darwaze ke andar aa jaata hai. Kundi lagaata hai, roshni mez par rakhta hai aur subah tak uske bujhne ka intezaar karta rehta hai. Bahar paani phir apni puraani awaaz mein behne lagta hai.

 Subah raaste par joota nahi milta. Mitti geeli hai, kyunki raat mein baarish hui thi. Woh isse koi nateeja nahi nikaalta. Yeh kahani saboot ke saath band nahi hoti. Yeh bas ek kamre mein baithe aadmi ko chhod jaati hai, jo soch raha hai ki kisi ko dhoondhne ki aadat kab shok se badi ho jaati hai.

 La Llorona ke is version mein aakhri darr uska chehra nahi hai. Woh ek sawaal hai jo sunne waale ko apni zindagi ki taraf mod deta hai: jiski talaash khatam nahi hoti, usse kaise bataayein ki ab ghar lautne ka waqt ho gaya?

kuchisake.title: Kuchisake-onna: mask ke peeche ka sawaal
kuchisake.text:
Woh aurat sadak ke beech nahi khadi thi. Bas kinaare, jahaan se main roz guzarta tha. Isliye pehle mujhe laga hi nahi ki mujhe rukna padega. Phir usne poochha, “Kya main khoobsurat hoon?” Main school ka bag ek kandhe se doosre par kar raha tha. Sawaal itna achanak tha ki mere muh se aadat mein “haan” nikal gaya. Usne mask ke kinaare par ungli rakhi. “Ab bhi?”

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Ek sawaal, do baar.

 Japan ki Kuchisake-onna lok-katha ka darr isi dohraaye gaye sawaal mein hai. Pehli baar jawaab dena aasaan lagta hai. Doosri baar lagta hai ki pehla jawaab hi tumhe phansa gaya. Uske naam ka sambandh kate hue muh ki chhavi se hai; is punarkathan mein uski graphic tafseel se zyada us pal par dhyaan hai jab bachche ko samajh aata hai ki woh is baatcheet ke niyam nahi jaanta.

 Mask neeche hua toh maine aankhein hata lin. Mujhe bas uski muskurahat ka asaamaanya phailaav yaad raha. Maine na poori tarah dekha, na poori tarah bach saka. Usne phir sawaal poochha. Is baar awaaz mein gussa nahi tha. Intezaar tha. Jaise uske paas poori raat ho, aur mere paas ek hi jawaab.

Sahi shabd ka intezaar.

 School mein bachche uske kisse sunaate the. Har kisi ke paas bachne ka ek tareeka tha, aur doosra bachcha turant kehta tha ki woh tareeka galat hai. Us waqt mujhe sab yaad aaya, aur kuch bhi kaam ka nahi laga. Maine socha ki main bhaagoon toh? Pair zameen par jam gaye. Main jhooth boloon toh? Pehla jawaab toh waise hi bina soche diya tha.

 Mujhe sabse zyada darr is baat se laga ki main use naaraaz nahi karna chahta tha. Hum bachchon ko anjaanon se bachna sikhaate hain, lekin saath hi har bade ke sawaal ka tameez se jawaab dena bhi. Main dono baatein ek saath karne ki koshish mein wahin khada tha.

 Door se cycle ki ghanti aayi. Maine us taraf dekha. Roshni ka ek tukda sadak par sarak raha tha. Maine uske paar dukaan ka khula darwaza dekha aur usi taraf chal diya. Pehle dheere, phir tez. Aurat ne mera naam nahi liya. Bas wahi sawaal mere peeche aaya, itna shaant ki usse meri jaldi aur ajeeb lagne lagi.

Agle din wahi jagah.

 Dukaan mein log the. Koi sikke gin raha tha. Koi packet maang raha tha. Maine pehli baar kisi bheed ko itni rahat se dekha. Dukandaar ne paani diya, phir ghar phone kiya. Is kalpanik ant mein bachcha bach jaata hai; yeh kisi lokpriya “survival rule” ki pushti nahi hai.

 Agle din us jagah koi nahi tha. Main doston ke saath nikla. Unhone poochha ki chehra kaisa tha. Maine kaha ki theek se nahi dekha. Unhe niraasha hui. Woh kahani ka sabse daraawna hissa sunna chahte the. Mujhe bas apne muh se bina soche nikli pehli “haan” yaad thi.

 Kuchisake-onna mere liye uske baad ek chehre se zyada ek dabaav ban gayi—woh pal jab kisi aur ko santusht karne ke liye hum apni bechaini ko nazarandaaz kar dete hain. Kabhi-kabhi kahani padhte hue bhi main pehle sawaal par rukta hoon. Is baar jawaab dene ki jaldi nahi karta.

blackshuck.title: Black Shuck: toofan mein kaala kutta
blackshuck.text:
Toofan shuru hua toh humne socha tha church ke andar surakshit rahenge. Darwaza band hua, geele kapdon ki gandh patthar ki thandak mein mil gayi. Bahar bijli chamakti toh khidki ek pal ke liye safed ho jaati. Phir andhera pehle se gehra lagta. Main bench par baitha apne haath ragad raha tha. Tab darwaze ki taraf sabke chehre ek saath mud gaye.

 Yeh lok-katha se prerit rachnatmak punarkathan hai. “Main”, samvaad aur vyaktigat drishya kalpanik hain; tathya aur seemaayein ant ke “Sach kya hai?” mein hain. 

Andar aaya andhera.

 Black Shuck ki riwaayat se juda 1577 ka Suffolk toofan aur uska puraana likhit bayaan is kahani ki prishthabhoomi hain. Neeche ka “main” ek kalpanik shrota-drashta hai. Woh aitihasik gawahi dene nahi, us bhay ki kalpana karne ke liye hai jo logon ne ek kaale kutte ka roop dekar sunaaya.

 Darwaza hawa se hila ya kisi ne dhakela, mujhe is kisse mein bhi theek se nahi dikhta. Jo dikhta hai woh farsh ke paas ek kaali aakriti hai. Uska aakaar roshni ke saath badalta hai. Pehle lagta hai koi geela jaanwar ghus aaya. Phir woh beech ke raaste mein rukta hai, aur mujhe uski aankhein dikhne ka bharam hota hai. Koi mere paas prarthana ke shabd bol raha hai, baar-baar ek hi jagah se shuru karke.

 Bijli ki kadak itni paas hoti hai ki main kaan dhak leta hoon. Kuch girta hai. Log hilte hain. Us ek pal mein main jaanwar ko kho deta hoon. Jab haath hataata hoon, mujhe apni saans ki awaaz bahut tez sunaai deti hai.

Jo ek pal mein nahi dekha gaya.

 Baad mein sabke paas us raat ka ek alag hissa hai. Kisi ne aankhein dekhin, kisi ne panje. Kisi ko yaad hai ki woh darwaze tak gaya. Kisi ko lagta hai woh achanak gaayab hua. Main jab bolne lagta hoon toh mujhe apne hi bayaan mein khaali jagah milti hai. Kadak ke waqt maine aankhein band ki thin. Uske pehle bhi mujhe farsh saaf nahi dikh raha tha.

 Lekin doosre log jab apni baat jodte hain, toh meri yaad bhi badalne lagti hai. Main sochta hoon, shayad maine bhi woh dekha tha. Yahin kahani dheere se meri aankhon se nikal kar sabki zubaan par chali jaati hai. Ab woh ek aadmi ki yaad nahi, poore toofan ki shakal hai.

Darwaze par reh gaye nishaan.

 Black Shuck ke baare mein alag riwaayatein hain: kabhi vinaash ka sanket, kabhi sunsaan raaste ka saathi, kabhi door se dikhkar gaayab hone waala praani. Kisi puraane darwaze par nishaan ko uske panje keh dene se unka kaaran siddh nahi hota. Puraana likhit bayaan bhi humein batata hai ki kya likha gaya; har vyakhya ko apne aap sach nahi banaata.

 Mere kalpanik drashta ke liye raat tab khatam hoti hai jab woh ghar ka darwaza khatkhatata hai. Andar se roshni aati hai. Uske ghar ka saadhaaran kutta uthkar uske paas aata hai, geele jooton ko soonghta hai aur phir apni jagah let jaata hai. Aadmi uske paas baith jaata hai. Kaafi der tak kuch nahi kehta.

 Saalon baad bhi toofan aaye toh use church yaad aata hai. Lekin ab woh ek baat apni kahani mein zaroor rakhta hai: “Us waqt meri aankhein band thin.” Shayad isi chhoti imaandaari ki wajah se baaki kahani aur gehri lagti hai. Hum uske saath andhere mein khade hote hain, bina yeh daawa kiye ki humein sab dikh raha hai.
